function chooseArena() {
  // Automatyczne losowanie jest domyślne. Ręczny wybór dostępny w ustawieniach aren.
  if (S.arenaPick === 'manual') return clamp(S.th|0, 0, ARENAS.length-1);
  let index = Math.floor(Math.random()*ARENAS.length);
  if (ARENAS.length>1 && index === S.lastArena) index = (index + 1 + Math.floor(Math.random()*(ARENAS.length-1))) % ARENAS.length;
  S.lastArena = index;
  save();
  return index;
}

function getBallStats(id, customTier, customDmgLv, customHpLv) {
  const b = B[id] || B[0];
  const isHw = id >= 99;
  const tier = customTier ?? (S?.tr?.[id] || 1);
  const dmgLv = customDmgLv ?? (S?.upDmg?.[id] | 0);
  const hpLv = customHpLv ?? (S?.upHp?.[id] | 0);
  const baseHp = BASE_HP_TABLE[id] || 105;
  const baseDmg = id == 50 ? 30 : id == 23 ? 22 : id == 99 ? 20 : 12;
  const rawCd = BASE_CD_TABLE[id] ?? 4.0;
  const tierStatMult = tier == 3 ? 1.32 : tier == 2 ? 1.15 : 1.0;
  const tierAbilityMult = tier == 3 ? 1.55 : tier == 2 ? 1.25 : 1.0;
  const cdMult = tier == 3 ? 0.72 : tier == 2 ? 0.85 : 1.0;
  const hp = Math.round(baseHp * (1 + 0.08 * hpLv) * tierStatMult);
  const dmg = Math.round(baseDmg * (1 + 0.08 * dmgLv) * tierStatMult);
  const cd = rawCd > 0 ? +(rawCd * cdMult).toFixed(2) : 0;
  const cleanDesc = b.d.replace(/^\[HALLOWEEN\]\s*/i, '');
  const descV2 = `${cleanDesc} [Ewolucja V2: +25% siły umiejętności${rawCd > 0 ? `, cooldown ${(rawCd * 0.85).toFixed(1)}s` : ''}].`;
  const descV3 = `${cleanDesc} [Ewolucja V3 MAX: +55% siły umiejętności${rawCd > 0 ? `, cooldown ${(rawCd * 0.72).toFixed(1)}s` : ''}, impuls specjalny].`;
  const activeDesc = tier == 3 ? descV3 : tier == 2 ? descV2 : cleanDesc;
  return { id, b, isHw, tier, dmgLv, hpLv, hp, dmg, cd, activeDesc };
}

const orb = b => orbHTML(b);
const roll = (halloweenOnly = false) => {
  if (halloweenOnly) return rnd(BVB_ROSTER);
  let x = Math.random() * 100, r = 0;
  for (; r < 4 && x >= RW[r]; r++) x -= RW[r];
  const pool = B.filter(b => b.r == r && b.id < 99);
  return pool.length ? rnd(pool) : rnd(B.filter(b => b.id < 99));
};

function load() {
  let raw = null;
  try {
    const str = localStorage.getItem(K);
    if (str) raw = JSON.parse(str);
  } catch (e) {
    raw = null;
  }

  if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw)) {
    S = {
      ver: 4,
      initReward: 1,
      coins: 100,
      candies: 50,
      xp: 0,
      lv: 1,
      own: [0, 1, 2],
      dup: {},
      dupV2: {},
      tr: {},
      upDmg: {},
      upHp: {},
      q: {}
    };
  } else {
    S = raw;
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(S.own) || !S.own.length) S.own = [0, 1, 2];
  S.own = [...new Set([0, 1, 2, ...S.own.filter(id => Number.isInteger(id) && B[id])])];

  if (!S.initReward) {
    S.coins = Number.isFinite(S.coins) ? S.coins : 100;
    S.candies = Number.isFinite(S.candies) ? S.candies : 50;
    S.initReward = 1;
  } else {
    S.coins = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(S.coins) || 0));
    S.candies = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(S.candies) || 0));
  }

  S.dup = (S.dup && typeof S.dup === 'object') ? S.dup : {};
  S.dupV2 = (S.dupV2 && typeof S.dupV2 === 'object') ? S.dupV2 : {};
  S.tr = (S.tr && typeof S.tr === 'object') ? S.tr : {};
  S.upDmg = (S.upDmg && typeof S.upDmg === 'object') ? S.upDmg : {};
  S.upHp = (S.upHp && typeof S.upHp === 'object') ? S.upHp : {};

  const t = new Date().toDateString();
  if (!S.q || S.q.d !== t) S.q = { d: t, play: 0, win: 0, gacha: 0, bn: 0, rare: 0, tw: 0, cl: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(S.q.cl)) S.q.cl = [];
  S.hwq = S.hwq || { hwwin: 0, hwplay: 0, hwbox: 0, cl: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(S.hwq.cl)) S.hwq.cl = [];
  S.bk = S.bk || {};
  S.fav = S.fav || {};
  S.ac = Array.isArray(S.ac) ? S.ac : [];
  S.hist = Array.isArray(S.hist) ? S.hist : [];
  S.bdt = S.bdt || {};
  S.bossWins = S.bossWins || {};
  S.rewardIds = Array.isArray(S.rewardIds) ? S.rewardIds : [];
  S.arenaCfg = S.arenaCfg && typeof S.arenaCfg === 'object' ? S.arenaCfg : {};
  S.arenaPick = S.arenaPick === 'manual' ? 'manual' : 'random';
  S.ach = S.ach && typeof S.ach === 'object' ? S.ach : { winsByArena:{}, portals:0, bounces:0, claimed:[] };
  S.ach.winsByArena ||= {};
  S.ach.portals = Math.max(0, Number(S.ach.portals)||0);
  S.ach.bounces = Math.max(0, Number(S.ach.bounces)||0);
  S.ach.claimed = Array.isArray(S.ach.claimed) ? S.ach.claimed : [];
  S.playerTitle ||= '';
  S.playerAura ||= '';
  S.o = Object.assign({}, DO, S.o);
  const wk = Math.floor(Date.now() / 6048e5);
  if (!S.wq || S.wq.k !== wk) S.wq = { k: wk, win: 0, play: 0, boss: 0, cl: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(S.wq.cl)) S.wq.cl = [];
  if (S.q.tb == null || !S.own.includes(S.q.tb)) S.q.tb = rnd(S.own);
  const mo = new Date().getFullYear() * 12 + new Date().getMonth();
  if (!S.bp || S.bp.m !== mo) S.bp = { m: mo, p: 0, cl: [] };
  if (!Array.isArray(S.bp.cl)) S.bp.cl = [];
  S.sh = S.sh || { tr: [0], sk: [0], vf: [0] };
  S.eq = S.eq || { tr: 0, sk: 0, vf: 0 };
  MU.s = S.ms | 0;
  MU.m = S.mm | 0;
  save();
  preloadArt();
}

function save() {
  const warn = $('#saveWarn');
  try {
    // The logged-in nickname is controlled by its exclusive Firestore claim.
    if (window.BVBCloud?.isOnline && window.BVBCloud.nickname) S.nm = window.BVBCloud.nickname;
    localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(S));
    if (warn) warn.hidden = true;
  } catch (e) {
    if (warn) warn.hidden = false;
  }
  const cc = $('#coinCount'), cd = $('#candyCount');
  if (cc && S) cc.textContent = S.coins;
  if (cd && S) cd.textContent = S.candies;
  window.BVBCloud?.scheduleSave?.();
}

function snd(f, d, t, v, s, m) {
  if (m ? MU.m : MU.s) return;
  v *= (m ? S.o.vm : S.o.vs) * 1.3;
  if (v < 0.001) return;
  try {
    AC = AC || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if (AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume().catch(() => {});
    const n = AC.currentTime, o = AC.createOscillator(), g = AC.createGain();
    o.type = t;
    o.frequency.setValueAtTime(f, n);
    if (s) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(s, n + d);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(v, n);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, n + d);
    o.connect(g);
    g.connect(AC.destination);
    o.start();
    o.stop(n + d);
  } catch (e) {}
}
const mel = (a, t) => a.forEach((f, i) => setTimeout(() => snd(f, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.09), i * t));
const SFX = {
  hit: () => snd(220, 0.1, 'square', 0.07, 90),
  boom: () => snd(140, 0.38, 'sawtooth', 0.1, 30),
  shot: () => snd(880, 0.07, 'square', 0.035, 380),
  zap: () => snd(1250, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.06, 200),
  tick: () => snd(700, 0.04, 'square', 0.045),
  win: () => mel([523, 659, 784, 1047], 115),
  lose: () => mel([392, 330, 262, 196], 135),
  rare: () => mel([440, 554, 659, 880, 1108], 85)
};

const BG_MENU = [220, 262, 330, 262, 208, 247, 311, 247, 196, 233, 294, 233, 185, 220, 277, 247];
const BG_BATTLE = [294, 349, 440, 466, 440, 349, 294, 262, 330, 392, 494, 523, 494, 392, 330, 294];
// Oryginalne, generowane w przeglądarce ścieżki Halloween — bez plików MP3 i internetu.
const HW_MENU = [220, 0, 261.63, 0, 246.94, 0, 196, 0, 174.61, 0, 164.81, 0, 196, 0, 146.83, 0];
const HW_BATTLE = [220, 261.63, 293.66, 261.63, 220, 174.61, 196, 164.81, 220, 261.63, 329.63, 293.66, 261.63, 220, 196, 164.81];

// Poza październikiem event nadal ma swój własny mroczny motyw.
function halloweenSeason() {
  const d = new Date();
  return d.getMonth() === 9 || (d.getMonth() === 10 && d.getDate() <= 2);
}
function musicTheme() {
  const eventPanel = !$('#pn').hidden && $('#pn').dataset.panel === 'hw';
  if (!$('#game').hidden && G && G.th!=null) return 'arena-'+G.th;
  return halloweenSeason() || eventPanel ? 'halloween' : 'normal';
}

// Miękka synteza: mroczne dzwonki, drony i pulsujący bas.
// Dźwięki kończą się automatycznie; nie pozostają aktywne po zmianie muzyki.
function spookyTone(freq, duration, type = 'sine', volume = 0.025, cutoff = 1300, detune = 0) {
  if (MU.m || document.hidden || !freq || !S || !S.o) return;
  try {
    AC = AC || new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    if (AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume().catch(() => {});
    const now = AC.currentTime;
    const osc = AC.createOscillator(), gain = AC.createGain(), filter = AC.createBiquadFilter();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, now);
    osc.detune.value = detune;
    filter.type = 'lowpass';
    filter.frequency.value = cutoff;
    // Halloween gra teraz ok. 2,2 raza głośniej; suwak muzyki nadal reguluje poziom.
    const amount = Math.max(0.0001, Math.min(0.18, volume * S.o.vm * 2.2));
    const attack = Math.min(0.08, duration * 0.2);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, now);
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(amount, now + attack);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, now + duration);
    osc.connect(filter); filter.connect(gain); gain.connect(AC.destination);
    osc.start(now); osc.stop(now + duration + 0.01);
  } catch (e) {}
}
function halloweenBeat(step, isBattle) {
  const melody = isBattle ? HW_BATTLE : HW_MENU;
  const n = melody[step % melody.length];
  if (n) {
    // Celowo nierówne, rozstrojone dzwony dla nawiedzonego klimatu.
    spookyTone(n * (isBattle ? 1 : 2), isBattle ? 0.22 : 0.46,
      'sine', isBattle ? 0.052 : 0.046, 2100, step % 4 === 0 ? -8 : 6);
    spookyTone(n / 2, isBattle ? 0.3 : 0.6, 'triangle', 0.026, 640);
  }
  if (step % 8 === 0) {
    // Niskie tło: Am → Fm → Dm → E, bez samplowanych nagrań.
    const roots = [110, 87.31, 73.42, 82.41];
    const root = roots[Math.floor(step / 8) % roots.length];
    spookyTone(root, isBattle ? 1.2 : 2.5, 'sawtooth', isBattle ? 0.030 : 0.020, 280);
    spookyTone(root * 1.498, isBattle ? 0.9 : 2.2, 'triangle', 0.013, 450, -5);
  }
  if (isBattle) {
    if (step % 4 === 0) {
      spookyTone(72, 0.19, 'sine', 0.1, 220); // uderzenie bębna
      spookyTone(36, 0.14, 'triangle', 0.045, 140);
    }
    if (step % 4 === 2) spookyTone(185, 0.055, 'square', 0.017, 900);
    if (step % 2 === 1) spookyTone(910, 0.038, 'triangle', 0.009, 2800);
  } else if (step % 8 === 7) {
    spookyTone(740, 0.7, 'sine', 0.009, 1800, -14); // echo / szept
  }
}

// Osobny instrumentalny motyw dla każdej mapy (WebAudio; działa także offline).
const ARENA_NOTES = [
  [220,261.63,246.94,196,174.61,164.81,196,146.83],
  [220,277.18,329.63,440,329.63,277.18,246.94,196],
  [164.81,196,220,164.81,146.83,196,174.61,130.81],
  [293.66,349.23,440,392,349.23,329.63,293.66,261.63],
  [174.61,220,261.63,293.66,261.63,220,196,174.61],
  [261.63,329.63,392,523.25,392,329.63,349.23,293.66]
];
function arenaBeat(arenaIndex, n, isBattle) {
  const melody=ARENA_NOTES[arenaIndex], ar=ARENAS[arenaIndex];
  const f=melody[n % melody.length] * (isBattle?1:0.5);
  if(arenaIndex===0) { halloweenBeat(n, isBattle); return; }
  const instrument=arenaIndex===1?'sine':arenaIndex===2?'sawtooth':arenaIndex===3?'triangle':arenaIndex===4?'sine':'square';
  snd(f, isBattle?0.18:0.31, instrument, arenaIndex===2?0.035:0.030, 0, 1);
  if(n%4===0) snd(f/2, isBattle?.3:.55, 'triangle', 0.026, 0, 1);
  if(arenaIndex===2 && n%2===0) snd(62,0.15,'sawtooth',0.022,0,1);
  if(arenaIndex===3 && n%4===2) snd(f*2,.18,'sine',.025,0,1);
  if(arenaIndex===4 && n%4===3) snd(f*1.5,.3,'sine',.021,0,1);
  if(arenaIndex===5 && n%2) snd(f*2,.065,'square',.014,0,1);
  if(arenaIndex===1 && n%4===1) snd(f*2,.43,'sine',.014,0,1);
}
function bgm(mode = bgmMode) {
  const theme = musicTheme();
  if (bt && bgmMode === mode && bgmTheme === theme) return;
  bgmMode = mode;
  bgmTheme = theme;
  clearInterval(bt);
  bt = null;
  bi = 0;
  if (MU.m || document.hidden) return;
  const isBattle = mode === 'battle';
  const spooky = theme === 'halloween';
  const arenaIndex=theme.startsWith('arena-')? Number(theme.slice(6)):-1;
  const track = isBattle ? BG_BATTLE : BG_MENU;
  const tempo = arenaIndex>=0 ? (isBattle?175:285) : spooky ? (isBattle ? 180 : 345) : (isBattle ? 165 : 245);
  const step = () => {
    if (arenaIndex>=0 && ARENAS[arenaIndex]) { arenaBeat(arenaIndex,bi++,isBattle); }
    else if (spooky) {
      halloweenBeat(bi++, isBattle);
    } else {
      const n = track[bi++ % track.length];
      snd(n / 2, isBattle ? 0.15 : 0.22, isBattle ? 'sawtooth' : 'triangle', 0.032, 0, 1);
      if (bi % 4 === 1) snd(n / 4, 0.24, 'square', 0.02, 0, 1);
    }
  };
  step();
  bt = setInterval(step, tempo);
}

document.addEventListener('pointerdown', () => {
  try { if (AC && AC.state === 'suspended') AC.resume(); } catch (e) {}
  if (!MU.m && !bt) bgm(bgmMode);
}, { passive: true });

}
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
  if (document.hidden) { clearInterval(bt); bt = null; }
  else if (!MU.m) bgm(bgmMode);
});

}

function achievementProgress(id) {
  return id==='arenas' ? Object.keys(S.ach.winsByArena).filter(k=>S.ach.winsByArena[k]).length : id==='portals' ? S.ach.portals : S.ach.bounces;
}
function achievementGoal(id) { return id==='arenas'?6:id==='portals'?10:25; }
function checkAchievements() {
  if (!S || !S.ach) return;
  for (const a of ARENA_ACHIEVEMENTS) {
    if (S.ach.claimed.includes(a.id) || achievementProgress(a.id) < achievementGoal(a.id)) continue;
    S.ach.claimed.push(a.id); S.coins += a.coin;
    if (!S.playerTitle) S.playerTitle = a.title;
    if (!S.playerAura) S.playerAura = a.aura;
    if (G) { G.pop ||= []; G.pop.push({x:180,y:145,age:0,life:2,text:'🏆 '+a.name,c:'#fbbf24'}); }
  }
  save();
}

            `;
          }).join('')}
        </div>
        <button class="b" style="margin-top:12px" ${S.candies < 50 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="exchangeCandies()">🔄 Wymień 50 🍬 na 100 🪙 monet</button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  if (k == 'shop') {
    p.innerHTML = `
      <div class="cd">
        <h2>📦 Zwykła Skrzynka z Kulą</h2>
        <p style="color:var(--mu);font-size:0.86rem;margin-bottom:10px">
          Masz 🪙 <b>${S.coins}</b>. Losuje jedną ze standardowych kulek (ID 0–98). Jeśli trafisz duplikat posiadanej kulki, otrzymujesz <b>+1 Duplikat do Ewolucji V2/V3</b>!
        </p>
        <p style="font-size:0.8rem;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:12px">
          Szanse zgodne z rozkładem: Zwykła 45%, Rzadka 30%, Epicka 16%, Legendarna 7%, Mityczna 2%.
        </p>
        <button class="b graj" ${S.coins < 100 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="pull(false)">Otwórz za 100 🪙</button>
      </div>
      <div class="cd hw-card">
        <h2>🎃 Skrzynka Halloween Event</h2>
        <p style="color:#fed7aa;font-size:0.86rem;margin-bottom:10px">
          Masz 🍬 <b>${S.candies}</b>. Gwarantowana kulka z puli kulek Halloween (ID 99–119)! Duplikat daje <b>+1 Duplikat do Ewolucji V2/V3</b>. Koszt: 50 🍬.
        </p>
        <button class="b hw" ${S.candies < 50 ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="pull(true)">Otwórz Skrzynię Halloween (50 🍬)</button>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  if (k == 'col') {
    renderBrawlInventory(p);
  }
  if (k == 'q') qp(p);
  if (k == 'pr') prof(p);
  if (k == 'set') setp(p);
  if (k == 'st') stp(p);
  if (k == 'bp') bpp(p);
}

function renderBrawlInventory(p) {
  const filterFn = b => {
    if (colRarity !== -1 && b.r !== colRarity) return false;
    if (colSearch) {
      const q = colSearch.toLowerCase();
      return b.n.toLowerCase().includes(q) || String(b.id) === q;
    }
    return true;
  };
  const unlockedBalls = B.filter(b => S.own.includes(b.id) && filterFn(b)).sort((a,b)=>a.r-b.r || a.id-b.id);
  const lockedBalls = B.filter(b => !S.own.includes(b.id) && filterFn(b)).sort((a,b)=>a.r-b.r || a.id-b.id);

  const renderCard = (b, isOwn) => {
    const st = getBallStats(b.id);
    const v1Dup = S.dup[b.id] | 0;
    const v2Dup = (S.dupV2[b.id] | 0) + Math.floor(v1Dup / 5);
    const totalLv = 1 + st.dmgLv + st.hpLv;
    const dupNeed = 5;
    const dupCur = st.tier == 1 ? v1Dup : st.tier == 2 ? v2Dup : 5;
    const dupPct = st.tier >= 3 ? 100 : Math.min(100, (dupCur / dupNeed) * 100);
    const dupLabel = st.tier >= 3 ? 'MAX V3' : `${dupCur}/${dupNeed} dupl. → V${st.tier + 1}`;

    return `
      <div class="bs-card ${isOwn ? '' : 'lk'}" style="--rc:${RC[b.r]}" onclick="openBallDetail(${b.id})">
        ${isOwn ? `<span class="bs-lv-badge">MOC ${totalLv}</span><span class="bs-tier-badge">V${st.tier}</span>` : ''}
        <div style="margin-top:14px">${orb(b)}</div>
        <b style="font-size:0.84rem">${b.n}</b>
        <small style="color:${RC[b.r]};font-weight:800;font-size:0.7rem">${RN[b.r]}</small>
        <small style="font-size:0.7rem;color:#e2e8f0">❤️ ${st.hp} · ⚔️ ${st.dmg}${st.cd ? ` · ⏱️ ${st.cd}s` : ''}</small>
        ${isOwn ? `
          <div class="dup-bar">
            <i style="width:${dupPct}%"></i>
            <span>${dupLabel}</span>
          </div>
          <button class="b ac" style="padding:6px;margin:4px 0 0;font-size:0.72rem">Szczegóły / Ulepsz</button>
        ` : `
          <small style="color:#fca5a5;font-size:0.68rem;margin-top:2px">${b.id >= 99 ? '🎃 Event Halloween' : '📦 Skrzynka / Sklep'}</small>
          <button class="b" style="padding:6px;margin:4px 0 0;font-size:0.72rem">Podgląd (${b.id >= 99 ? '80 🍬' : '120 🪙'})</button>
        `}
      </div>
    `;
  };

  p.innerHTML = `
    <div class="bs-top">
      <div>
        <div class="bs-counter">🔮 ODBLOKOWANE KULKI: ${S.own.length} / ${BVB_ROSTER.length}</div>
        <small style="color:var(--mu);font-size:0.76rem">Tylko kulki w sekcji „Odblokowane” należą do Ciebie. Pozostałe są podglądem do zdobycia.</small>
      </div>
      <input class="inp" style="margin:4px 0 0" placeholder="🔍 Szukaj kulki..." value="${colSearch.replace(/"/g, '')}" oninput="colSearch=this.value;renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'))" />
      <div style="display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;width:100%;margin-top:4px">
        <button class="b ${colRarity === -1 ? 'ac' : ''}" style="width:auto;padding:5px 9px;margin:0;font-size:0.7rem" onclick="colRarity=-1;renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'))">Wszystkie</button>
        ${RN.map((rn, idx) => `<button class="b ${colRarity === idx ? 'ac' : ''}" style="width:auto;padding:5px 8px;margin:0;font-size:0.7rem;border-color:${RC[idx]}" onclick="colRarity=${idx};renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'))">${rn}</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="bs-sec-title">
      <span>✅ ODBLOKOWANE KULKI (${unlockedBalls.length})</span>
      <span>Gotowe do walki</span>
    </div>
    <div class="col-grid">
      ${unlockedBalls.map(b => renderCard(b, true)).join('') || '<div class="cd" style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center">Brak odblokowanych kulek spełniających filtr.</div>'}
    </div>

    <div class="bs-sec-title" style="border-left-color:#64748b;color:#cbd5e1">
      <span>🔒 ZABLOKOWANE KULKI (${lockedBalls.length})</span>
      <span>Do zdobycia</span>
    </div>
    <div class="col-grid">
      ${lockedBalls.map(b => renderCard(b, false)).join('') || '<div class="cd" style="grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center">Wszystkie kulki w tej kategorii zostały odblokowane! 🎉</div>'}
    </div>
  `;
}

function openBallDetail(id) {
  const b = B[id];
  if (!b) return;
  const isOwn = S.own.includes(id);
  const st = getBallStats(id);
  const nextDmgSt = getBallStats(id, st.tier, Math.min(5, st.dmgLv + 1), st.hpLv);
  const nextHpSt = getBallStats(id, st.tier, st.dmgLv, Math.min(5, st.hpLv + 1));
  const nextTierSt = getBallStats(id, Math.min(3, st.tier + 1), st.dmgLv, st.hpLv);

  const curIcon = st.isHw ? '🍬' : '🪙';
  const walletAmt = st.isHw ? S.candies : S.coins;
  const dmgCost = (st.isHw ? 35 : 60) * (st.dmgLv + 1);
  const hpCost = (st.isHw ? 35 : 60) * (st.hpLv + 1);

  const v1Dup = S.dup[id] | 0;
  const v2DupRaw = S.dupV2[id] | 0;
  const convertibleV2 = Math.floor(v1Dup / 5);
  const totalV2Available = v2DupRaw + convertibleV2;

  const canEvolveV2 = isOwn && st.tier === 1 && v1Dup >= 5;
  const canEvolveV3 = isOwn && st.tier === 2 && totalV2Available >= 5;

  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;text-align:left;margin-bottom:10px">
      <div class="rev" style="--rc:${RC[b.r]};margin:0">${orb(b)}</div>
      <div>
        <span style="background:${RC[b.r]};color:#000;font-weight:900;font-size:0.7rem;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:99px">${RN[b.r]}</span>
        <h2 style="margin:4px 0 2px">${b.n}</h2>
        <b style="color:#fde047;font-size:0.85rem">Ewolucja: V${st.tier} / V3 ${st.isHw ? '· 🎃 Kulka Halloween' : ''}</b>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="stat-box-grid">
      <div class="stat-pill">❤️ Zdrowie<b>${st.hp} HP</b></div>
      <div class="stat-pill">⚔️ Obrażenia<b>${st.dmg} DMG</b></div>
      <div class="stat-pill">⏱️ Cooldown<b>${st.cd ? st.cd + ' s' : 'Pasywna'}</b></div>
    </div>

    <div class="cd" style="text-align:left;margin:8px 0;font-size:0.8rem;line-height:1.45">
      <b style="color:#38bdf8">⚡ Aktualna umiejętność (V${st.tier}):</b>
      <p style="margin-top:4px;color:#f8fafc">${st.activeDesc}</p>
      ${st.tier < 3 ? `
        <hr style="border:0;border-top:1px solid #3b2d6e;margin:8px 0">
        <b style="color:#fb923c">🔮 Podgląd kolejnej ewolucji (V${st.tier + 1}):</b>
        <p style="margin-top:3px;color:var(--mu)">${st.tier === 1 ? b.d + ' [Ewolucja V2]' : b.d + ' [Ewolucja V3 MAX]'}</p>
        <small style="color:#fde047;display:block;margin-top:4px">
          Statystyki na V${st.tier + 1}: ❤️ ${ st.hp } → <b>${ nextTierSt.hp } HP</b> · ⚔️ ${ st.dmg } → <b>${ nextTierSt.dmg } DMG</b>
        </small>
      ` : '<p style="color:#4ade80;font-weight:800;margin-top:6px">✨ Osiągnięto maksymalną ewolucję V3!</p>'}
    </div>

    ${isOwn ? `
      <div class="cd" style="text-align:left;margin:8px 0">
        <h3 style="font-size:0.85rem">🛠️ Ulepszenia Statystyk (${st.isHw ? 'za Cukierki 🍬' : 'za Monety 🪙'})</h3>
        <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top:8px;margin-bottom:0">
          <button class="b ${st.isHw ? 'hw' : 'ac'}" style="flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:10px 6px;font-size:0.75rem" ${st.dmgLv >= 5 || walletAmt < dmgCost ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="upgradeStat(${id}, 'dmg')">
            <span>⚔️ Obrażenia Lv ${st.dmgLv}/5</span>
            <small style="color:#fef08a">${st.dmgLv < 5 ? `${st.dmg} → ${nextDmgSt.dmg} DMG (${dmgCost} ${curIcon})` : 'MAKSYMALNY'}</small>
          </button>
          <button class="b ${st.isHw ? 'hw' : 'ac'}" style="flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:10px 6px;font-size:0.75rem" ${st.hpLv >= 5 || walletAmt < hpCost ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="upgradeStat(${id}, 'hp')">
            <span>❤️ Zdrowie Lv ${st.hpLv}/5</span>
            <small style="color:#fef08a">${st.hpLv < 5 ? `${st.hp} → ${nextHpSt.hp} HP (${hpCost} ${curIcon})` : 'MAKSYMALNY'}</small>
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="cd hw-card" style="text-align:left;margin:8px 0">
        <h3 style="font-size:0.85rem">🧬 Duplikaty i Ewolucja V2 / V3</h3>
        <p style="font-size:0.76rem;color:#fed7aa;margin-bottom:6px">
          Duplikaty V1: <b>${v1Dup}</b> · Duplikaty V2: <b>${v2DupRaw}</b> ${convertibleV2 > 0 && st.tier === 2 ? `(w tym +${convertibleV2} z nadmiaru V1)` : ''}
        </p>
        ${st.tier === 1 ? `
          <button class="b graj" style="font-size:0.86rem;padding:11px;margin:0" ${canEvolveV2 ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="evolveWithDuplicates(${id})">
            ✨ Ewoluuj do V2 (${v1Dup}/5 duplikatów V1)
          </button>
        ` : st.tier === 2 ? `
          <button class="b graj" style="font-size:0.86rem;padding:11px;margin:0" ${canEvolveV3 ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="evolveWithDuplicates(${id})">
            🌟 Ewoluuj do V3 (${totalV2Available}/5 duplikatów V2)
          </button>
        ` : `
          <div style="text-align:center;color:#fde047;font-weight:900;font-size:0.85rem">🏆 Kulka na poziomie mistrzowskim V3!</div>
        `}
      </div>
    ` : `
      <div class="cd" style="margin:8px 0">
        <p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--mu);margin-bottom:8px">Ta kulka jest jeszcze zablokowana. Odblokuj ją bezpośrednio:</p>
        <button class="b ${st.isHw ? 'hw' : 'graj'}" style="font-size:0.9rem;padding:12px;margin:0" ${(st.isHw ? S.candies < 80 : S.coins < 120) ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="buyBallDirect(${id});openBallDetail(${id})">
          🔓 Odblokuj teraz za ${st.isHw ? '80 🍬' : '120 🪙'}
        </button>
      </div>
    `}

    <button class="b" style="margin:8px 0 0;padding:11px" onclick="$('#ov').hidden=true;if(!$('#pn').hidden)panel('col')">Zamknij</button>
  `;
}

function upgradeStat(id, kind) {
  if (!S.own.includes(id)) return;
  const isHw = id >= 99;
  const table = kind === 'dmg' ? S.upDmg : S.upHp;
  const lv = table[id] | 0;
  if (lv >= 5) return;
  const cost = (isHw ? 35 : 60) * (lv + 1);
  if (isHw) {
    if (S.candies < cost) return;
    S.candies -= cost;
  } else {
    if (S.coins < cost) return;
    S.coins -= cost;
  }
  table[id] = lv + 1;
  save();
  SFX.win();
  openBallDetail(id);
  if (!$('#pn').hidden) renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'));
}

function evolveWithDuplicates(id) {
  if (!S.own.includes(id)) return;
  const tier = S.tr[id] || 1;
  if (tier === 1) {
    if ((S.dup[id] | 0) < 5) return;
    S.dup[id] -= 5;
    S.tr[id] = 2;
  } else if (tier === 2) {
    let v2 = S.dupV2[id] | 0;
    let v1 = S.dup[id] | 0;
    while (v2 < 5 && v1 >= 5) {
      v1 -= 5;
      v2 += 1;
    }
    if (v2 < 5) return;
    v2 -= 5;
    S.dup[id] = v1;
    S.dupV2[id] = v2;
    S.tr[id] = 3;
  } else {
    return;
  }
  save();
  SFX.rare();
  openBallDetail(id);
  if (!$('#pn').hidden) renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'));
}

function buyBallDirect(id) {
  if (!B[id] || S.own.includes(id)) return;
  if (id >= 99) {
    if (S.candies < 80) return;
    S.candies -= 80;
  } else {
    if (S.coins < 120) return;
    S.coins -= 120;
  }
  S.own.push(id);
  save();
  SFX.win();
  if (!$('#pn').hidden) renderBrawlInventory($('#pb'));
}

function pull(isHalloween) {
  if (isHalloween) {
    if (S.candies < 50) return;
    S.candies -= 50;
    S.hwq.hwbox = (S.hwq.hwbox | 0) + 1;
  } else {
    if (S.coins < 100) return;
    S.coins -= 100;
    S.q.gacha++;
  }
  const w = roll(isHalloween), dup = S.own.includes(w.id);
  let dupMsg = '🎉 Nowa kula odblokowana w kolekcji!';
  if (dup) {
    const curTier = S.tr[w.id] || 1;
    if (curTier === 1) {
      S.dup[w.id] = (S.dup[w.id] | 0) + 1;
      dupMsg = `🧬 Duplikat V1! Zebrano ${S.dup[w.id]}/5 do ewolucji V2!`;
    } else if (curTier === 2) {
      S.dupV2[w.id] = (S.dupV2[w.id] | 0) + 1;
      dupMsg = `🌟 Duplikat V2! Zebrano ${S.dupV2[w.id]}/5 do ewolucji V3!`;
    } else {
      if (isHalloween) { S.candies += 25; dupMsg = 'Kulka ma już V3 MAX! Bonus +25 🍬'; }
      else { S.coins += 40; dupMsg = 'Kulka ma już V3 MAX! Bonus +40 🪙'; }
    }
  } else {
    S.own.push(w.id);
  }
  save();

  const IT = Array.from({ length: 45 }, () => roll(isHalloween));
  IT[37] = w;
  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
    <h2>${isHalloween ? '🎃 Skrzynia Halloween…' : '📦 Otwieranie skrzynki…'}</h2>
    <div class="cs">
      <i class="mk"></i>
      <div id="sp">
        ${IT.map(b => `<div class="it" style="--rc:${RC[b.r]}">${orb(b)}<small>${b.n}</small></div>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    <button class="b" onclick="skipPull()">Pomiń</button>
  `;
  const sp = $('#sp'), cw = $('.cs').clientWidth, IW = 98;
  const tg = -(37 * IW + IW / 2 - cw / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40);
  let li = -1;
  void sp.offsetWidth;
  sp.style.transition = 'transform 5.2s cubic-bezier(.12,.72,.08,1)';
  sp.style.transform = `translateX(${tg}px)`;
  const iv = setInterval(() => {
    if (!$('#sp')) return clearInterval(iv);
    const i = Math.floor((cw / 2 - new DOMMatrix(getComputedStyle(sp).transform).m41) / IW);
    if (i != li) { li = i; SFX.tick(); }
  }, 30);
  const done = () => {
    if (!$('#sp')) return;
    clearInterval(iv);
    clearTimeout(tm);
    w.r > 1 ? SFX.rare() : SFX.win();
    $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
      <div class="rev" style="--rc:${RC[w.r]}">${orb(w)}</div>
      <h2>${w.n}</h2>
      <b style="color:${RC[w.r]}">${RN[w.r]}</b>
      <p style="font-size:0.88rem;color:var(--mu);margin:8px 0">${getBallStats(w.id).activeDesc}</p>
      <p style="font-weight:800;color:#fde047;margin-bottom:12px">${dupMsg}</p>
      <div class="grid-2">
        <button class="b ac" style="padding:12px" onclick="openBallDetail(${w.id})">Pokaż w ekwipunku</button>
        <button class="b graj" style="font-size:1rem;padding:12px" onclick="$('#ov').hidden=true;panel('${isHalloween ? 'hw' : 'shop'}')">OK</button>
      </div>
    `;
  };
  const tm = setTimeout(done, 5400);
  window.skipPull = done;
}

function qp(p) {
  const rw = (q, v, dn, f, nm, cur = '🪙') => `
    <div class="cd">
      <b>${nm || q.t}</b> (${Math.min(v, q.n)}/${q.n})
      <div class="bar"><i style="width:${Math.min(v, q.n) / q.n * 100}%"></i></div>
      <button class="b ac" style="margin:6px 0 0;padding:10px" ${v < q.n || dn ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="${f}">
        ${dn ? 'Odebrano ✓' : 'Odbierz ' + q.r + ' ' + cur}
      </button>
    </div>
  `;
  p.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cd hw-card"><h2>🎃 Questy Halloween Event</h2></div>
    ${HWQ.map((q, i) => rw(q, S.hwq[q.k] | 0, S.hwq.cl.includes(i), `claimhw(${i})`, 0, '🍬')).join('')}
    <div class="cd"><h2>📜 Questy dzienne</h2></div>
    ${Q.map((q, i) => rw(q, S.q[q.k] | 0, S.q.cl.includes(i), `claim(${i})`, q.k == 'tw' ? q.t + ' (' + (B[S.q.tb] ? B[S.q.tb].n : 'Szarża') + ')' : 0)).join('')}
    <div class="cd"><h2>🏆 Questy tygodniowe</h2></div>
    ${WQ.map((q, i) => rw(q, S.wq[q.k] | 0, S.wq.cl.includes(i), `claimw(${i})`)).join('')}
  `;
}
function claim(i) { S.q.cl.push(i); S.coins += Q[i].r; save(); SFX.win(); panel('q'); }
function claimw(i) { S.wq.cl.push(i); S.coins += WQ[i].r; save(); SFX.win(); panel('q'); }
function claimhw(i) { S.hwq.cl.push(i); S.candies += HWQ[i].r; save(); SFX.win(); panel('q'); }

function prof(p) {
  const g = S.g | 0, w = S.wins | 0;
  const online = Boolean(window.BVBCloud?.isOnline);
  p.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cd">
      <h2>👤 Profil Gracza</h2>
      <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:10px 0">
        <span style="font-size:38px">${S.av || AV[0]}</span>
        <input class="inp" maxlength="16" value="${(S.nm || 'Gracz').replace(/["<>&]/g, '')}" ${online ? 'readonly title="Zmień nick w zakładce Konto"' : 'oninput="S.nm=this.value.slice(0,16);save()"'} placeholder="Twój nick..." />
      </div>
      ${online ? '<button class="b ac" onclick="panel(\'account\')">🔐 Zmień nick w Koncie</button>' : ''}
      <div style="display:flex;gap:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px">
        ${AV.map(a => `<button class="b" style="width:auto;padding:8px 12px;margin:0" onclick="S.av='${a}';save();panel('pr')">${a}</button>`).join('')}
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="cd" style="line-height:1.7;font-size:0.9rem">
      <h3>📊 Statystyki</h3>
      Rozegrane mecze: <b>${g}</b> · Wygrane: <b>${w}</b> (${g ? Math.round(w / g * 100) : 0}%)<br>
      Monety: <b>🪙 ${S.coins}</b> · Cukierki Halloween: <b>🍬 ${S.candies}</b><br>
      Odblokowane kule: <b>${S.own.length} / ${BVB_ROSTER.length}</b><br>
      Rekord Survival: <b>fala ${S.best | 0}</b><br>
      Rekord Nieskończoność: <b>fala ${S.binf | 0}</b><br>
      Pokonani Bossowie: <b>${S.bb | 0}</b><br>
      Tytuł: <b>${esc(S.playerTitle||'Brak')}</b><br>
      <button class="b" onclick="panel('ach')">🏆 Nagrody za osiągnięcia</button>
    </div>
  `;
}

function importSaveModal() {
  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
    <h2>📥 Import Zapisu Gry</h2>
    <p style="font-size:0.82rem;color:var(--mu);margin:6px 0">Wklej kod zapisu wygenerowany w oknie Eksportu:</p>
    <textarea class="inp" id="impArea" rows="4" placeholder="Wklej kod tutaj..."></textarea>
    <p id="impErr" style="color:#f87171;font-size:0.8rem;min-height:18px"></p>
    <div class="grid-2" style="margin-top:8px">
      <button class="b graj" style="font-size:0.9rem;padding:11px" onclick="doImportSave()">Wczytaj zapis</button>
      <button class="b" style="padding:11px" onclick="$('#ov').hidden=true">Anuluj</button>
    </div>
  `;
}

function doImportSave() {
  try {
    const raw = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(($('#impArea').value || '').trim()))));
    if (!raw || typeof raw !== 'object' || !Array.isArray(raw.own)) throw new Error('Invalid');
    localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(raw));
    load();
    $('#ov').hidden = true;
    panel('set');
  } catch (e) {
    const err = $('#impErr');
    if (err) err.textContent = '❌ Nieprawidłowy kod zapisu.';
  }
}

function askResetProgress() {
  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
    <h2>Skasować cały postęp?</h2>
    <p style="color:var(--mu);font-size:0.86rem;margin:10px 0 16px">Wrócisz do stanu początkowego (100 🪙, 50 🍬 oraz 3 startowe kulki: Szarża, Topór i Trujący kolec).</p>
    <div class="grid-2">
      <button class="b" onclick="$('#ov').hidden=true">Anuluj</button>
      <button class="b" style="background:#dc2626;border-color:#f87171" onclick="localStorage.removeItem(K);location.reload()">Tak, resetuj</button>
    </div>
  `;
}

function stp(p) {
  p.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cd">
      <h2>🛒 Sklep Kosmetyczny</h2>
      <small style="color:var(--mu)">Kupuj ślady, obwódki i efekty zwycięstwa za monety (masz 🪙 ${S.coins}).</small>
    </div>
    ${CAT.map(([k, n, L]) => `
      <div class="cd">
        <h3>${n}</h3>
        ${L.map((it, i) => {
          const own = S.sh[k].includes(i), eq = S.eq[k] == i;
          return `
            <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin:8px 0;padding:8px;background:var(--cd-dark);border-radius:12px">
              <span><b>${it.n}</b> ${own ? '' : '· ' + it.p + ' 🪙'}</span>
              <button class="b ${eq ? 'ac' : ''}" style="width:auto;padding:8px 14px;margin:0;font-size:0.8rem" ${!own && S.coins < it.p ? 'disabled' : ''} onclick="buyCosmetic('${k}',${i})">
                ${eq ? 'Założone' : own ? 'Załóż' : 'Kup'}
              </button>
            </div>
          `;
        }).join('')}
      </div>
    `).join('')}
  `;
}

function buyCosmetic(k, i) {
  const cat = CAT.find(c => c[0] == k);
  const it = cat && cat[2][i];
  if (!it) return;
  if (!S.sh[k].includes(i)) {
    if (S.coins < it.p) return;
    S.coins -= it.p;
    S.sh[k].push(i);
  }
  S.eq[k] = i;
  save();
  SFX.win();
  panel('st');
}

function bpp(p) {
  const t = Math.floor(S.bp.p / 100);
  p.innerHTML = `
    <div class="cd hw-card">
      <h2>🌙 Sezon Halloween</h2>
      <p>Poziom <b>${Math.min(t, 20)} / 20</b> · (${S.bp.p % 100}/100 pkt)</p>
      <div class="bar"><i style="width:${S.bp.p % 100}%"></i></div>
      <small style="color:#fed7aa">Za każdy mecz zdobywasz punkty sezonowe!</small>
    </div>
    ${BPR.map((r, i) => `
      <div class="cd" style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center">
        <span>Poziom ${i + 1}: <b>🪙 +${r.c} monet</b></span>
        <button class="b ${t > i && !S.bp.cl.includes(i) ? 'ac' : ''}" style="width:auto;padding:8px 14px;margin:0" ${t > i && !S.bp.cl.includes(i) ? '' : 'disabled'} onclick="claimBp(${i})">
          ${S.bp.cl.includes(i) ? 'Odebrano ✓' : 'Odbierz'}
        </button>
      </div>
    `).join('')}
  `;
}

function claimBp(i) {
  if (!Number.isInteger(i) || !BPR[i]) return;
  const t = Math.floor(S.bp.p / 100);
  if (t <= i || S.bp.cl.includes(i)) return;
  S.bp.cl.push(i);
  S.coins += BPR[i].c;
  save();
  SFX.win();
  panel('bp');
}

const orbHTML = b => `<span class="orb" style="--oc:${b.c};--rc:${RC[b.r]};width:56px;height:56px">${art(b.id)}</span>`;

function preloadArt() {
  for (let i = 0; i < B.length; i++) {
    if(!B[i])continue;
    const im = new Image();
    im.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(art(i));
    ART_IMAGES.set(i, im);
  }
}

function refreshPeriods() {
  const day = new Date().toDateString(), wk = Math.floor(Date.now() / 6048e5);
  if (S.q.d !== day) S.q = { d: day, play: 0, win: 0, gacha: 0, bn: 0, rare: 0, tw: 0, cl: [], tb: rnd(S.own) };
  if (S.wq.k !== wk) S.wq = { k: wk, win: 0, play: 0, boss: 0, cl: [] };
}

// ───────────────────────── Arena physics & rendering ─────────────────────────
function obstacleKinds(arena) {
  return arena===0?['pumpkin','coffin','tomb']:arena===1?['asteroid','planet']:arena===2?['rock','basalt']:arena===3?['iceberg','crystal']:arena===4?['coral','shell']:['neon','hologram'];
}
function randomEmptyPoint(items, margin=63) {
  for(let j=0;j<100;j++) {
    const x=margin+Math.random()*(360-margin*2), y=95+Math.random()*170;
    // Safe from two spawn positions, and from other obstacles/portal destinations.
    if(Math.hypot(x-180,y-300)<64 || Math.hypot(x-180,y-60)<64) continue;
    if(items.every(p=>Math.hypot(x-p.x,y-p.y)>(p.r||18)+37)) return {x,y};
  }
  return {x:55+Math.random()*250,y:125+Math.random()*110};
}
function createRoundArena(g) {
  const cfg=settingsForArena(g.th), kinds=obstacleKinds(g.th);
  g.obstacles=[];g.portal=null;g.arenaFxTime=0;
  if(cfg.obstacles) {
    const count=clamp(Number(cfg.count)||3,2,5);
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++) {
      const point=randomEmptyPoint(g.obstacles), kind=kinds[i%kinds.length];
      const r=kind==='coffin'?21:kind==='tomb'?20:kind==='asteroid'?20:18;
      g.obstacles.push({...point,r,kind,moving:g.th===0,
        moveClock:3+Math.random()*6, moveDuration:0, dx:0,dy:0, seed:Math.random()*6.28});
    }
  }
  if(Math.random()<0.38) {
    const at=randomEmptyPoint(g.obstacles);
    g.portal={...at,r:21,seed:Math.random()*6.28};
  }
}
function obstacleSpark(x,y) {
  if(!G || !settingsForArena(G.th).fx) return;
  G.fx ||= [];
  for(let i=0;i<5;i++) {
    if(G.fx.length>140)break;
    const a=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
    G.fx.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(a)*(20+Math.random()*65),vy:Math.sin(a)*(20+Math.random()*65),r:1.2+Math.random()*1.8,c:'#fcd34d',life:.3,max:.3});
  }
}
function portalVisual(o,x,y) {
  if(!settingsForArena(G.th).fx)return;
  G.rings ||= [];
  G.rings.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,age:0,life:.55,radius:14,c:'#7c3aed'});
  G.rings.push({x,y,age:0,life:.55,radius:11,c:'#a78bfa'});
  obstacleSpark(x,y);
}
function moveArena(dt) {
  if(!G)return;
  G.arenaFxTime=(G.arenaFxTime||0)+dt;
  for(const p of G.obstacles||[]) {
    if(!p.moving)continue;
    if(p.moveDuration>0) {
      const dx=p.dx*dt,dy=p.dy*dt;
      p.x=clamp(p.x+dx,35,325);p.y=clamp(p.y+dy,102,258);
      p.moveDuration-=dt;
    } else {
      p.moveClock-=dt;
      if(p.moveClock<=0) {
        const kind=p.kind;
        const gap=kind==='pumpkin'?5+Math.random()*5:kind==='coffin'?9+Math.random()*7:12+Math.random()*7;
        p.moveClock=gap;
        p.moveDuration=.45+Math.random()*.5;
        const ang=Math.random()*Math.PI*2;
        p.dx=Math.cos(ang)*(22+Math.random()*22);
        p.dy=Math.sin(ang)*(22+Math.random()*22);
      }
    }
  }
}
function collideWithArena(o,dt) {
  o.portalCooldown=Math.max(0,(o.portalCooldown||0)-dt);
  o.obstacleCooldown=Math.max(0,(o.obstacleCooldown||0)-dt);
  for(const p of G.obstacles||[]) {
    const dx=o.x-p.x,dy=o.y-p.y;
    const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy), minDist=o.r+p.r;
    if(dist>=minDist)continue;
    const nx=dist>0.001?dx/dist:1, ny=dist>0.001?dy/dist:0;
    o.x=p.x+nx*(minDist+0.5);o.y=p.y+ny*(minDist+0.5);
    const inward=o.vx*nx+o.vy*ny;
    if(inward<0){o.vx-=2*inward*nx;o.vy-=2*inward*ny;}
    o.x=clamp(o.x,o.r,360-o.r);o.y=clamp(o.y,o.r,360-o.r);
    if(o.obstacleCooldown<=0){
      obstacleSpark(o.x-nx*o.r,o.y-ny*o.r);
      o.obstacleCooldown=.20;
      if(netRole!=='guest') {S.ach.bounces++;S.q.bn=(S.q.bn||0)+1;checkAchievements();}
    }
  }
  const portal=G.portal;
  if(portal && o.portalCooldown<=0 && Math.hypot(o.x-portal.x,o.y-portal.y)<o.r+portal.r-5) {
    const destination=randomEmptyPoint([...(G.obstacles||[]),portal,...G.bl.filter(t=>t!==o)] , 40);
    o.x=destination.x;o.y=destination.y;
    window.BVBCampaign?.onPortal?.(G,o);
    o.portalCooldown=2+Math.random()*3;
    portalVisual(portal,o.x,o.y);
    if(netRole!=='guest') {S.ach.portals++;checkAchievements();}
  }
}

    for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const x=i*43;cx.globalAlpha=.52;cx.fillStyle='#170e34';cx.fillRect(x,165+(i%4)*20,31,195);cx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#2dd4bf':'#f472b6';cx.lineWidth=2;cx.strokeRect(x+2,175+(i%4)*20,27,15);}
    if(fx)for(let i=0;i<13;i++){const x=decorPoint(i).x;cx.globalAlpha=.12+(.08*Math.sin(t*2+i));cx.fillStyle=i%2?'#22d3ee':'#f472b6';cx.fillRect(x,0,2,360);}
  }
  cx.restore();
  if(G.rare==='night'){cx.fillStyle='#03010b88';cx.fillRect(0,0,360,360);}
  if(G.rare==='fx' && fx){for(let i=0;i<12;i++){const q=decorPoint(i,11),a=(Math.sin(t*2+i)+1)/2;cx.fillStyle=ar.ac;cx.globalAlpha=.12+.33*a;cx.beginPath();cx.arc(q.x,q.y,2+i%3,0,7);cx.fill();}cx.globalAlpha=1;}
  cx.save();cx.strokeStyle=ar.ac;cx.globalAlpha=.45;cx.lineWidth=3;cx.strokeRect(2,2,356,356);cx.restore();
  cx.save();cx.font='bold 12px Segoe UI, sans-serif';cx.fillStyle='#e2e8f0';cx.globalAlpha=.8;cx.fillText(ar.name+(G.rare==='night'?' 🌙':G.rare==='fx'?' ✨':''),12,20);cx.restore();
}
function drawArenaItems() {
  const ar=ARENAS[G.th]||ARENAS[0],t=(G.arenaFxTime||0);
  for(const p of G.obstacles||[]) {
    cx.save();cx.translate(p.x,p.y);
    cx.shadowColor=ar.ac;cx.shadowBlur=6;
    if(p.kind==='pumpkin') {cx.fillStyle='#ea580c';cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(0,2,18,16,0,0,7);cx.fill();cx.fillStyle='#166534';cx.fillRect(-3,-20,6,9);cx.fillStyle='#24100c';cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(-10,-2);cx.lineTo(-4,-9);cx.lineTo(-1,-1);cx.moveTo(3,-2);cx.lineTo(9,-9);cx.lineTo(12,-2);cx.fill();cx.fillRect(-5,7,11,3);}
    else if(p.kind==='coffin'||p.kind==='tomb'){cx.fillStyle=p.kind==='coffin'?'#71472d':'#737381';cx.strokeStyle='#ddd6fe';cx.lineWidth=2;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(-13,-15);cx.lineTo(13,-15);cx.lineTo(20,-7);cx.lineTo(14,17);cx.lineTo(-14,17);cx.lineTo(-20,-7);cx.closePath();cx.fill();cx.stroke();cx.strokeStyle='#e5e7eb';cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,-10);cx.lineTo(0,11);cx.moveTo(-7,-2);cx.lineTo(7,-2);cx.stroke();}
    else if(p.kind==='rock'||p.kind==='basalt'||p.kind==='asteroid'){cx.fillStyle=p.kind==='asteroid'?'#64748b':'#7c3423';cx.beginPath();for(let i=0;i<7;i++){const a=i*2*Math.PI/7;const r=p.r*(i%2?.78:1);i?cx.lineTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r):cx.moveTo(Math.cos(a)*r,Math.sin(a)*r);}cx.closePath();cx.fill();}
    else if(p.kind==='planet'){cx.fillStyle='#7c83d8';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(0,0,p.r,0,7);cx.fill();cx.strokeStyle='#a5b4fc';cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(0,0,26,7,.4,0,7);cx.stroke();}
    else if(p.kind==='iceberg'||p.kind==='crystal'){cx.fillStyle='#90dff7';cx.strokeStyle='#e0f2fe';cx.lineWidth=2;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,-21);cx.lineTo(18,10);cx.lineTo(9,18);cx.lineTo(-14,18);cx.lineTo(-20,5);cx.closePath();cx.fill();cx.stroke();}
    else if(p.kind==='coral'||p.kind==='shell'){cx.strokeStyle='#5eead4';cx.lineWidth=5;for(let i=-1;i<=1;i++){cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(0,16);cx.lineTo(i*8,-4);cx.lineTo(i*12,-16);cx.stroke();}}
    else {cx.strokeStyle=p.kind==='neon'?'#22d3ee':'#f472b6';cx.lineWidth=4;cx.strokeRect(-16,-16,32,32);cx.fillStyle='#4c1d95';cx.globalAlpha=.5;cx.fillRect(-13,-13,26,26);}
    cx.restore();
  }
  if(G.portal){const p=G.portal;cx.save();cx.translate(p.x,p.y);const rot=t*1.7+p.seed;cx.shadowColor='#7c3aed';cx.shadowBlur=18;for(let i=0;i<3;i++){cx.strokeStyle=['#8b5cf6','#a78bfa','#c084fc'][i];cx.lineWidth=4-i;cx.beginPath();cx.ellipse(0,0,13+i*4,9+i*3,rot+i*2,0,7);cx.stroke();}cx.fillStyle='#03000a';cx.beginPath();cx.arc(0,0,12,0,7);cx.fill();cx.restore();}
}
function computeBotAim(bx, by, px, py, pvx, pvy, dLevel) {
  const leadTime = 0.35 + dLevel * 0.18;
  let predX = px + pvx * 112 * leadTime;
  let predY = py + pvy * 112 * leadTime;
  if (predX < 20) predX = 40 - predX;
  if (predX > W - 20) predX = 2 * (W - 20) - predX;
  if (predY < 20) predY = 40 - predY;
  if (predY > W - 20) predY = 2 * (W - 20) - predY;

  const chosen = Math.atan2(predY - by, predX - bx);
  const jitter = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * ERR[clamp(dLevel, 0, 4)];
  return chosen + jitter;
}

function actor(b, x, y, a, own, team = own, customTier, customDmgLv, customHpLv) {
  const st = getBallStats(b.id, customTier, customDmgLv, customHpLv);
  return {
    uid: ++serial,
    b: { ...b },
    x, y, own, team,
    r: b.isBoss ? 24 : 17,
    tier: st.tier,
    hp: b.isBoss ? Math.round(st.hp * (b.bossHpMult || 1.65)) : st.hp,
    mh: b.isBoss ? Math.round(st.hp * (b.bossHpMult || 1.65)) : st.hp,
    baseDmg: b.isBoss ? Math.round(st.dmg * (b.bossDmgMult || 1.15)) : st.dmg,
    power: 1.0,
    vx: Math.cos(a),
    vy: Math.sin(a),
    cd: 1.15,
    abilityCd: 0.6 + (st.cd || 0),
    contact: 0,
    t: 0,
    trail: [],
    trailClock: 0,
    status: {}
  };
}

const alive = o => o && o.hp > 0 && !o.gone;

function freshGame(mode, my, bt) {
  return {
    m: mode, my, bt,
    sv: [1, 3, 7, 10].includes(mode),
    w: 1,
    h: [3, 3],
    ph: 'draft',
    pa: -Math.PI / 2,
    bl: [], pr: [], z: [], events: [], fx: [], rings: [], pop: [],
    rt: 0, th: chooseArena(), rare: (Math.random()<RARE_CHANCE ? (Math.random()<.5?'night':'fx') : ''),
    obstacles:[], portal:null, arenaFxTime:0,
    matchId: crypto.randomUUID ? crypto.randomUUID() : String(Date.now()),
    dn: 1, score: [0, 0], bossIndex: 0, rn: 0
  };
}

function startMatch(mode = 0) {
  if(Number(mode)===12)return false; // Online mode is not part of the test beta.
  if (netRole === 'guest' && activeConn) { netStatus('Host rozpoczyna mecz. Poczekaj na synchronizację.'); return; }
  $('#ov').hidden = true;
  refreshPeriods();
  const own = B.filter(b => S.own.includes(b.id));
  const myThree = mode === 4 ? BVB_ROSTER : (own.length >= 3 ? sh(own).slice(0, 3) : [B[0], B[1], B[2]]);
  if (mode === 12 && (!activeConn?.open || netRole !== 'host' || !guestOnlineDeck)) {
    netStatus('Poczekaj na połączenie i kolekcję znajomego.'); return;
  }
  const botThree = mode === 12 ? guestOnlineDeck.slice() :
    (mode == 9 || mode == 10) ? [B[0], ...sh(BVB_ROSTER).slice(0, 2)] : sh(B.filter(b => b.id < 99)).slice(0, 3);
  if (mode === 11) botThree[0] = { ...B[0], ...BOSSD[pendingBossIndex], isBoss: true };
  const previousArena = G?.finished ? G.th : null;
  G = freshGame(mode, myThree, botThree);
  window.BVBGameplay?.newMatch?.(G);
  window.BVBCampaign?.prepareMatch?.(G);
  arenaTransition(G.th, previousArena);
  if (mode === 11) G.bossIndex = pendingBossIndex;
  show('game');
  nextRound();
}

function nextRound() {
  if (!G) return;
  if (window.BVBCampaign?.intermission?.(G)) return;
  G.ph = 'draft';
  G.rn = (G.rn || 0) + 1;
  G.bl = []; G.pr = []; G.z = []; G.fx = []; G.rings = []; G.pop = [];
  G.v2 = null; // Round-based hazards and Spider webs expire only at round boundary.
  createRoundArena(G);
  window.BVBGameplay?.newRound?.(G);
  window.BVBCampaign?.setupRound?.(G);
  remoteAimAngle = null; hostAimAngle = null; remoteBallId = null;
  renderDraft();
  hearts();
  broadcastState();
}

function renderDraft() {
  if (!G) return;
  $('#msg').textContent = G.m===13 ? 'Kampania '+G.campaignLevel+'/50: wybierz kulkę ze swojej drużyny, wyceluj i wystrzel!' : 'Wybierz jedną z 3 wylosowanych kulek, wyceluj procą i wystrzel:';
  $('#cards').innerHTML = G.my.map((b, i) => {
    const st = G.m === 12 ? getBallStats(b.id, 1, 0, 0) : getBallStats(b.id);
    return `<button class="card" style="--rc:${RC[b.r]}" onclick="pick(${i})">
      ${orb(b)}
      <div>
        <b>${esc(b.n)} · <span style="color:#fde047">V${st.tier}</span></b>
        <small style="color:#cbd5e1;display:block">❤️ ${st.hp} HP · ⚔️ ${st.dmg} DMG</small>
        <span class="d">${st.activeDesc}</span>
        ${window.BVBGameplay?.badge?.(b.id) || ''}
      </div>
    </button>`;
  }).join('');
  $('#bset').innerHTML = `<b>${G.m === 13 ? '🗺️ Poziom '+G.campaignLevel+'/50 · Rywal:' : G.m === 12 ? '🌐 Kule rywala:' : '🤖 Kule Bota:'}</b>` + G.bt.map(b => `<span class="bs">${orb(b)}<small>${esc(b.n)}</small></span>`).join('');
}

function pick(i) {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'draft' || !G.my[i] || (netRole === 'guest' && guestBallId != null)) return;
  G.pb = G.my[i];
  if (netRole === 'guest' && activeConn) {
    guestBallId = G.pb.id;
    G.bb = G.bt?.[0] || B[0];
    G.ph = 'aim';
    netSend({ type: 'pick', id: G.pb.id, matchId: G.matchId, rn: G.rn });
  } else {
    G.bb = G.m===13 ? G.bt[0] : G.m === 11 ? { ...B[0], ...BOSSD[G.bossIndex || 0], isBoss: true } : ((G.m == 9 || G.m == 10) ? B[0] : (remoteBallId || rnd(G.bt)));
    G.ph = 'aim';
    broadcastState();
  }
  $('#cards').innerHTML = '';
  $('#fire').hidden = netRole === 'guest' && activeConn && !G.bb;
  $('#fire').disabled = false;
  $('#msg').textContent = `${G.m === 11 ? '👹 Boss: ' : 'Przeciwnik wybrał: '}${G.bb.n}. Naciągnij procą na arenie i kliknij WYSTRZEL!`;
}

function fire() {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'aim' || !Number.isFinite(G.pa)) return;
  if (netRole === 'guest' && activeConn) {
    guestAimSent = true;
    guestAimAngle = G.pa;
    window.BVBGameplay?.resendTactic?.();
    netSend({ type: 'fire', angle: G.pa, matchId: G.matchId, rn: G.rn });
    $('#fire').disabled = true;
    $('#msg').textContent = 'Wysłano strzał. Oczekiwanie na ruch drugiego gracza…';
    return;
  }
  if (netRole === 'host' && activeConn) {
    hostAimAngle = G.pa;
    if (remoteAimAngle == null || remoteBallId == null) {
      $('#fire').disabled = true;
      $('#msg').textContent = 'Twój strzał gotowy — czekam na strzał drugiego gracza…';
      return;
    }
    launchMatch(remoteAimAngle);
    return;
  }
  launchMatch(null);
}
function launchMatch(remoteAngle = null) {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'aim') return;
  const p = G.m === 12 ? actor(G.pb, 180, 300, G.pa, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0) : actor(G.pb, 180, 300, G.pa, 0, 0);
  const botAim = remoteAngle == null
    ? computeBotAim(180, 60, 180, 300, Math.cos(G.pa), Math.sin(G.pa), diff)
    : remoteAngle;
  const enemyBall = G.m === 11 ? { ...B[0], ...BOSSD[G.bossIndex || 0], isBoss: true } : G.bb;
  // The guest sees the same X axis and a mirrored Y axis: flip only the Y component.
  const enemyAngle = remoteAngle == null ? botAim : -remoteAngle;
  // Standard bot difficulty is one profile, not hidden V2 + upgrades + random boosts.
  const normalBot = G.m === 0;
  const difficulty = clamp(diff, 0, 4);
  const botTier = normalBot ? [1,1,2,3,3][difficulty] : G.m === 12 ? 1 : G.m === 11 ? 3 : 2;
  const botLevel = normalBot ? [0,0,1,2,4][difficulty] : G.m === 12 ? 0 : diff;
  const e = actor(enemyBall, 180, 60, enemyAngle, 1, 1, botTier, botLevel, botLevel);
  window.BVBGameplay?.prepareActors?.(G, p, e);
  if(normalBot){
    const hpScale=[.88,1,1.08,1.15,1.25][difficulty];
    const dmgScale=[.86,1,1.08,1.15,1.25][difficulty];
    e.hp=Math.round(e.hp*hpScale);e.mh=e.hp;
    e.baseDmg=Math.round(e.baseDmg*dmgScale*100)/100;
  }
  window.BVBCampaign?.applyActors?.(G,p,e);
  window.BVB2?.prepareActors?.(G,p,e);
  G.bl = [p, e];
  G.ph = 'battle';
  G.rt = 0;
  G.silence = 0; G.silenceBoost = 0; G.silenceBoostFading = false; G.hitStop = 0;
  $('#fire').hidden = true;
  $('#msg').textContent = '⚔️ Walka trwa!';
  SFX.shot();
  hearts();
  broadcastState();
}

let cv = $('#cv'), cx = cv.getContext('2d');
cv.width = cv.height = W * D;
cx.setTransform(D, 0, 0, D, 0, 0);

function aimEv(e) {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'aim') return;
  const r = cv.getBoundingClientRect();
  const x = (e.clientX - r.left) * 360 / r.width;
  const y = (e.clientY - r.top) * 360 / r.height;
  if (e.type === 'pointerdown') {
    G.ds = { x, y };
    return;
  }
  if (!G.ds) return;
  const dx = G.ds.x - x, dy = G.ds.y - y;
  G.pa = Math.hypot(dx, dy) < 8 ? -Math.PI / 2 : Math.atan2(dy, dx);
  if (netRole === 'guest' && activeConn) guestAimAngle = G.pa;
  $('#fire').disabled = netRole === 'guest' && guestAimSent;
}
cv.addEventListener('pointerdown', aimEv);
cv.addEventListener('pointermove', e => { if (e.buttons || e.pointerType === 'touch') aimEv(e); });

// Wyraźne, tematyczne efekty specjalne kulek (również kulek Halloween).
const EFFECTS = {
  fire: { color: '#fb923c', accent: '#facc15', text: '🔥 PODPALENIE' },
  ice: { color: '#67e8f9', accent: '#e0f2fe', text: '❄️ ZAMROŻENIE' },
  electric: { color: '#facc15', accent: '#ffffff', text: '⚡ PORAŻENIE' },
  shadow: { color: '#a78bfa', accent: '#e879f9', text: '🌑 WYSYSANIE' },
  poison: { color: '#a3e635', accent: '#22c55e', text: '☠️ TRUCIZNA' },
  heal: { color: '#4ade80', accent: '#bbf7d0', text: '💚 REGENERACJA' },
  shield: { color: '#38bdf8', accent: '#a5f3fc', text: '🛡️ OSŁONA' },
  blast: { color: '#fb7185', accent: '#fdba74', text: '💥 WYBUCH' },
  normal: { color: '#f8fafc', accent: '#93c5fd', text: '✨ MOC' }
};
function effectType(b) {
  const d = `${b?.n || ''} ${b?.d || ''}`.toLowerCase();
  if (/leczy|leczenie|regener|medyk|heal/.test(d)) return 'heal';
  if (/tarcza|pancerz|bariera|osłona/.test(d)) return 'shield';
  if (/lód|lodow|mroź|mróz|zamraża|zamroż|frost|freeze|śnieg/.test(d)) return 'ice';
  if (/piorun|błyskawic|elektry|laser|plazma|prąd/.test(d)) return 'electric';
  if (/ogień|płom|płon|podpal|lawa|magma|wulkan|meteor|dyni|ognik|erupcj/.test(d)) return 'fire';
  if (/truciz|zatru|poison|toksy|jadow|kwas|wirus/.test(d)) return 'poison';
  if (/wysysa|wampir|lifesteal|dusza|duch|mrok|cień|shadow|kląt|nekroman|żniwiarz/.test(d)) return 'shadow';
  if (/wybuch|eksploz|bomba|bomb|fala uderzeniowa/.test(d)) return 'blast';
  return 'normal';
}
function burst(o, kind, n = 12, label = true) {
  if (!G || !o) return;
  const e = EFFECTS[kind] || EFFECTS.normal;
  G.fx ||= []; G.rings ||= []; G.pop ||= [];
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    const a = Math.PI * 2 * i / n + Math.random() * 0.45, sp = 18 + Math.random() * 63;
    G.fx.push({ x: o.x, y: o.y, vx: Math.cos(a) * sp, vy: Math.sin(a) * sp,
      r: 1.7 + Math.random() * 2.7, life: 0.38 + Math.random() * 0.35, max: 0.75,
      c: i % 3 ? e.color : e.accent });
  }
  G.rings.push({ x: o.x, y: o.y, age: 0, life: 0.45, c: e.color, radius: o.r + 3 });
  if (label) G.pop.push({ x: o.x, y: Math.max(24, o.y - o.r - 19), age: 0, life: 0.9, text: e.text, c: e.accent });
  if (G.fx.length > 120) G.fx.splice(0, G.fx.length - 120);
  if (G.rings.length > 16) G.rings.splice(0, G.rings.length - 16);
  if (G.pop.length > 12) G.pop.splice(0, G.pop.length - 12);
}
function specialAbility(o, foe) {
  const kind = effectType(o.b);
  if (!foe) return;
  switch (kind) {
    case 'fire':
      foe.status.burn = Math.max(foe.status.burn || 0, 2.2);
      burst(foe, kind, 14); break;
    case 'ice':
      foe.status.slow = Math.max(foe.status.slow || 0, 1.35);
      burst(foe, kind, 13); break;
    case 'electric':
      foe.hp -= Math.max(1, o.baseDmg * 0.28);
      foe.status.stun = Math.max(foe.status.stun || 0, 0.35);
      burst(foe, kind, 16); break;
    case 'shadow': {
      const damage = Math.min(5, Math.max(1, foe.hp * 0.045));
      foe.hp -= damage; o.hp = Math.min(o.mh, o.hp + damage);
      burst(foe, kind, 12); break;
    }
    case 'poison':
      foe.status.poison = Math.max(foe.status.poison || 0, 3.0);
      burst(foe, kind, 10); break;
    case 'heal':
      o.hp = Math.min(o.mh, o.hp + 5);
      burst(o, kind, 10); break;
    case 'shield':
      o.status.shield = Math.min(30, (o.status.shield || 0) + 11);
      burst(o, kind, 10); break;
    case 'blast':
      foe.hp -= Math.max(2, o.baseDmg * 0.5);
      burst(foe, kind, 18); break;
    default:
      // Pozostałe kulki również mają widoczne efekty aktywacji.
      foe.hp -= Math.max(1, o.baseDmg * 0.13);
      burst(o, kind, 8, false);
  }
}
function applyDamage(target, damage) {
  const blocked = Math.min(target.status.shield || 0, damage);
  target.status.shield = Math.max(0, (target.status.shield || 0) - blocked);
  target.hp -= damage - blocked;
}
function updateEffects(dt) {
  for (const f of G.fx || []) { f.life -= dt; f.x += f.vx * dt; f.y += f.vy * dt; f.vx *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 1.7); f.vy *= Math.max(0, 1 - dt * 1.7); }
  G.fx = (G.fx || []).filter(f => f.life > 0);
  for (const r of G.rings || []) r.age += dt;
  G.rings = (G.rings || []).filter(r => r.age < r.life);
  for (const p of G.pop || []) { p.age += dt; p.y -= dt * 14; }
  G.pop = (G.pop || []).filter(p => p.age < p.life);
}

function foeAliveForStatus(actorObj, actors) { return actors.some(t => t !== actorObj && alive(t)); }

function step(dt) {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'battle') return;
  if (G.hitStop > 0) { G.hitStop = Math.max(0, G.hitStop - dt); updateEffects(dt); return; }
  G.rt += dt;
  // +20% at round start; +5% every five seconds, up to +50%.
  // After five seconds without contact an extra +10% smoothly fades on the next hit.
  const previousGap = G.silence || 0;
  G.silence = (G.silence || 0) + dt;
  if (G.silence >= 5 && previousGap < 5) G.silenceBoost = .10;
  if (G.silenceBoostFading) {
    G.silenceBoost = Math.max(0, (G.silenceBoost || 0) - .1 * dt / 2);
    if (!G.silenceBoost) G.silenceBoostFading = false;
  }
  G.speedRamp = Math.min(.5, Math.floor(G.rt / 5) * .05);
  moveArena(dt);
  for (const o of G.bl) {
    if (!alive(o)) continue;
    o.contact = Math.max(0,(o.contact||0)-dt);
    o.impactSlow = Math.max(0,(o.impactSlow||0)-dt);
    const basePace = 1.2 + (G.speedRamp||0) + (G.silenceBoost||0) + (o.hp/o.mh < .15 ? .15 : 0);
    // Chronos slows movement, skill timers and the actor's animation clock.
    const ownTimeScale = (o.bvb5264SlowUntil||0)>G.rt ? .25 : 1;
    o.bvb5264AnimClock=(o.bvb5264AnimClock||0)+dt*ownTimeScale;
    const speedBoost = (G.m === 11 ? 1.08 : 1.15) * (o.speedFactor||1) *
      basePace * (o.status.stun > 0 ? 0 : o.status.slow > 0 ? .55 : 1) *
      ownTimeScale * (o.impactSlow > 0 ? .83 : 1);
    o.actualPace = speedBoost;
    o.x += o.vx * 110 * speedBoost * dt;
    o.y += o.vy * 110 * speedBoost * dt;
    o.trailClock = (o.trailClock || 0) + dt;
    if (o.trailClock >= 0.075) {
      o.trailClock = 0;
      o.trail.push({ x: o.x, y: o.y });
      if (o.trail.length > 9) o.trail.shift();
    }
    o.abilityCd -= dt*ownTimeScale;
    if (o.abilityCd <= 0 && !(o.status.stun > 0)) {
      const foe = G.bl.find(t => t !== o && alive(t));
      specialAbility(o, foe);
      window.BVBCampaign?.onAbility?.(G,o);
      o.abilityCd = window.BVB2?.cooldown?.(o) ?? Math.max(1.0, ((o.b.isBoss ? 2.0 : 3.4) - (o.tier - 1) * 0.6) * (o.abilityRate||1));
    }
    if (o.status.slow > 0) o.status.slow = Math.max(0, o.status.slow - dt);
    if (o.status.stun > 0) o.status.stun = Math.max(0, o.status.stun - dt);
    // Obrażenia od trucizny i ognia otrzymuje zatruty/podpalony, nie jego rywal.
    if (o.status.poison > 0) { o.status.poison = Math.max(0, o.status.poison - dt); applyDamage(o, 2.6 * dt); }
    if (o.status.burn > 0) { o.status.burn = Math.max(0, o.status.burn - dt); applyDamage(o, 3.5 * dt); }

    if (o.x < o.r || o.x > W - o.r) {
      o.vx *= -1; o.x = clamp(o.x, o.r, W - o.r);
      const delta=(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(1+Math.random()*2)*Math.PI/180;
      const vx=o.vx,vy=o.vy;o.vx=vx*Math.cos(delta)-vy*Math.sin(delta);o.vy=vx*Math.sin(delta)+vy*Math.cos(delta);
    }
    if (o.y < o.r || o.y > W - o.r) {
      o.vy *= -1; o.y = clamp(o.y, o.r, W - o.r);
      const delta=(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(1+Math.random()*2)*Math.PI/180;
      const vx=o.vx,vy=o.vy;o.vx=vx*Math.cos(delta)-vy*Math.sin(delta);o.vy=vx*Math.sin(delta)+vy*Math.cos(delta);
    }
    collideWithArena(o, dt);
  }
  if (G.bl.length === 2) {
    const [a, b] = G.bl;
    if (alive(a) && alive(b)) {
      const dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      const minDist=a.r+b.r;
      if (dist < minDist) {
        // Separate overlapping balls before dealing damage; never hit every frame.
        const nx=dist>0.001?dx/dist:1,ny=dist>0.001?dy/dist:0;
        const penetration=minDist-dist+.75;
        a.x=clamp(a.x+nx*penetration*.5,a.r,W-a.r);
        a.y=clamp(a.y+ny*penetration*.5,a.r,W-a.r);
        b.x=clamp(b.x-nx*penetration*.5,b.r,W-b.r);
        b.y=clamp(b.y-ny*penetration*.5,b.r,W-b.r);
        if (a.contact<=0 && b.contact<=0) {
          a.contact=b.contact=.30;
          G.silence = 0; G.silenceBoostFading = true;
          const overtime=G.rt>=30?1.10:1;
          const momentumA=1 + Math.min(.10,Math.max(0,(b.actualPace||1.2)-1.2)*.12);
          const momentumB=1 + Math.min(.10,Math.max(0,(a.actualPace||1.2)-1.2)*.12);
          const damageToA=window.BVB2?.onContact?.(G,b,a,Math.max(3,b.baseDmg*(b.power||1)*overtime*momentumA*(b.status.weaken>0?.8:1)))??3;
          const damageToB=window.BVB2?.onContact?.(G,a,b,Math.max(3,a.baseDmg*(a.power||1)*overtime*momentumB*(a.status.weaken>0?.8:1)))??3;
          const heavyImpact=Math.random()<.075; // Rare cinematic collisions: ~7.5%.
          if(heavyImpact) {
            G.hitStop=.075;
            G.rings ||= [];
            G.rings.push({x:(a.x+b.x)/2,y:(a.y+b.y)/2,age:0,life:.7,radius:28,c:'#fff'});
            G.pop ||= [];
            G.pop.push({x:(a.x+b.x)/2,y:(a.y+b.y)/2-30,age:0,life:.85,text:'POWER CLASH!',c:'#facc15'});
          }
          const hitSlow = Math.min(.23,.065+Math.max(damageToA,damageToB)*.004);
          a.impactSlow = b.impactSlow = hitSlow;
          applyDamage(a,damageToA*(1+Math.min(.35,(b.skillCharge||0)*.07+(b.skillImpact||0)*.15)));
          applyDamage(b,damageToB*(1+Math.min(.35,(a.skillCharge||0)*.07+(a.skillImpact||0)*.15)));
          a.skillCharge=b.skillCharge=0;
          if(a.skillReflect>0)applyDamage(b,Math.min(3,damageToA*.2));
          if(b.skillReflect>0)applyDamage(a,Math.min(3,damageToB*.2));
          window.BVBCampaign?.onImpact?.(G);
          burst(a,effectType(b.b),8,false);
          burst(b,effectType(a.b),8,false);
          SFX.hit();
        }
        // Reflect incoming velocities relative to the contact normal.
        const da=a.vx*nx+a.vy*ny,db=b.vx*nx+b.vy*ny;
        if(da<0){a.vx-=2*da*nx;a.vy-=2*da*ny;}
        if(db>0){b.vx-=2*db*nx;b.vy-=2*db*ny;}
        // Barely noticeable deviation avoids endless identical collision loops.
        for(const o of [a,b]){
          const t=(Math.random()<.5?-1:1)*(1+Math.random()*2)*Math.PI/180;
          const vx=o.vx,vy=o.vy;
          o.vx=vx*Math.cos(t)-vy*Math.sin(t);o.vy=vx*Math.sin(t)+vy*Math.cos(t);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  updateEffects(dt);
  const team0 = G.bl.some(o => o.team === 0 && alive(o)), team1 = G.bl.some(o => o.team === 1 && alive(o));
  if (!team0 || !team1) {
    const winner=team0 && !team1 ? 0 : team1 && !team0 ? 1 : -1;
    window.BVBCampaign?.onRoundEnd?.(G,winner);
    roundEnd(winner);
  }
}

function roundEnd(winner) {
  if (!G || G.ph !== 'battle') return;
  G.ph = 'end';
  if (winner >= 0) G.h[1 - winner]--;
  hearts();
  broadcastState();
  setTimeout(() => {
    if (!G || G.ph !== 'end') return;
    if (G.h[0] > 0 && G.h[1] > 0) return nextRound();
    over();
  }, 1100);
}

function over() {
  if (!G || G.finished) return;
  G.finished = true;
  broadcastState();
  const win = G.h[0] > 0;
  const isHw = (G.m == 9 || G.m == 10);
  if (G.m === 11 && win) { S.bb = (S.bb | 0) + 1; S.bossWins[G.bossIndex || 0] = (S.bossWins[G.bossIndex || 0] | 0) + 1; }
  const candyEarned = isHw ? (win ? DIFF_CANDY[diff] : Math.round(DIFF_CANDY[diff] * 0.25)) : (win ? 15 : 5);
  const coinEarned = win ? DIFF_REW[diff] : Math.round(DIFF_REW[diff] * 0.25);
  
  if (G.m === 12) { /* Online 1vs1 is a friendly match, no ranked rewards. */ }
  else { S.coins += coinEarned; S.candies += candyEarned; }
  if (win && netRole!=='guest') S.ach.winsByArena[G.th]=true;
  checkAchievements();
  save();

  win ? SFX.win() : SFX.lose();
  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = `
    <h2>${win ? '🏆 Zwycięstwo!' : '💀 Koniec walki'}</h2>${G.m === 11 ? `<p style="margin:8px 0">Boss: ${esc(BOSSD[G.bossIndex || 0].n)}</p>` : ''}
    <p style="color:var(--mu);margin:10px 0">${G.m === 12 ? 'Mecz towarzyski online' : `+${coinEarned} 🪙 · +${candyEarned} 🍬`}</p>
    <button class="b graj" onclick="$('#ov').hidden=true;${G.m === 11 ? `startBossFight(${G.bossIndex || 0})` : `startMatch(${G.m})`}">Zagraj ponownie</button>
    <button class="b" onclick="menu()">Menu główne</button>
  `;
}

function hearts() {
  if (!G) return;
  const hh = n => '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, n)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - n));
  $('#hp').textContent = `😎 Ty ${hh(G.h[0])}`;
  $('#hb').textContent = `${activeConn?.open ? '🌐 Rywal' : '🤖 Bot'} ${hh(G.h[1])}`;
}

function pz() {
  if (!G) return;
  $('#ov').hidden = false;
  $('#ovb').innerHTML = '<h2>Pauza ⏸️</h2><button class="b graj" onclick="$(\'#ov\').hidden=true">Wznów grę</button><button class="b" onclick="menu()">Wyjdź do menu</button>';
}

function emo(i) {
  if (!G || !EMO[i]) return;
  SFX.tick();
}

function draw() {
  if (!G) return;
  cx.setTransform(D, 0, 0, D, 0, 0);
  drawArenaBackground();
  window.BVB1625?.drawArena?.(cx,G);
  drawArenaItems();

  if (['draft', 'aim'].includes(G.ph)) {
    cx.fillStyle = '#fef08a';
    cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(PX, PY, 13, 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.fill();
    cx.save();
    cx.setLineDash([6, 5]);
    cx.strokeStyle = '#fef08a';
    cx.lineWidth = 2.5;
    cx.beginPath();
    cx.moveTo(PX, PY);
    let x = PX, y = PY, vx = Math.cos(G.pa), vy = Math.sin(G.pa);
    for (let i = 0; i < 90; i++) {
      x += vx * 4; y += vy * 4;
      if (x < 12 || x > 348) { vx *= -1; x = clamp(x, 12, 348); }
      if (y < 12 || y > 348) { vy *= -1; y = clamp(y, 12, 348); }
      cx.lineTo(x, y);
    }
    cx.stroke();
    cx.restore();
  }

  // Świetliste kręgi oraz iskry podczas aktywowania mocy.
  for (const ring of G.rings || []) {
    const t = ring.age / ring.life;
    cx.save(); cx.globalAlpha = (1 - t) * 0.8;
    cx.strokeStyle = ring.c; cx.lineWidth = 3 * (1 - t) + 0.5;
    cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(ring.x, ring.y, ring.radius + t * 33, 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.stroke(); cx.restore();
  }
  for (const f of G.fx || []) {
    cx.save(); cx.globalAlpha = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, f.life / f.max));
    cx.shadowColor = f.c; cx.shadowBlur = 12; cx.fillStyle = f.c;
    cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.r, 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.fill(); cx.restore();
  }
  for (const o of G.bl || []) {
    if (!alive(o)) continue;
    cx.save();
    const kind = effectType(o.b), effect = EFFECTS[kind];
    for (let i = 0; i < (o.trail || []).length; i++) {
      const pt = o.trail[i];
      cx.globalAlpha = (i + 1) / o.trail.length * 0.27;
      cx.fillStyle = effect.color;
      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(pt.x, pt.y, o.r * (0.25 + 0.55 * (i + 1) / o.trail.length), 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.fill();
    }
    cx.globalAlpha = 1;
    cx.shadowColor = effect.color;
    cx.shadowBlur = 11 + Math.sin((G.rt || 0) * 7) * 3;
    const teamColor = o.team ? '#ef4444' : '#fbbf24';
    if (o.team===0 && S.playerAura) {
      cx.strokeStyle=S.playerAura;cx.lineWidth=2;
      cx.beginPath();cx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.r+9+Math.sin((G.rt||0)*5)*2,0,6.283);cx.stroke();
    }
    cx.strokeStyle = teamColor;
    cx.lineWidth = 3;
    cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r + 3, 0, 6.283); cx.stroke();

    const im = ART_IMAGES.get(o.b.id);
    // Chronos slows opponents' individual visual timelines in every supported batch,
    // not only movement and cooldowns. The Chronos actor is not slowed by its own skill.
    const renderG=(o.bvb5264SlowUntil||0)>G.rt ? {...G,rt:o.bvb5264AnimClock??G.rt} : G;
    if(window.BVBLastLive?.ids.includes(o.b?.id)){window.BVBLastLive.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);} else if(window.BVBParty87?.ids.includes(o.b?.id)){window.BVBParty87.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);} else if(window.BVBParty65?.ids.includes(o.b?.id)){window.BVBParty65.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);} else if (o.b?.id>=16 && o.b?.id<=25 && window.BVB1625Visual) {cx.save();window.BVB1625Visual.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);cx.restore();}
    else if (window.BVBStatusVisuals?.actor(cx,o,renderG)) { /* replacement actor rendered */ }
    else if (o.b?.id>=52 && o.b?.id<=64 && window.BVB5264Visual) {cx.save();window.BVB5264Visual.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);cx.restore();}
    else if (o.b?.id>=39 && o.b?.id<=51 && window.BVB3951Visual) {cx.save();cx.translate(o.x,o.y);cx.rotate(o.rotation||0);window.BVB3951Visual.drawActor(cx,o,renderG);cx.restore();}
    else if (im?.complete && im.naturalWidth) {cx.save();cx.translate(o.x,o.y);cx.rotate(o.rotation||0);if(!window.BVBBatch01Animation?.drawActor(cx,o,renderG)&&!window.BVBBatch2638Motion?.drawActor(cx,o,renderG))cx.drawImage(im,-o.r,-o.r,o.r*2,o.r*2);cx.restore();}
    else { cx.fillStyle = o.b.c; cx.fillRect(o.x - o.r, o.y - o.r, o.r * 2, o.r * 2); }

    cx.shadowBlur = 0;
    if (o.status.shield > 0) {
      cx.strokeStyle = '#67e8f9'; cx.lineWidth = 3;
      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(o.x, o.y, o.r + 8, 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.stroke();
    }
    window.BVBStatusVisuals?.status(cx,o,renderG);
    if (o.status.burn > 0 || o.status.poison > 0 || o.status.slow > 0 || o.status.stun > 0) {
      cx.fillStyle = o.status.burn > 0 ? '#fb923c' : o.status.poison > 0 ? '#a3e635' : o.status.stun > 0 ? '#fde047' : '#67e8f9';
      cx.beginPath(); cx.arc(o.x + o.r - 1, o.y - o.r + 1, 5, 0, Math.PI * 2); cx.fill();
    }
    cx.fillStyle = '#090f20'; cx.fillRect(o.x - 22, o.y - o.r - 12, 44, 5);
    cx.fillStyle = o.team ? '#ef4444' : '#4ade80'; cx.fillRect(o.x - 22, o.y - o.r - 12, 44 * clamp(o.hp / o.mh, 0, 1), 5);
    cx.restore();
  }
  for (const p of G.pop || []) {
    cx.save(); cx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, 1 - p.age / p.life);
    cx.font = 'bold 10px Segoe UI, sans-serif'; cx.textAlign = 'center';
    cx.lineWidth = 3; cx.strokeStyle = '#070a18';
    cx.strokeText(p.text, p.x, p.y); cx.fillStyle = p.c; cx.fillText(p.text, p.x, p.y);
    cx.restore();
  }
}

function loop(t) {
  window.BVBBatch01Animation?.renderPortraits?.(t);
  const elapsed = Math.min(0.1, Math.max(0, (t - (frameLast || t)) / 1000));
  frameLast = t;
  if (G) {
    if (G.ph === 'battle' && netRole !== 'guest') {
      fixedAccumulator += elapsed;
      let steps = 0;
      while (fixedAccumulator >= 1 / 60 && steps++ < 6 && G?.ph === 'battle') {
        step(1 / 60);
        fixedAccumulator -= 1 / 60;
      }
    }
    draw();
    if (netRole === 'host' && activeConn && G.ph === 'battle' && t - netSyncAt > 120) {
      netSyncAt = t; broadcastState();
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

window.BVBGameBridge = {
  getNickname: () => String(S.nm || 'Gracz'),
  setNickname: name => { S.nm = String(name||'Gracz').trim().slice(0,16);save(); },
  stats: () => ({wins:Math.max(0,S.wins|0),level:Math.max(1,S.lv|0)}),
  exportState: () => JSON.stringify(S),
  backup: () => {try {localStorage.setItem('bvb_cloud_backup_'+Date.now(),JSON.stringify(S));} catch(e) { /* local storage may be full */ }},
  importState: data => {try {const x=JSON.parse(data);if(!x || !Array.isArray(x.own))return false;localStorage.setItem(K,JSON.stringify(x));load();return true;} catch(e){return false;}},
  goMenu: () => menu(),
  getRoom: () => (netRole==='host' && activeConn?.open || netRole==='host' && peer?.id) ? peer?.id : null,
  joinRoom: () => false
};
window.addEventListener('bvb-cloud-ready',()=>{
  if ($('#pn')?.dataset.panel === 'account' && !$('#pn').hidden) window.BVBCloud?.renderAccount?.();
});
load();
menu();
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
</script>

    snd(230+(id*19+id2*13)%510,.075,id%2?'triangle':'sawtooth',.025,105);
  };
  const oldStep = step, oldDraw = draw, oldLoop = loop, oldSetp = setp, oldRoundEnd = roundEnd;

  const smooth = new Map();

    const v = Number(S?.o?.fxLevel);
    return Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 3 ? v : 3;
  }
  function quality() {
    return [0, 0.3, 0.62, 1][level()] * adaptive;
  }
  function addPop(x, y, text, color, life = .9) {
    if (!G || !quality()) return;
    G.pop ||= [];
    G.pop.push({ x, y, text, c: color, age: 0, life });
    if (G.pop.length > 24) G.pop.splice(0, G.pop.length - 24);
  }
  function ring(x, y, color, radius = 18, duration = .55) {
    if (!G || !quality()) return;
    G.rings ||= [];
    G.rings.push({ x, y, c: color, radius, life: duration, age: 0 });
    if (G.rings.length > 28) G.rings.splice(0, G.rings.length - 28);
  }
  function banner(text, color = '#a78bfa', time = 1450) {
    if (!quality()) return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.bvb-anime-banner').forEach(el => el.remove());
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'bvb-anime-banner';

    setTimeout(() => el.remove(), time);

  function sparks(x, y, color, n = 9, seed = 0) {

    G.fx ||= [];
    const count = Math.min(24, Math.max(2, Math.round(n * quality())));
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {

      const sp = 28 + (i * 31 + seed * 7) % 110;
      const life = .3 + (i % 4) * .09;

    const tone = o.b?.c || EFFECTS[kind]?.color || '#a78bfa';
    sparks(o.x,o.y,tone,count,ballId);
    if (ballId % 3 === 0) ring(o.x,o.y,tone,o.r + 5,.38);
    else if (ballId % 3 === 1) ring(o.x,o.y,'#fff',o.r + 8,.30);
