  }
  burst = function(o, kind, n = 12, label = true) {
    if (!quality()) return;
    oldBurst(o,kind,Math.max(3,Math.round(n * quality())),label);
    signature(o,kind,Math.min(10,n));
  };

  function shieldEffect(o, blocked) {
    if (!blocked) return;
    ring(o.x,o.y,'#67e8f9',o.r + 8,.4);
    sparks(o.x,o.y,'#a5f3fc',7,o.uid);
    addPop(o.x,Math.max(20,o.y-28),'BLOCK!','#a5f3fc');
    if (o.status.shield <= 0) {
      ring(o.x,o.y,'#f8fafc',o.r + 14,.67);
      addPop(o.x,Math.max(20,o.y-46),'SHIELD BREAK!','#93c5fd',1.2);
    }
  }
  function executeCombo(o, foe) {
    if (!foe || !alive(foe)) return;
    o.comboCooldown = 5.5;
    o.comboHits = 0;
    // Tactical choice controls the finisher; Balanced keeps the surprise.
    const choice = o.tactic === 'strike' ? 0 : o.tactic === 'rush' ? 1 : o.tactic === 'guard' ? 2 : Math.floor(Math.random()*3);
    const col = o.b.c || '#e879f9';
    o.attackGlow = .75;
    addPop(o.x,o.y-36,'COMBO!','#fde047',1.3);
    ring(foe.x,foe.y,col,foe.r+4,.55);
    if (choice === 0) {
      oldApply(foe,o.baseDmg*.8);
      burst(foe,'blast',24,false);
    } else if (choice === 1) {
      oldApply(foe,o.baseDmg*.85);
      for (let i=0;i<3;i++) ring(foe.x,foe.y,col,9+i*8,.22+i*.14);
      sparks(foe.x,foe.y,'#fff',22,o.b.id);
    } else {
      oldAbility(o,foe);
      signature(o,effectType(o.b),19);
    }
    SFX.zap();
  }
  function emergency(o) {
    if (!alive(o) || o.emergencyUsed || o.hp/o.mh >= .15) return;
    const foe = G?.bl?.find(p=>p!==o && alive(p));
    if (!foe) return;
    o.emergencyUsed = true;
    o.attackGlow = 1.05;
    const col = o.b.c || '#f43f5e';
    addPop(o.x,o.y-42,'AWAKENING!','#fff',1.4);
    ring(o.x,o.y,col,o.r+8,.85);
    signature(o,effectType(o.b),25);
    oldApply(foe,o.baseDmg*1.5);
    if (SFX.boom) SFX.boom();
  }
  applyDamage = function(target, damage) {
    if (!target || !Number.isFinite(damage) || damage <= 0) return;
    const direct = damage >= 9, crit = direct && Math.random()<.11;
    const amount = damage*(crit?1.5:1);
    const before = target.hp, oldShield = target.status.shield || 0;
    oldApply(target,amount);
    const dealt = Math.max(0,before-target.hp);
    const blocked = Math.max(0,oldShield-(target.status.shield||0));
    if (direct) {
      if (G) G.recentHitAt = G.rt || 0;
      shieldEffect(target,blocked);
      if (dealt>0) {
        const attacker = G?.bl?.find(p=>p!==target);
        target.flash = .21;
        target.flashColor = attacker?.b?.c || '#fff';
        sparks(target.x,target.y,target.flashColor,crit?19:9,target.b?.id||0);
        ring(target.x,target.y,crit?'#ef4444':target.flashColor,target.r+2,crit?.65:.28);
        if (S.o.nd || crit) addPop(target.x,target.y-23,(crit?'CRITICAL! ':'')+(S.o.nd?Math.ceil(dealt):''),
          crit?'#ff4747':'#fff4a3',crit?1.25:.75);
        if (attacker && alive(attacker)) {
          attacker.comboHits = (attacker.comboHits||0)+1;
          if (attacker.comboHits >= 5 && !(attacker.comboCooldown>0))
            executeCombo(attacker,target);
        }
        if (crit) { SFX.boom(); if (G) G.shake = Math.max(G.shake || 0, 3.5); }
        else if (damage >= 20 && G) G.shake = Math.max(G.shake || 0, 2);
      }
    }
    if (dealt>0 && alive(target)) emergency(target);
  };
  specialAbility = function(o,foe) {
    if (!o || !foe || !alive(foe)) return;
    const kind = effectType(o.b);
    const oldHp = o.hp, foeHp = foe.hp, oldShield = o.status.shield || 0;
    oldAbility(o,foe);
    o.attackGlow = .55;
    signature(o,kind,14);
    if (kind === 'heal' && o.hp>oldHp) {
      addPop(o.x,o.y-33,'+'+Math.ceil(o.hp-oldHp)+' HP','#4ade80');
      ring(o.x,o.y,'#4ade80',o.r+12,.65);
    }
    if (kind === 'shield' && (o.status.shield||0)>oldShield)
      addPop(o.x,o.y-32,'SHIELD!','#a5f3fc');
    if (kind === 'ice') addPop(foe.x,foe.y-34,'FROZEN!','#bae6fd');
    if (kind === 'electric') {
      addPop(foe.x,foe.y-33,'SHOCK!','#fef08a');
      G.lightning ||= [];
      G.lightning.push({from:o.uid,to:foe.uid,life:.38,max:.38,seed:o.b.id});
      if(G.lightning.length>8)G.lightning.shift();
      SFX.zap();
    }
    if (foe.hp<foeHp) {
      foe.flash = .18;
      foe.flashColor = EFFECTS[kind]?.color || o.b.c;
      if (S.o.nd) addPop(foe.x,foe.y-19,'-'+Math.ceil(foeHp-foe.hp),foe.flashColor);
      emergency(foe);
    }
  };
  step = function(dt) {
    if (!G || G.ph !== 'battle') return;
    for(const o of G.bl) {
      o.comboCooldown = Math.max(0,(o.comboCooldown||0)-dt);
      o.attackGlow = Math.max(0,(o.attackGlow||0)-dt);
      o.flash = Math.max(0,(o.flash||0)-dt);
      o.dotVisual = (o.dotVisual||0)+dt;
      if(o.dotVisual>=.8) {
        o.dotVisual = 0;
        if(o.status.poison>0) {sparks(o.x,o.y,'#a3e635',3,o.uid); if(S.o.nd)addPop(o.x,o.y-22,'-2','#a3e635',.6);}
        if(o.status.burn>0) {sparks(o.x,o.y,'#fb923c',4,o.uid); if(S.o.nd)addPop(o.x,o.y-22,'-3','#fb923c',.6);}
        if(o.status.stun>0) sparks(o.x,o.y,'#facc15',5,o.uid);
        if(o.status.slow>0) sparks(o.x,o.y,'#bae6fd',4,o.uid);
      }
    }
    oldStep(dt);
    if (G?.ph === 'battle' && G.bl.length === 2) {
      const [a,b] = G.bl, dx=a.x-b.x,dy=a.y-b.y, gap=Math.hypot(dx,dy);
      const separating=dx*(a.vx-b.vx)+dy*(a.vy-b.vy)>0;
      if(gap<a.r+b.r+14 && gap>a.r+b.r+2 && separating && G.rt-(G.recentHitAt||-10)>.65) {
        if((G.rt||0)-(G.lastDodgeAt||-10)>1.8) {
          G.lastDodgeAt=G.rt;
          addPop((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2-23,'DODGE!','#67e8f9');
          sparks((a.x+b.x)/2,(a.y+b.y)/2,'#67e8f9',7);
        }
      }
    }
  };
  roundEnd = function(winner) {
    if (!G || G.ph !== 'battle') return;
    G.ph = 'end';
    if(winner>=0) G.h[1-winner]--;
    G.lastRoundWinner = winner;
    const loser = G.bl?.find(o=>o.team!==winner);
    const victor = G.bl?.find(o=>o.team===winner);
    const kind = effectType(victor?.b);
    if(loser) {burst(loser,kind,35,false);ring(loser.x,loser.y,EFFECTS[kind]?.color||'#fff',25,1.3);}
    hearts();
    broadcastState();
    banner(winner<0?'DRAW!':winner===0?'VICTORY!':'DEFEAT!',winner<0?'#facc15':winner===0?'#fbbf24':'#8b5cf6',1500);
    const match = G.matchId, round = G.rn;
    setTimeout(()=>{
      if(!G || G.matchId!==match || G.rn!==round || G.ph!=='end') return;
      if(G.h[0]>0 && G.h[1]>0) nextRound();
      else over();
    },1550);
  };
  setp = function(p) {
    oldSetp(p);
    const el = p.querySelector('.cd');
    if(!el) return;
    el.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
      '<div style="margin:14px 0"><label for="bvbFxLevel">✨ Efekty anime VFX</label>'+
      '<select id="bvbFxLevel" class="inp" onchange="window.BVBAnime.setLevel(this.value)">'+
      [0,1,2,3].map((n)=>'<option value="'+n+'"'+(level()===n?' selected':'')+'>'+
      ['Wyłączone','Niskie','Średnie','Wysokie'][n]+'</option>').join('')+
      '</select><small style="color:var(--mu)">Automatyczna optymalizacja płynności · cel 60 FPS</small></div>');
  };
  window.BVBAnime = {
    setLevel(v) {S.o.fxLevel=Math.max(0,Math.min(3,Number(v)||0));save();},
    getLevel: level
  };

  function drawStatus(o) {
    const kind=effectType(o.b), time=G.rt||0, power=quality();
    if (!power) return;
    cx.save();
    if(o.flash>0) {
      cx.fillStyle=o.flashColor||'#fff';cx.globalAlpha=Math.min(.43,o.flash*2.1);
      cx.beginPath();cx.arc(o.x,o.y,o.r,0,Math.PI*2);cx.fill();
      cx.globalAlpha=1;
    }
    if(o.attackGlow>0) {
      const color=o.b.c||EFFECTS[kind]?.color||'#a78bfa';
      cx.strokeStyle=color;cx.shadowColor=color;cx.shadowBlur=12+o.attackGlow*14;
      cx.lineWidth=1.5+o.attackGlow*3;
      const points=5+(o.b.id%5);
      cx.beginPath();
      for(let i=0;i<=points;i++) {
        const angle=time*3+i*Math.PI*2/points;
        const rad=o.r+7+(i%2?5:0)+2*Math.sin(time*17+i);
        const x=o.x+Math.cos(angle)*rad, y=o.y+Math.sin(angle)*rad;
        if(i===0)cx.moveTo(x,y);else cx.lineTo(x,y);
      }
      cx.stroke();
    }
    const status=o.status||{};
    const count=3+Math.round(power*3);
    for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
      const a=i*Math.PI*2/count+time*(status.stun>0?7:2.1);
      const rad=o.r+5+(i%2)*3;
      const x=o.x+Math.cos(a)*rad,y=o.y+Math.sin(a)*rad;
      if(status.burn>0) {
        cx.fillStyle=i%2?'#facc15':'#fb923c';
        cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x-3,y+3);cx.lineTo(x,y-6-2*Math.sin(time*12+i));cx.lineTo(x+3,y+3);cx.fill();
      } else if(status.poison>0) {
        cx.fillStyle='#a3e635';cx.globalAlpha=.7;cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,2+i%2,0,7);cx.fill();
      } else if(status.slow>0){
        cx.strokeStyle='#bae6fd';cx.lineWidth=2;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x-3,y+3);cx.lineTo(x,y-4);cx.lineTo(x+3,y+3);cx.stroke();
      } else if(status.stun>0){
        cx.strokeStyle='#facc15';cx.lineWidth=2;cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x-3,y-3);cx.lineTo(x+2,y);cx.lineTo(x-1,y+4);cx.stroke();
      }
    }
    cx.restore();
  }
  function drawLightning() {
    if (!quality()) return;
    for(const l of G.lightning||[]) {
      const from=G.bl?.find(o=>o.uid===l.from),to=G.bl?.find(o=>o.uid===l.to);
      if(!from||!to)continue;
      cx.save();cx.strokeStyle='#fde047';cx.lineWidth=1.3+quality()*2.2;
      cx.shadowColor='#facc15';cx.shadowBlur=10;
      cx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,l.life/l.max);
      cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(from.x,from.y);
      for(let i=1;i<9;i++) {
        const t=i/9, off=Math.sin((l.seed+i*17)*2.31)*11*(1-Math.abs(2*t-1)*.5);
        const dx=to.x-from.x,dy=to.y-from.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        cx.lineTo(from.x+dx*t-dy/len*off,from.y+dy*t+dx/len*off);
      }
      cx.lineTo(to.x,to.y);cx.stroke();cx.restore();
    }
  }
  draw = function() {
    if (!G) return;
    const oldPos = [];
    if(netRole === 'guest' && G.ph === 'battle'){
      const key=G.matchId+':'+G.rn;
      if(visualRound!==key){visualRound=key;smooth.clear();}
      for(const o of G.bl||[]){
        let p=smooth.get(o.uid);
        if(!p){p={x:o.x,y:o.y};smooth.set(o.uid,p);}
        if(Math.hypot(p.x-o.x,p.y-o.y)>110){p.x=o.x;p.y=o.y;}
        const k=Math.min(1,(1/60)*17);
        p.x+=(o.x-p.x)*k;p.y+=(o.y-p.y)*k;
        oldPos.push([o,o.x,o.y]);o.x=p.x;o.y=p.y;
      }
    }
    const oldFx=G.fx,oldRings=G.rings,oldPop=G.pop;
    const q=quality();
    if(q===0){G.fx=[];G.rings=[];G.pop=[];}
    else if(q<.95){
      G.fx=(oldFx||[]).filter((_,i)=>i%4 < Math.max(1,Math.round(q*4)));
    }
    try {
      oldDraw();
      if(q)drawLightning();
      if(q && G.ph==='battle')
        for(const o of G.bl||[])if(alive(o))drawStatus(o);
    } finally {
      G.fx=oldFx;G.rings=oldRings;G.pop=oldPop;
      for(const [o,x,y] of oldPos){o.x=x;o.y=y;}
    }
  };
  loop = function(t) {
    const elapsed=frameMark?Math.min(.07,Math.max(0,(t-frameMark)/1000)):1/60;
    frameMark=t;
    if(elapsed>.027){lowFrames++;highFrames=0;}
    else if(elapsed<.019){highFrames++;lowFrames=Math.max(0,lowFrames-1);}
    if(lowFrames>35){adaptive=Math.max(.35,adaptive-.13);lowFrames=0;}
    if(highFrames>240){adaptive=Math.min(1,adaptive+.12);highFrames=0;}
    if(G && (netRole==='guest'||G.ph==='end') && ['battle','end'].includes(G.ph)){
      updateEffects(elapsed);
      for(const o of G.bl||[])if(netRole==='guest'){
        o.flash=Math.max(0,(o.flash||0)-elapsed);
        o.attackGlow=Math.max(0,(o.attackGlow||0)-elapsed);
      }
    }
    if(G && !$('#game').hidden) {
      const key=G.matchId+':'+G.rn;
      if(visualRound!==key && netRole!=='guest')visualRound=key;
      const phase=key+':'+G.ph+':'+Boolean(G.finished);
      if(phase!==visualPhase){
        visualPhase=phase;
        if(netRole==='guest'){
          if(G.finished)banner(G.h[0]>0?'VICTORY!':'DEFEAT!',G.h[0]>0?'#fbbf24':'#8b5cf6');
          else if(G.ph==='battle')banner('ROUND START!','#38bdf8');
          else if(G.ph==='end')banner(G.lastRoundWinner<0?'DRAW!':G.lastRoundWinner===0?'VICTORY!':'DEFEAT!',G.lastRoundWinner===0?'#fbbf24':'#8b5cf6');
        } else if(G.finished)banner(G.h[0]>0?'VICTORY!':'DEFEAT!',G.h[0]>0?'#fbbf24':'#8b5cf6');
        else if(G.ph==='battle')banner('ROUND START!','#38bdf8');
      }
    }
    const canvas = $('#cv');
    if (canvas) {
      if (G && (G.shake||0)>0 && S.o.sk && quality()) {
        const s = G.shake;
        canvas.style.transform = 'translate(' + ((Math.random()-.5)*s*2).toFixed(1) + 'px,' + ((Math.random()-.5)*s*2).toFixed(1) + 'px)';
      } else canvas.style.transform = '';
    }
    if(G) {
      G.shake = Math.max(0,(G.shake||0)-elapsed*7);
      for(const l of G.lightning||[])l.life-=elapsed;
      G.lightning=(G.lightning||[]).filter(l=>l.life>0);
    }
    oldLoop(t);
  };
})();


</script>
<script>
/* Ball VS Ball — Tactical Replayability Update
   Player decisions, fair round rules and cosmetic ball mastery.
   All combat modifiers are applied only by the authoritative host. */
(() => {
  'use strict';
  if (typeof G === 'undefined' || typeof draw !== 'function') return;
  const TACTICS = {
    balanced: {icon:'⚖️',name:'Balans',detail:'Bez zmian · losowe COMBO',color:'#cbd5e1'},
    strike: {icon:'⚔️',name:'Atak',detail:'+18% obrażeń · -10% HP · COMBO: wybuch',color:'#fb7185'},
    guard: {icon:'🛡️',name:'Obrona',detail:'+20% HP · -15% obrażeń · COMBO: moc',color:'#7dd3fc'},
    rush: {icon:'💨',name:'Szybkość',detail:'+26% prędkości · -8% obrażeń · COMBO: seria',color:'#facc15'}
  };
  const RULES = {
    standard: {icon:'⚖️',name:'Klasyczne starcie',desc:'Bez dodatkowych zasad'},
    turbo: {icon:'🚀',name:'TURBO',desc:'Obie kulki poruszają się o 25% szybciej'},
    guard: {icon:'🛡️',name:'BARIERA',desc:'Obie kulki zaczynają z tarczą 12 HP'},
    frenzy: {icon:'⚡',name:'SZYBKIE MOCE',desc:'Umiejętności odnawiają się o 25% szybciej'},
    clash: {icon:'💥',name:'POTĘŻNE UDERZENIA',desc:'Obie kulki zadają o 13% więcej obrażeń, ale są wolniejsze'}
  };
  const MISSIONS = {
    strike: {name:'Siła ataku',desc:'Wygraj rundę z taktyką Atak',reward:25},
    guard: {name:'Mocna obrona',desc:'Wygraj rundę z taktyką Obrona',reward:25},
    rush: {name:'Mistrz szybkości',desc:'Wygraj rundę z taktyką Szybkość',reward:25},
    balls: {name:'Dwie różne kulki',desc:'Wygraj rundy dwiema różnymi kulkami',reward:35},
    styles: {name:'Adaptacja',desc:'Wygraj rundy dwoma różnymi taktykami',reward:35}
  };
  let personalChoice = 'balanced', matchKey = '', panelKey = '';
  const oldDraw = draw, oldRoundEnd = roundEnd;
  const palette = document.createElement('style');
  palette.textContent =
    '#bvbTactics{margin:6px 0 10px;padding:10px;border:1px solid #44558c;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#111a39,#211a3f);color:#f8fafc}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-rule{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 7px;padding:7px;background:#ffffff0b;border-radius:8px}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:4px}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-tactic{font-size:12px;color:#eff6ff;background:#243055;border:1px solid #58618a;border-radius:9px;cursor:pointer;padding:7px 2px;line-height:1.2;min-height:48px}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-tactic:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #a5f3fc}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-tactic[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#385294;border:2px solid #facc15;color:#fff}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-detail{font-size:12px;color:#dce6ff;min-height:18px;margin:6px 0 0}' +
    '#bvbTactics .bvb-hint{font-size:10px;color:#bac7f7;margin:3px 0 0}';
  document.head.appendChild(palette);

  const roundKey = g => g ? String(g.matchId) + ':' + String(g.rn) : '';
  const valid = s => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TACTICS,s);
  function localTeam(g) { return netRole === 'guest' && g?.m === 12 ? 1 : 0; }
  function rule(g) { return RULES[g?.modifier] || RULES.standard; }
  function useChoice(g) {
    const key = roundKey(g);
    if (key !== matchKey) { matchKey = key; personalChoice = 'balanced'; panelKey = ''; }
    return personalChoice;
  }

  function selectTactic(name) {
    if (!valid(name) || !G || !['draft','aim'].includes(G.ph)) return;
    if (netRole === 'guest' && G.m === 12 && guestAimSent) return; // Lock after shooting.
    if (netRole === 'host' && G.m === 12 && hostAimAngle != null) return;
    useChoice(G);
    personalChoice = name;
    if (netRole === 'guest' && G.m === 12) {
      netSend({type:'tactic',tactic:name,matchId:G.matchId,rn:G.rn});
    } else {
      G.tactics ||= {0:'balanced',1:'balanced'};
      G.tactics[0] = name;
      if (G.m === 12) broadcastState();
    }
    panelKey = '';
    displayPanel();
    if (typeof SFX?.tick === 'function') SFX.tick();
  }

  function newMatch(g) {
    if (!g || g.m === 12 || g.m === 4 || netRole === 'guest') return;
    const keys=Object.keys(MISSIONS);
    g.mission={key:keys[Math.floor(Math.random()*keys.length)],complete:false,progress:[]};
  }
  function nextRule(g) {
    if (!g || netRole === 'guest') return;
    const keys = Object.keys(RULES).filter(k=>k!==g.lastModifier);
    const pick = keys[Math.floor(Math.random()*keys.length)];
    g.lastModifier = g.modifier = pick;
    g.tactics = {0:'balanced',1:Math.random()<.24?'balanced':(['strike','guard','rush'][Math.floor(Math.random()*3)])};
    // Easy bots do not randomly gain Guard (+20% HP) or Rush (+26% speed).
    // Medium bots may occasionally use a mild tactic, but never Rush.
    if(g.m===0&&typeof diff==='number'){
      if(diff===0)g.tactics[1]='balanced';
      else if(diff===1)g.tactics[1]=Math.random()<.18?(['strike','guard'][Math.floor(Math.random()*2)]):'balanced';
    }
    if(g.m===12)g.tactics[1] = 'balanced'; // Guest chooses their own stance.
    g.roundStartedAt = 0;
  }

  function prepareActors(g, p, e) {
    if (!g || netRole === 'guest') return;
    const list = [p,e];
    for(let i=0;i<2;i++){
      const o=list[i],name=g.tactics?.[i]||'balanced';
      o.tactic=valid(name)?name:'balanced';
      o.speedFactor=1;
      o.abilityRate=1;
      if(o.tactic==='strike'){o.hp*=.9;o.mh*=.9;o.baseDmg*=1.18;}
      if(o.tactic==='guard'){o.hp*=1.2;o.mh*=1.2;o.baseDmg*=.85;}
      if(o.tactic==='rush'){o.baseDmg*=.92;o.speedFactor*=1.26;}
      if(g.modifier==='turbo')o.speedFactor*=1.25;
      if(g.modifier==='guard')o.status.shield=12;
      if(g.modifier==='frenzy'){o.abilityRate=.75;o.abilityCd=Math.max(.4,o.abilityCd*.75);}
      if(g.modifier==='clash'){o.baseDmg*=1.13;o.speedFactor*=.92;}
    }
    g.roundStartedAt=Date.now();
    if(typeof burst==='function' && typeof effectType==='function'){
      for(const o of list){o.attackGlow=.35;burst(o,effectType(o.b),6,false);}
    }
  }

  function applyRemoteTactic(data) {
    if (!G || G.m!==12 || netRole!=='host' || !['draft','aim'].includes(G.ph))return false;
    if(data.matchId!==G.matchId || data.rn!==G.rn || !valid(data.tactic))return false;
    if(remoteAimAngle!==null)return false; // A committed shot cannot change its stance.
    G.tactics||={0:'balanced',1:'balanced'};
    G.tactics[1]=data.tactic;
    broadcastState();
    return true;
  }

  function resendTactic() {
    if (!G || netRole!=='guest' || G.m!==12 || !activeConn?.open) return;
    netSend({type:'tactic',tactic:useChoice(G),matchId:G.matchId,rn:G.rn});
  }

  function onGuestState(hostState) {
    if(!hostState || netRole!=='guest') return;
    useChoice(G);
    // The draw wrapper updates only when phase or tactic really changes.
  }

  function rank(id) {
    const d=S?.mastery?.[id];
    const wins=Math.max(0,d?.wins||0), fights=Math.max(0,d?.fights||0);
    const target=3*(1+Math.floor(wins/3)), lvl=1+Math.floor(wins/3);
    return {wins,fights,target,lvl:Math.min(9,lvl)};
  }
  function badge(id) {
    const d=rank(id);
    return '<small style="display:block;color:#fde68a">⭐ Mistrzostwo '+d.lvl+
      ' · '+d.wins+'/'+d.target+' wygranych do następnego poziomu</small>';
  }
  function displayPanel() {
    let el=document.getElementById('bvbTactics');
    if(!el){el=document.createElement('section');el.id='bvbTactics';el.setAttribute('aria-label','Taktyka rundy');$('#bset')?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',el);}
    if(!G || $('#game')?.hidden || !['draft','aim','battle','end'].includes(G.ph)){el.hidden=true;return;}
    el.hidden=false;
    const current=useChoice(G),r=rule(G);
    const locked=G.ph!=='draft'&&G.ph!=='aim' || (netRole==='guest'&&G.m===12&&guestAimSent) || (netRole==='host'&&G.m===12&&hostAimAngle!=null);
    const effective = netRole==='guest' && G.m===12 ? current : G.tactics?.[0]||current;
    const mission = G.mission && MISSIONS[G.mission.key];
    const key = roundKey(G)+':'+G.ph+':'+r.name+':'+effective+':'+locked+':'+(G.mission?.complete||false)+':'+(G.mission?.progress?.length||0);
    if(key===panelKey)return;
    panelKey=key;
    const tip=TACTICS[effective] || TACTICS.balanced;
    el.innerHTML =
      (mission ? '<p class="bvb-rule" style="border-left:3px solid #facc15">'+
        '<b>🏅 Misja meczu: '+mission.name+'</b> · +'+mission.reward+' 🪙<span style="display:block;color:#cad7fa">'+
        (G.mission.complete?'✅ Wykonano!':mission.desc+(G.mission.progress?.length?' ('+G.mission.progress.length+'/2)':''))+
        '</span></p>':'')+
      '<p class="bvb-rule"><b>'+r.icon+' Zasada rundy: '+r.name+'</b><span style="display:block;color:#cad7fa">'+r.desc+'</span></p>'+
      '<b style="font-size:12px">🎯 Twoja taktyka na tę rundę'+(locked?' (wybrana)':' (wybierz przed strzałem)')+':</b>'+
      '<div class="bvb-buttons">'+Object.entries(TACTICS).map(([id,t])=>
        '<button type="button" class="bvb-tactic" aria-pressed="'+(effective===id)+'"'+(locked?' disabled':'')+
        ' onclick="window.BVBGameplay.selectTactic(\''+id+'\')">'+t.icon+'<span style="display:block">'+t.name+'</span></button>'
      ).join('')+'</div>'+
      '<p class="bvb-detail" style="color:'+tip.color+'">'+tip.detail+'</p>'+
      '<p class="bvb-hint">Taktyka ustawia też rodzaj COMBO. Zasada rundy działa jednakowo na obie kulki.</p>';
  }

  draw = function() { oldDraw(); displayPanel(); };
  function updateMission(winner, participant) {
    if(winner!==0 || !participant || !G?.mission || G.mission.complete || G.m===12 || G.m===4)return;
    const mission=G.mission, task=MISSIONS[mission.key];
    if(!task)return;
    const tactic=G.tactics?.[0]||'balanced';
    let fulfilled=false;
    if(['strike','guard','rush'].includes(mission.key))fulfilled=tactic===mission.key;
    else {
      const id=mission.key==='balls'?participant.b.id:tactic;
      if(!mission.progress.includes(id))mission.progress.push(id);
      fulfilled=mission.progress.length>=2;
    }
    if(fulfilled){
      mission.complete=true;
      S.coins=(S.coins||0)+task.reward;
      G.pop ||= [];
      G.pop.push({x:participant.x,y:Math.max(25,participant.y-55),text:'🏅 MISJA +'+task.reward+' 🪙',c:'#facc15',age:0,life:1.35});
    }
  }
  roundEnd = function(winner) {
    if(!G || G.ph!=='battle')return;
    const participant=G.bl?.find(o=>o.team===0);
    updateMission(winner,participant);
    if(participant && G.m!==12 && !participant.b?.isBoss){
      S.mastery ||= {};
      const id=participant.b.id;
      const old=rank(id), data=S.mastery[id] || {fights:0,wins:0};
      data.fights++;
      if(winner===0)data.wins++;
      S.mastery[id]=data;
      const newer=rank(id);
      if(newer.lvl>old.lvl && G.pop)G.pop.push({x:participant.x,y:Math.max(28,participant.y-45),text:'⭐ MISTRZOSTWO '+newer.lvl,c:'#fde68a',age:0,life:1.4});
      save();
    }
    oldRoundEnd(winner);
  };

  window.BVBGameplay = {TACTICS,RULES,MISSIONS,newMatch,newRound:nextRule,prepareActors,selectTactic,applyRemoteTactic,resendTactic,onGuestState,badge,rank,
    getTactic:()=>personalChoice,
    getRule:()=>G?.modifier||'standard'
  };
})();


</script>

function saveState(){
 S.campaign ||= {};
 const c=S.campaign;
 c.unlocked=Math.max(1,Math.min(50,Number(c.unlocked)||1));
 c.cleared=Array.isArray(c.cleared)?c.cleared:[];
 c.stars=Array.isArray(c.stars)?c.stars:[];
 c.deck=Array.isArray(c.deck)?c.deck:[0,1,2];
 return c;
}
function stage(n){return LEVELS[(Number(n)||1)-1];}
function ownIds(){const arr=S.own.filter(id=>Number.isInteger(id)&&B[id]);return arr.length>=3?arr:[0,1,2];}
function deck(){
 const chosen=[],c=saveState(),available=ownIds();
 for(const id of c.deck){if(available.includes(id)&&!chosen.includes(id)&&chosen.length<3)chosen.push(id);}
 for(const id of available){if(chosen.length>=3)break;if(!chosen.includes(id))chosen.push(id);}
 return chosen.map(id=>B[id]);
}
function chooseBall(i,value){
 const id=Number(value),chosen=deck().map(b=>b.id);
 if(!ownIds().includes(id)||!Number.isInteger(id)||chosen.some((v,j)=>j!==i&&v===id)){render();return;}
 chosen[i]=id;saveState().deck=chosen;save();render();
}
function bossBall(l){
 const template=B[l.enemyId]||B[0],boss=BOSSD[[2,1,3,4,5][Math.floor(l.id/10)-1]];
 return {...template,isBoss:true};
}
function inspect(n){if(n>saveState().unlocked)return;selected=n;render();}

}

 p.innerHTML='<h2>🗺️ Kampania — 50 poziomów</h2><p>✅ '+c.cleared.length+'/50 · ⭐ '+c.stars.length+'/50 · 🔓 '+c.unlocked+'/50</p>'+

function start(n){
 if(!Number.isInteger(n)||!stage(n)||n>saveState().unlocked||netRole==='guest')return;
 selected=n;startMatch(13);
}
function prepareMatch(g){
 if(!g||g.m!==13)return;
 const l=stage(selected);
 g.campaignLevel=l.id;g.th=l.arena;g.my=deck();g.bt=[l.boss?bossBall(l):B[l.enemyId]];
 g.h=l.boss?[3,3]:[2,2];
 g.rare=l.boss?'fx':l.id%7===0?'night':'';
 g.campaignGoalMet=false;g.campaignTotals={hits:0,abilities:0,portals:0,styles:[]};
 g.campaignEvent=null;g.campaignEventHandled=-1;g.campaignRewarded=false;
}
function addObstacles(g,n){
 g.obstacles ||= [];
 for(let i=0;i<n&&g.obstacles.length<6;i++){
  const p=randomEmptyPoint(g.obstacles),kind=obstacleKinds(g.th)[(i+g.rn)%obstacleKinds(g.th).length];
  g.obstacles.push({...p,r:16,kind,moving:false,dx:0,dy:0,moveClock:999,moveDuration:0,seed:i*2});
 }
}
function forcePortal(g){
 if(!g.portal){const p=randomEmptyPoint(g.obstacles||[],48);g.portal={...p,r:21,seed:Math.random()*6.28};}
}
function setupRound(g){
 if(!g||g.m!==13)return;
 const l=stage(g.campaignLevel);g.th=l.arena;
 if(['maze','fortress','boss','final','bounce'].includes(l.twist))addObstacles(g,l.twist==='maze'?4:2);
 if(l.twist==='portal'||g.campaignEvent?.id==='portal')forcePortal(g);
 if(g.campaignEvent?.id==='rocks')addObstacles(g,2);
}
function applyActors(g,p,e){
 if(!g||g.m!==13)return;
 const l=stage(g.campaignLevel),both=[p,e];
 const healthScale=1+(l.id-1)*.009;
 e.hp*=healthScale;e.mh*=healthScale;e.baseDmg*=1+(l.id-1)*.006;
 if(l.boss){e.hp*=1.4;e.mh*=1.4;e.baseDmg*=1.13;e.r=Math.max(25,e.r);e.abilityRate*=.83;}
 switch(l.twist){
 case 'bounce':p.speedFactor*=1.08;e.speedFactor*=1.08;break;
 case 'speed':p.speedFactor*=1.12;e.speedFactor*=1.23;break;
 case 'shield':p.status.shield=(p.status.shield||0)+10;e.status.shield=(e.status.shield||0)+18;break;
 case 'toxic':p.status.shield=(p.status.shield||0)+13;e.abilityRate*=.8;break;
 case 'glass':case 'blast':for(const o of both){o.hp*=.77;o.mh*=.77;o.baseDmg*=1.2;}break;
 case 'maze':e.baseDmg*=1.08;break;
 case 'ice':e.speedFactor*=.86;e.status.shield=(e.status.shield||0)+13;break;
 case 'portal':p.speedFactor*=1.1;break;
 case 'shock':for(const o of both)o.abilityRate*=.75;break;
 case 'wave':for(const o of both){o.speedFactor*=1.17;o.baseDmg*=1.08;}break;
 case 'fortress':e.status.shield=(e.status.shield||0)+22;p.baseDmg*=1.08;break;
 case 'final':e.status.shield=(e.status.shield||0)+30;e.speedFactor*=1.18;e.abilityRate*=.73;p.status.shield=(p.status.shield||0)+14;break;
 }
 switch(g.campaignEvent?.id){
 case 'comet':for(const o of both)o.baseDmg*=1.15;break;
 case 'boost':for(const o of both)o.speedFactor*=1.15;break;
 case 'shield':for(const o of both)o.status.shield=(o.status.shield||0)+12;break;
 case 'magic':for(const o of both)o.abilityRate*=.75;break;
 case 'gift':p.status.shield=(p.status.shield||0)+16;break;
 case 'rival':e.hp+=12;e.mh+=12;p.baseDmg*=1.1;break;
 case 'glass':for(const o of both){o.hp*=.85;o.mh*=.85;o.baseDmg*=1.2;}break;
 }
 for(const o of both){
  o.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(o.hp));o.mh=Math.max(o.hp,Math.round(o.mh));
  o.baseDmg=Math.round(o.baseDmg*100)/100;
  o.abilityCd=Math.max(.3,o.abilityCd*(o.abilityRate||1));
 }
 g.campaignEvent=null;
}
function intermission(g){
 if(!g||g.m!==13||g.rn<1||g.campaignEventHandled===g.rn||g.h[0]<=0||g.h[1]<=0)return false;
 g.campaignEventHandled=g.rn;
 const candidates=EVENTS.filter(e=>e.id!==g.lastEvent);
 const event=candidates[Math.floor(Math.random()*candidates.length)];
 g.lastEvent=event.id;g.campaignEvent=event;g.ph='intermission';
 $('#fire').hidden=true;$('#cards').innerHTML='';
 $('#ov').hidden=false;
 $('#ovb').innerHTML='<h2>'+event.name+'</h2><p style="margin:16px 0">'+event.desc+'</p>'+
   '<p style="color:var(--mu)">Następna runda będzie inna!</p>'+
   '<button class="b graj" onclick="window.BVBCampaign.continueEvent()">⚔️ Następna runda</button>'+
   '<button class="b" onclick="menu()">Menu główne</button>';
 return true;
}
function continueEvent(){if(!G||G.m!==13||G.ph!=='intermission')return;$('#ov').hidden=true;nextRound();}
function onImpact(g){
 if(g?.m!==13)return;g.campaignTotals.hits++;
 if(stage(g.campaignLevel).goal==='hits'&&g.campaignTotals.hits>=4)g.campaignGoalMet=true;
}
function onAbility(g,o){
 if(g?.m!==13||o.team!==0)return;g.campaignTotals.abilities++;
 if(stage(g.campaignLevel).goal==='special'&&g.campaignTotals.abilities>=3)g.campaignGoalMet=true;
}
function onPortal(g,o){
 if(g?.m!==13||o.team!==0)return;g.campaignTotals.portals++;
 if(stage(g.campaignLevel).goal==='portal')g.campaignGoalMet=true;
}
function onRoundEnd(g,winner){
 if(g?.m!==13||winner!==0)return;
 const l=stage(g.campaignLevel),t=g.campaignTotals,p=g.bl.find(o=>o.team===0);if(!p)return;
 const stance=g.tactics?.[0]||'balanced';if(!t.styles.includes(stance))t.styles.push(stance);
 const met={fast:g.rt<=35,hits:t.hits>=4,health:p.hp/Math.max(1,p.mh)>=.4,
 special:t.abilities>=3,rush:stance==='rush',guard:stance==='guard',strike:stance==='strike',
 portal:t.portals>=1,styles:t.styles.length>=2,long:g.rt>=20,close:p.hp/Math.max(1,p.mh)<=.45};
 if(met[l.goal])g.campaignGoalMet=true;
}
function finish(g,won){
 if(g?.m!==13||g.campaignRewarded)return;
 g.campaignRewarded=true;
 const c=saveState(),n=g.campaignLevel,l=stage(n);
 const first=won&&!c.cleared.includes(n);
 const finalTrophy=won&&n===50&&!c.finalWon;
 let coins=0,stars=0;
 if(won){
  if(first)c.cleared.push(n);
  c.unlocked=Math.max(c.unlocked,Math.min(50,n+1));
  coins=first?45+n*6:10+n;
  if(g.campaignGoalMet&&!c.stars.includes(n)){c.stars.push(n);stars=25+n*2;}
  S.coins+=coins+stars;
  if(n===50&&!c.finalWon){c.finalWon=true;S.coins+=500;S.candies=(S.candies||0)+100;}
 }
 save();
 const next=won&&n<50;
 $('#ovb').innerHTML='<h2>'+(won?'🏆 Poziom '+n+' ukończony!':'💔 Spróbuj ponownie')+'</h2>'+
  '<h3>'+esc(l.title)+'</h3>'+
  (won?'<p>+'+coins+' 🪙'+(stars?' · ⭐ Gwiazdka +'+stars+' 🪙':'')+
   '</p><p>'+(next?'🔓 Odblokowano poziom '+(n+1):n===50?'👑 Ukończono 50 poziomów!':'Możesz walczyć o gwiazdkę.')+'</p>'+
   (finalTrophy?'<p>🏆 Finałowy puchar: +500 🪙, +100 🍬 i tytuł „Pogromca Chaosu”!</p>':''):
   '<p>Możesz zmienić skład lub taktykę.</p>')+
  '<button class="b graj" onclick="window.BVBCampaign.start('+(next?n+1:n)+')">'+(next?'➡️ Następny poziom':'🔄 Zagraj ponownie')+'</button>'+
  '<button class="b" onclick="window.BVBCampaign.open()">🗺️ Mapa poziomów</button>'+
  '<button class="b" onclick="menu()">Menu główne</button>';
}
function equip(){
 if(!saveState().finalWon)return;
 S.playerTitle='Pogromca Chaosu';S.playerAura='#facc15';save();render();
}
const oldOver=over;
over=function(){
 const campaign=G?.m===13&&!G.finished,g=campaign?G:null;
 oldOver();if(g)finish(g,g.h[0]>0);
};
window.BVBCampaign={LEVELS,TWISTS,GOALS,EVENTS,open,render,inspect,start,chooseBall,deck,equip,
prepareMatch,setupRound,applyActors,intermission,continueEvent,onImpact,onAbility,onPortal,onRoundEnd,saveState};
})();
