if(Object.keys(authoredUpgrades).length!==114)throw Error('114 authored V2/V3 profiles expected');
function authoredUpgradeDescription(id,stage){
 const actions=authoredUpgrades[id];
 if(!actions||stage<1)return null;
 const extra=stage===2?' oraz '+upgradeCaptions[actions[1]]:'';
 return 'V'+(stage+1)+': '+upgradeCaptions[actions[0]]+extra+'; mocniejsze efekty aktywnej zdolności.';
}
// First individual-rework batch (16–23): the mechanics here are tied to each
// identity's own V1 skill and its triggers, not selected from shared actions.
// Gameplay events, hazards and movement are stored in the authoritative state.
function applySignatureEvolution(o,foe,level){
 const id=o.b.id,color=abilityData[id].color,st=roundState();
 if(id===16){ // Forge: the existing wall-forged pet gets a heat engine.
  o.v2ForgeHeat=Math.min(6,(o.v2ForgeHeat||0)+1);
  o.v2PetPower=Math.min(3,(o.v2PetPower||1)+.25);
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,'pet',26,6,.85+o.v2ForgeHeat*.12);
  if(level===2){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2*o.v2ForgeHeat);
   zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'shock',27,1.9,.40);
  }
  visual(o,o,'orbit',32+level*5,color,.7);
 }else if(id===17){ // Cell: budding makes sustained recovery, mitosis evolves.
  o.v2CellBud={clock:.65,remaining:2+level*2,heal:1.7*level};
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,'slime',25,2.3,.34);
  if(level===2){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+4);
   o.v2MitosisBloom=true;
  }
  visual(o,o,'growth',37+level*5,color,.75);
 }else if(id===18){ // Electrician: arc is stored until the next real impact.
  o.v2ArcUntil=G.rt+2.6+level*.4;
  o.v2ArcContactUsed=false;
  shoot(o,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.13,stun:.14*level,homing:.75,color:'#fde047'});
  if(level===2)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'shock',29,2.2,.42);
  visual(o,foe,'beam',34+level*5,'#fde047',.6);
 }else if(id===19){ // Pressure Zone: mobile aura; V3 generates gravity.
  o.v2Pressure={remaining:2.2+level*.65,next:.1,radius:48+level*13,
   damage:.13+level*.04,pull:level===2?.19:0};
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,'zone',27,2.5,.28);
  visual(o,o,'ring',o.v2Pressure.radius,color,.75);
 }else if(id===20){ // Foresight ray: predictive piercing shot; delayed echo.
  shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.22,ghost:true,homing:.15,speed:265,
   slow:.25+level*.1,color:'#60a5fa'});
  if(level===2){
   o.v2BeamEcho={clock:.47,remaining:1,damage:.44,targetX:foe.x,targetY:foe.y};
   visual(o,foe,'beam',48,color,.8);
  }
 }else if(id===21){ // WDC: numbered 3x3 board central amplifier.
  o.v2MatrixCombo=Math.min(4,(o.v2MatrixCombo||0)+1);
  zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'grid',20,2.5,.13+o.v2MatrixCombo*.035);
  if(level===2){
   for(const [dx,dy] of [[-40,0],[40,0],[0,-40],[0,40]])
    zone(o,Math.max(18,Math.min(342,foe.x+dx)),Math.max(18,Math.min(342,foe.y+dy)),
     'mine',13,2.8,.22);
  }
  visual(o,foe,'clock',41,color,.66);
 }else if(id===22){ // Apple: orchard actually regenerates and grows produce.
  o.v2Orchard={clock:.65,remaining:2+level*2,level};
  shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.12,healOnHit:2.7*level,speed:135,homing:.25,color:'#f59e0b'});
  if(level===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+4);
  visual(o,o,'heal',38,color,.75);
 }else if(id===23){ // Cannon: recharge its wall turret, shell marks the impact.
  o.v2TurretCharge=Math.min(5,(o.v2TurretCharge||0)+1);
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,'turret',27,5.2,.95);
  shoot(o,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.18,speed:128,bounces:1+level,
   knock:.16,color:'#fbbf24'});
  if(level===2){
   const d=Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)||1;
   const lead=Math.min(.42,d/150);
   const x=Math.max(20,Math.min(340,foe.x+foe.vx*80*lead));
   const y=Math.max(20,Math.min(340,foe.y+foe.vy*80*lead));
   zone(o,x,y,'mine',27,3.6,.6);
   visual(o,{x,y},'impact',44,color,.75);
  }
 }else if(id===24){
  o.v2VirusActiveUntil=G.rt+3+level*.6;
  o.v2VirusNextContact=0;
  o.v2VirusMutating=level===2;
  visual(o,o,'growth',38+level*5,color,.75);
 }else if(id===25){
  o.v2BriarUntil=G.rt+3.4+level*.5;
  o.v2BriarGuard=level===2;
  visual(o,o,'shard',35+level*5,color,.72);
 }else if(id===26){
  shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.22,speed:190,life:3.5,
   bounces:3+level*2,ricochetSplit:level===2?1:0,color:'#fef08a'});
  visual(o,foe,'slash',43+level*5,color,.72);
 }else if(id===27){
  o.v2CrownUntil=G.rt+3+level*.7;
  o.v2CrownArmed=level===2;
  visual(o,o,'orbit',34+level*5,color,.72);
 }else if(id===28){
  o.v2Ripples={next:.22,remaining:level===2?4:3,index:0,level};
  visual(o,o,'ring',34+level*7,color,.7);
 }else if(id===29){
  o.v2FrostSteps={next:.1,remaining:3+level*.7,
   lastX:o.x,lastY:o.y,level};
  visual(o,o,'tail',35+level*6,color,.7);
 }else if(id===30){
  if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<245){
   o.v2HarpAnchor={uid:foe.uid,remaining:1.3+level*.3,next:.2,level,pulses:0};
   visual(o,foe,'tether',37+level*5,color,.72);
  }
 }else if(id===31){
  o.v2Hive={remaining:2.6+level*.6,next:.18,
   intercepts:level===2?2:1,level};
  if(level===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+3);
  visual(o,o,'orbit',36+level*5,color,.7);
 }
}
// Batch 32–47: individually authored mechanics. Unlike the fallback
// profiles, every signature uses identity-specific combat state and triggers.
function applySignatureEvolution32(o,foe,level){
 const id=o.b.id,st=roundState(),color=abilityData[id].color;
 if(id===32){ // Alchemist: three reagents, not a flat extra attack.
  const roll=Math.floor((window.BVBRework?.random?.()??Math.random())*3);
  o.v2Catalyst={roll,level,remaining:1.4+level*.35};
  if(roll===0)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'fire',25,2,.35);
  else if(roll===1)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'frost',25,2,.35);
  else{o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+3*level);zone(o,o.x,o.y,'slime',19,2,.25);}
  if(level===2)o.v2Volatile={next:.44,roll,remaining:2};
  visual(o,foe,'dice',36,color,.65);
 }else if(id===33&&false){ // Physical conductor rails handled by beta-only module.
  o.v2Rail={remaining:2.5+level*.5,next:.17,level};
  for(const h of st.hazards){
   if(h.kind==='train'&&h.owner===o.uid&&h.life>0){
    h.v2RailTrain=level;h.v2RailClock=.14;
   }
  }
  if(level===2)o.v2Express={next:.4,remaining:2,level};
  visual(o,o,'train',42,color,.65);
 }else if(id===34){ // Black spider: only real opposite-wall bounces make strands.
  o.v2WidowUntil=G.rt+4+level*.7;
  o.v2WidowLattice=level===2;
  visual(o,o,'web',40,color,.65);
 }else if(id===35){ // Haunted grave: each armed grave has its own afterlife.
  const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'mine',25,4.4,.55);
  if(h){h.v2Grave=level;h.armAt=.5;}
  visual(o,foe,'shadow',40,color,.7);
 }else if(id===36){ // Light flight: afterimage preserves real starting point.
  const origin=o.v2LightOrigin||{x:o.x,y:o.y};
  o.v2LightEcho={x:origin.x,y:origin.y,level,next:.2,remaining:1.6+level*.4};
  if(level===2)o.v2PrismaticReturn={next:.48,remaining:1,from:{x:origin.x,y:origin.y}};
  visual(o,origin,'blink',40,color,.7);
 }else if(id===37){ // Candies: flavor-specific effects in real projectiles.
  const flavors=['frost','sour','spark'];
  const flavor=flavors[Math.floor((window.BVBRework?.random?.()??Math.random())*flavors.length)];
  o.v2CandyFlavor=flavor;
  shoot(o,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.18,slow:flavor==='frost'?.75:0,
   poison:flavor==='sour'?.65:0,stun:flavor==='spark'?.13:0,
   homing:.35,spread:.42,color:flavor==='sour'?'#bef264':flavor==='frost'?'#a5f3fc':'#fde047'});
  if(level===2)o.v2SugarCrystal={next:.45,remaining:2,flavor};
  visual(o,foe,'shard',35,color,.65);
 }else if(id===38){ // Live slime: organic buds grow only as owner moves.
  o.v2SlimeBud={remaining:3+level*.5,next:.13,lastX:o.x,lastY:o.y,level};
  if(level===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+3);
  visual(o,o,'growth',40,color,.75);
 }else if(id===39){ // Chains: an armed mine actually ties the victim on hit.
  const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'mine',23,4.2,.44);
  if(h){h.v2Shackle=level;h.armAt=.48;}
  visual(o,foe,'tether',38,color,.65);
 }else if(id===40){ // Acid: original puddle, with a tracked corrosion process.
  const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'poison',31,3.4,.38);
  if(h)h.v2Acid=level;
  visual(o,foe,'zone',37,color,.65);
 }else if(id===41){ // Wall lens must be produced on a real wall, not cast.
  o.v2LensUntil=G.rt+3.5+level*.5;
  o.v2LensCrossfire=level===2;
  visual(o,o,'beam',38,color,.65);
 }else if(id===42){ // Gas: the cloud drifts and eventually condenses.
  const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'gas',37,3.5,.38);
  if(h){h.v2Drifting=level;h.vx=level===2?42:27;h.vy=level===2?-19:-12;h.v2Condensed=false;}
  visual(o,foe,'zone',43,color,.75);
 }else if(id===43){ // Stars: orbital charge followed by a triad.
  o.v2Stars={next:.3,remaining:level===2?3:2,level};
  visual(o,o,'orbit',39,color,.75);
 }else if(id===44){ // Fibonacci: contact gains numbers from the sequence.
  o.v2FibActiveUntil=G.rt+4+level*.5;
  o.v2GoldenSpiral=level===2;
  o.v2FibHit=0;
  visual(o,o,'clock',40,color,.72);
 }else if(id===45){ // Reactive thorn armor: a genuine collision counter.
  o.v2ArmorUntil=G.rt+3.5+level*.5;
  o.v2ArmorNext=0;
  o.v2LivingArmor=level===2;
  if(level===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+5);
  visual(o,o,'shield',40,color,.65);
 }else if(id===46){ // Delayed bomb: track and split the actual blast.
  const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'mine',29,4.6,.68);
  if(h){h.v2Bomb=level;h.armAt=level===2?.6:.95;}
  visual(o,foe,'clock',42,color,.7);
 }else if(id===47){ // Satellites: orbit mechanics, firing and intercepting.
  o.v2Satellites={next:.18,remaining:2.3+level*.45,level,intercepts:level===2?2:0};
  if(level===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
  visual(o,o,'orbit',42,color,.75);
 }
}
function applyAuthoredUpgrade(o,foe){
 const level=evolutionStage(o),profile=authoredUpgrades[o?.b?.id];
 if(level===0||!profile||!foe||!alive(foe)||netRole==='guest')return;
 const id=o.b.id,boost=level===2?1.28:1,unique=1+(id%5)*.04;
 if(id>=16&&id<=31){applySignatureEvolution(o,foe,level);return;}
 if(id>=32&&id<=47){applySignatureEvolution32(o,foe,level);return;}
 const accent=id>=99?'#d8b4fe':o.b.c;
 function action(kind){
  const color=kind.includes('frost')?'#a5f3fc':kind.includes('venom')?'#bef264':kind.includes('fire')||kind==='burnwave'||kind==='scatterFire'?'#fb923c':accent;
  if(['petBolt','sparkShot','venomShot','pierceShot','healingShot','heavyShot','bounceShot','scatter','frostShot','ghostShot','scatterFire'].includes(kind)){
   const options={damage:o.baseDmg*.18*boost*unique,speed:165,homing:.36,life:2.5,color};
   if(kind==='petBolt'||kind==='sparkShot'){options.stun=.12;options.homing=.65;}
   if(kind==='venomShot')options.poison=.78*boost;
   if(kind==='pierceShot'||kind==='ghostShot'){options.ghost=true;options.homing=.3;}
   if(kind==='healingShot')options.healOnHit=5*boost;
   if(kind==='heavyShot'){options.knock=.24*boost;options.speed=125;}
   if(kind==='bounceShot')options.bounces=2+level;
   if(kind==='scatter'||kind==='scatterFire'){options.count=2;options.spread=.48;}
   if(kind==='frostShot')options.slow=.7*boost;
   if(kind==='scatterFire')options.burn=.65*boost;
   shoot(o,foe,options);
   return;
  }
  if(['shockField','slowField','venomField','thornField','mineField','frostField','fireField'].includes(kind)){
   const name={shockField:'shock',slowField:'slow',venomField:'poison',thornField:'thorn',mineField:'mine',frostField:'frost',fireField:'fire'}[kind];
   const center=kind==='thornField'?o:foe;
   // Existing collision and status systems do the actual work; effects expire
   // through the usual hazard lifecycle and are stored in replay snapshots.
   zone(o,center.x,center.y,name,24+id%7,2.4+level*.25,.27*boost*unique);
   return;
  }
  if(['shockwave','pushwave','burnwave'].includes(kind)){
   const options={radius:kind==='shockwave'?115:kind==='pushwave'?120:108,
    knock:kind==='pushwave'?.18*boost:0,burn:kind==='burnwave'?.6*boost:0,
    stun:kind==='shockwave'?.12:0};
   radial(o,foe,.19*boost*unique,options);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='guard'||kind==='mirror'||kind==='cleanse'){
   o.status||={};
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+5*boost*unique);
   if(kind==='mirror')o.skillReflect=Math.max(o.skillReflect||0,1.25+level*.4);
   if(kind==='cleanse'){
    for(const key of ['poison','slow','burn','weaken'])o.status[key]=0;
   }
   visual(o,o,'shield',33*boost,color,.55);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='healing'){
   o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+5*boost*unique);
   visual(o,o,'heal',32*boost,color,.55);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='pull'){
   const distance=Math.hypot(o.x-foe.x,o.y-foe.y)||1;
   if(distance<230){
    const power=.29*boost*unique;
    foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+(o.x-foe.x)/distance*power;
    foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+(o.y-foe.y)/distance*power;
    setStatus(o,foe,'slow',.4*boost);
   }
   visual(o,foe,'tether',39,color,.6);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='stun'||kind==='weaken'||kind==='lure'){
   if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<220){
    setStatus(o,foe,kind==='stun'?'stun':kind==='weaken'?'weaken':'slow',kind==='stun'?.16:kind==='weaken'?1.0*boost:.6*boost);
    if(kind==='lure'){
     foe.aiTarget={vx:-(foe.vy||0),vy:foe.vx||0};
     foe.aiDecisionClock=Math.max(foe.aiDecisionClock||0,.45*boost);
    }
   }
   visual(o,foe,kind==='lure'?'mirage':'clock',40*boost,color,.6);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='drain'){
   const distance=Math.hypot(o.x-foe.x,o.y-foe.y);
   if(distance<175){
    strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.18*boost*unique,{slow:.2});
    o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+3*boost*unique);
   }
   visual(o,foe,'tether',32*boost,color,.5);
   return;
  }
  if(kind==='echo'){
   // V3 includes more pulses: the standard tick() will trigger them later.
   const pulses=1+level;
   o.v2Echo={clock:.4,remaining:Math.max(o.v2Echo?.remaining||0,pulses),power:.18*boost*unique,radius:118};
   visual(o,o,'ring',39*boost,color,.7);
   return;
  }
  throw new Error('Unknown authored evolution '+kind);
 }
 // V3 retains the exact V2 action, strengthened, then adds a second identity
 // upgrade. No additional gameplay rolls: finishing scene RNG is separate.
 action(profile[0]);
 if(level===2)action(profile[1]);
 // A clearer tier-specific ring is presentation-only; changing reduced-motion
 // settings may suppress it without suppressing the combat mechanics.
 visual(o,o,'ring',level===2?48:31,accent,level===2?.75:.55);
}

const evolutionStage=o=>Math.max(0,Math.min(2,(o?.tier||1)-1));
function evolutionDescription(id,tier=1){
 if(id===130)return window.BVBTrebusz?.description(tier)||'Proca: 1 / 2 / 5 kamieni, naciąg 0,3 s.';
 const kind=abilityData[id]?.kind,stage=Math.max(0,Math.min(2,tier-1));
 if(!stage)return 'V1: podstawowa wersja zdolności.';
 const newer=window.BVBThirdSixteen?.description?.(id,tier);
 if(newer)return newer;
 const next=window.BVBNextSixteen?.description?.(id,tier);
 if(next)return next;
 const bespoke=authoredUpgradeDescription(id,stage);
 if(bespoke)return bespoke;
 const early=window.BVBFirstSixteen?.description?.(id,stage);
 if(early)return early;
 const labels={
 orbit:'więcej ostrzy, większa orbita i dłuższa aktywacja',
 web:'sieć dodatkowo spowalnia'+(stage===2?' i zatruwa':''),
 thorn:'większe i trwalsze kolce przy ścianach',
 charge:'szybsza szarża i więcej ładunków następnego zderzenia',
 dash:'szybszy doskok, dodatkowa osłona i mocniejszy następny kontakt',
 chess:'dodatkowe pociski po ruchu po liniach',
 drain:'większy zasięg wysysania i skuteczniejsze leczenie',
 beam:'dłuższy promień wizualny i dodatkowe spowolnienie; lasery ścienne są szersze',
 tail:'dłuższy jadowity ogon',growth:'większy wzrost i dłuższa strefa szlamu',
 tether:'mocniejsze przyciąganie i dłuższe spowolnienie',
 pet:'pomocnik działa dłużej i strzela silniej',turret:'wieżyczka działa dłużej i strzela silniej',
 train:'większy, trwalszy pociąg',dice:'dłuższe efekty sześciu wyników kostki',
 potion:'większy obszar i trwalsze efekty eliksiru',
 shield:'większa tarcza i oczyszczenie '+(stage===1?'ognia':'ognia, trucizny i spowolnienia'),
 reflect:'większa tarcza i dłuższe odbijanie',heal:'skuteczniejsze leczenie i oczyszczanie statusów',
 blink:stage===1?'pocisk cienia po teleportacji':'dwa pociski cienia i osłona po teleportacji',
 time:'dłuższe zatrzymanie tempa rywala',eclipse:'dłuższe spowolnienie i osłabienie',
 mirage:'większa osłona, silniejszy doskok i dłuższa dezorientacja',
 cyclone:'większy zasięg i mocniejszy odrzut',gravity:'większy zasięg i silniejsze przyciąganie',
 void:'mocniejsze wysysanie energii i leczenie',shadow:'dodatkowe widmowe pociski',
 phoenix:'więcej leczenia i większy pierścień ognia',pumpkin:'większy zasięg fali dyni'
 };
 return 'V'+tier+': '+(labels[kind]||(['zone','gas','poison','grid','mine','doom','lava','sun','echo'].includes(kind)?'większe pola, dłuższe działanie i silniejsze impulsy':'dodatkowe pociski z lepszym naprowadzaniem i podziałem obrażeń salwy'))+'.';
}
function onContact(g,o,foe,base){
 if(!o||!foe||!g||netRole==='guest')return base;
 if(o.v2InfectUntil>g.rt)setStatus(o,foe,'poison',.7+evolutionStage(o)*.2);
 if(o.v2ShockUntil>g.rt)setStatus(o,foe,'stun',.12+evolutionStage(o)*.04);
 if(o.v2ShatterUntil>g.rt){o.v2ShatterUntil=0;shoot(o,foe,{count:3,damage:o.baseDmg*.12,spread:.6,bounces:1});}
 if(o.b.id===8&&(o.skillImpact||0)>0){
  // Spear's finishing thrust applies an actual push on contact.
  // Only the live, recent dash can trigger it; V2/V3 increase its strength.
  const dx=foe.x-o.x,dy=foe.y-o.y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  const power=.22+evolutionStage(o)*.07;
  foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+dx/len*power;
  foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dy/len*power;
  const speed=Math.hypot(foe.vx,foe.vy);
  if(speed>1.35){foe.vx*=1.35/speed;foe.vy*=1.35/speed;}
  o.skillImpact=0; // One thrust per activation; no repeated bonus on the next hit.
 }
 if(o.b.id===18&&evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2ArcUntil>g.rt){
  setStatus(o,foe,'stun',.14+evolutionStage(o)*.075);
  if(evolutionStage(o)===2&&!o.v2ArcContactUsed){
   zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'shock',30,1.55,.48);
   o.v2ArcContactUsed=true;
  }
 }
 if(o.b.id===24&&evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2VirusActiveUntil>g.rt&&
    g.rt>=(o.v2VirusNextContact||0)){
  const stage=evolutionStage(o);
  const infection=foe.v2Viral||{};
  const stacks=Math.min(3,(infection.owner===o.uid?infection.stacks||0:0)+1);
  foe.v2Viral={owner:o.uid,stacks,clock:.46,remaining:stage===2?4:3,
   mutation:stage===2,bloomed:false};
  o.v2VirusNextContact=g.rt+.55;
  setStatus(o,foe,'poison',.9+stacks*.2);
  visual(o,foe,'growth',22+stacks*4,abilityData[24].color,.55);
 }
 if(o.b.id===25&&evolutionStage(o)===2&&o.v2BriarGuard&&o.v2BriarUntil>g.rt){
  const dx=foe.x-o.x,dy=foe.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+dx/d*.2;foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dy/d*.2;
  o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+1.5);
  visual(o,foe,'shard',23,abilityData[25].color,.4);
 }
 if(o.b.id===44){
  o.v2FibHit=Math.min(6,(o.v2FibHit||0)+1);
  const fib=[0,1,1,2,3,5,8][o.v2FibHit];
  base+=Math.min(3,fib*.5); // Preserve original V1 sequence.
  if(evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2FibActiveUntil>g.rt){
   const stage=evolutionStage(o);
   base+=fib*(stage===2?.42:.28);
   o.v2SequenceHits=(o.v2SequenceHits||0)+1;
   if(stage===2&&o.v2GoldenSpiral&&o.v2SequenceHits%3===0){
    radial(o,foe,.22+fib*.018,{radius:80+fib*3,knock:.11});
    o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
    o.v2GoldenPulses=(o.v2GoldenPulses||0)+1;
   }
  }
 }
 if(o.b.id===45&&g.rt>=(o.v1CactusBloomNext||0)){
  // Direct contact disperses a radial ring of seed pods; evolutions add their own counters.
  o.v1CactusBloomNext=g.rt+3.1;
  for(let j=0;j<6;j++){
   const a=j*Math.PI/3+g.rt*.07;
   const hx=clamp(o.x+Math.cos(a)*45,16,344),
    hy=clamp(o.y+Math.sin(a)*45,16,344);
   const seed=zone(o,hx,hy,'thorn',9.5,3.8,.32);
   if(seed){seed.v1CactusSeed=true;seed.armAt=.4;}
  }
  o.v1CactusBlooms=(o.v1CactusBlooms||0)+1;
  visual(o,o,'growth',43,'#a7e968',.7);
 }
 if(o.b.id===45&&evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2ArmorUntil>g.rt&&
   g.rt>=(o.v2ArmorNext||0)){
  const level=evolutionStage(o);
  o.v2ArmorNext=g.rt+.35; // A single real contact cannot multi-trigger.
  strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*(.12+level*.08),{poison:level===2?.3:0});
  o.v2ArmorCounters=(o.v2ArmorCounters||0)+1;
  if(level===2&&o.v2LivingArmor){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
   shoot(o,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.1,
    spread:.3,speed:170,bounces:1,color:'#e5e7eb'});
  }
  visual(o,foe,'shard',27,abilityData[45].color,.55);
 }
 if(o.b.id<16)base=window.BVBFirstSixteen?.onContact?.(G,o,foe,base,first16Api)??base;
 if(o.b.id>=48&&o.b.id<=63)base=window.BVBNextSixteen?.onContact?.(G,o,foe,base,first16Api)??base;
 if(o.b.id>=64&&o.b.id<=79)base=window.BVBThirdSixteen?.onContact?.(G,o,foe,base,first16Api)??base;
 return base;
}

function abilityFor(o){return abilityData[o?.b?.abilityId ?? o?.b?.id] || abilityData[0];}
function roundState(){
 if(!G)return null;
 G.v2 ||= {shots:[],hazards:[],webs:[],wallBeams:[],beams:[],effects:[],tick:0,serial:0};
 return G.v2;
}
function visual(owner,point,kind='burst',size=24,color=null,duration=.48){
 const state=roundState();if(!state)return;
 const pos=point||owner;
 state.effects.push({x:pos.x,y:pos.y,kind,size,color:color||owner?.b?.c||'#fff',age:0,life:duration,id:owner?.b?.id||0});
 if(state.effects.length>35)state.effects.splice(0,state.effects.length-35);
 if(owner && typeof burst==='function')burst(owner,effectType(owner.b),4,false);
}
function setStatus(source,target,key,seconds){
 const kind=abilityFor(source).kind;
 const family=/lava|sun|phoenix|meteor|pumpkin/.test(kind)?'fire':/frost|shard|moon/.test(kind)?'ice':/shock|storm|beam|grid/.test(kind)?'electric':/poison|gas|thorn|web/.test(kind)?'poison':/void|shadow|mirage|doom|eclipse|prism/.test(kind)?'arcane':'physical';
 if(window.BVBRework?.applyStatus){window.BVBRework.applyStatus(target,key,seconds,family);return;}
 if(target.statusImmunities?.includes(key))return;
 target.status||={};target.status[key]=Math.max(target.status[key]||0,Math.min(key==='stun'?.55:5,seconds));
}
function strike(source,target,amount,options={}){
 if(!alive(target))return;
 const raw=Math.max(.5,amount*(source?.status?.weaken>0?.8:1));
 applyDamage(target,window.BVBRework?.abilityDamage?.(source,target,raw) ?? raw);
 for(const key of ['poison','burn','slow','stun'])if(options[key])setStatus(source,target,key,options[key]);
 if(options.knock){
  let dx=target.x-(source?.x||180),dy=target.y-(source?.y||180),d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  target.vx+=dx/d*options.knock;target.vy+=dy/d*options.knock;
  const sp=Math.hypot(target.vx,target.vy);
  if(sp>1.35){target.vx*=1.35/sp;target.vy*=1.35/sp;}
 }
 visual(source,target,'impact',10,source?.b?.c,.28);
}
function shoot(o,foe,opts={}){
 if(!foe||!alive(foe))return;
 const stage=evolutionStage(o),st=roundState(),count=Math.max(1,Math.min(7,(opts.count||1)+stage)),speed=(opts.speed||145)*(1+stage*.04);
 const lead=Math.min(.42,Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)/Math.max(120,speed))*((opts.homing||0)>.5?.85:.55);
 const targetX=Math.max(18,Math.min(342,foe.x+foe.vx*110*lead));
 const targetY=Math.max(18,Math.min(342,foe.y+foe.vy*110*lead));
 const heading=Math.atan2(targetY-o.y,targetX-o.x);
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
  const a=(opts.randomAim?(window.BVBRework?.random?.()??Math.random())*Math.PI*2:heading)+(i-(count-1)/2)*(opts.spread??.18);
  const muzzle=o.b.id===30?o.r*1.55:o.r+5;
  st.shots.push({x:o.x+Math.cos(a)*muzzle,y:o.y+Math.sin(a)*muzzle,
   px:o.x,py:o.y,vx:Math.cos(a)*speed,vy:Math.sin(a)*speed,
   owner:o.uid,team:o.team,id:o.b.id,damage:(opts.damage||o.baseDmg*.45)*(1+stage*.08)*Math.min(1,(opts.count||1)/count),ghost:!!opts.ghost,
   r:opts.r||4,life:opts.life||2.2,age:0,homing:(opts.homing||0)+stage*.18,bounces:(opts.bounces||0)+(abilityFor(o).kind==='arrow'?stage:0),
   healOnHit:(opts.healOnHit||0)*Math.min(1,(opts.count||1)/count),slow:opts.slow||0,poison:opts.poison||0,burn:opts.burn||0,stun:opts.stun||0,
   knock:opts.knock||0,ricochetSplit:opts.ricochetSplit||0,
   starTrail:!!opts.starTrail,color:opts.color||abilityData[o.b.id].color});
 }
 if(st.shots.length>80)st.shots.splice(0,st.shots.length-80);
 visual(o,o,'charge',17,abilityData[o.b.id].color,.34);
}
function zone(o,x,y,kind='zone',radius=29,life=3,power=1){
 const stage=evolutionStage(o);radius*=1+stage*.1;life*=1+stage*.15;power*=1+stage*.1;
 const st=roundState();if(!st)return;
 if(['pet','turret'].includes(kind)){const old=st.hazards.find(h=>h.owner===o.uid&&h.kind===kind&&h.life>0);if(old){old.life=Math.max(old.life,life);old.max=Math.max(old.max,life);old.power=Math.max(old.power,power);return old;}}
 const hazard={x,y,kind,owner:o.uid,team:o.team,id:o.b.id,radius,life,max:life,
  power,age:0,cooldown:0,armAt:kind==='doom'?1:kind==='mine'?.75:kind==='echo'?.5:0,nextShot:.35,color:abilityData[o.b.id].color};
 st.hazards.push(hazard);
 if(st.hazards.length>45)st.hazards.splice(0,st.hazards.length-45);
 visual(o,{x,y},'circle',radius,abilityData[o.b.id].color,.55);
 return hazard;
}
function radial(o,foe,mult=.55,opts={}){
 opts={...opts,radius:(opts.radius||93)*(1+evolutionStage(o)*.1)};
 if(!foe||!alive(foe))return;
 visual(o,o,'ring',Math.max(o.r+12,Math.min(110,opts.radius||60)),abilityData[o.b.id].color,.65);
 if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<(opts.radius||93))strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*mult,opts);
}
function dash(o,foe,strength=.32,opts={}){
 if(!foe)return;const stage=evolutionStage(o);strength+=stage*.1;const d=Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)||1;
 o.vx=(foe.x-o.x)/d*(1+strength);o.vy=(foe.y-o.y)/d*(1+strength);
 o.skillImpact=Math.max(o.skillImpact||0,1.5+stage*.25);
 if(stage)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+stage*2);
 if(opts.shield)o.status.shield=(o.status.shield||0)+opts.shield;
 visual(o,o,'slash',39,abilityData[o.b.id].color,.55);
}
function webPoint(o,side){
 const st=roundState();if(!st)return;
 const p={x:o.x,y:o.y,side};
 const start=o.v2WallAnchor;
 if(start&&start.side!==side){
  st.webs.push({a:start,b:p,team:o.team,id:o.b.id,owner:o.uid,stage:evolutionStage(o),inside:{},color:o.b.id===34||o.b.id===117?'#aa83da':'#d4e7ff'});
  visual(o,{x:(start.x+p.x)/2,y:(start.y+p.y)/2},'web',38,'#dcecff',.7);
 }
 o.v2WallAnchor=p;
}
// Bespoke bounce consequences must use the actual collided wall and live
// hazards. They cannot be simulated by a preview or a generic on-cast action.
function signatureWall32(o,side,st){
 const id=o.b.id,stage=evolutionStage(o);
 if(!stage)return;
 if(id===33&&false&&o.v2Rail){
  const train=st.hazards.findLast(h=>h.kind==='train'&&h.owner===o.uid&&h.life>0);
  if(train){train.v2RailTrain=stage;train.v2RailClock=.16;}
  if(stage===2){
   const express=zone(o,o.x,o.y,'train',21,2.25,.42);
   if(express){
    express.vx=side==='top'||side==='bottom'?175:0;
    express.vy=side==='left'||side==='right'?175:0;
    express.v2RailTrain=stage;express.v2RailClock=.2;
   }
  }
 }else if(id===34&&o.v2WidowUntil>G.rt){
  const old=o.v2WidowLast;
  if(old&&old.side!==side){
   const shift=20;
   const path=(dir)=>{
    const a={x:clamp(old.x+dir*shift,12,348),y:clamp(old.y-dir*shift,12,348)};
    const b={x:clamp(o.x-dir*shift,12,348),y:clamp(o.y+dir*shift,12,348)};
    st.webs.push({a,b,team:o.team,id:34,owner:o.uid,stage,
     inside:{},color:'#a78bfa'});
   };
   path(1);if(stage===2)path(-1);
   if(st.webs.length>16)st.webs.splice(0,st.webs.length-16);
  }
  o.v2WidowLast={x:o.x,y:o.y,side};
 }else if(id===41&&o.v2LensUntil>G.rt){
  const draw=(a,b,width)=>{
   st.wallBeams.push({a,b,owner:o.uid,team:o.team,color:abilityData[41].color,
    life:2.1+stage*.25,width,inside:{}});
  };
  const end={x:clamp(W-o.x,10,350),y:clamp(W-o.y,10,350)};
  draw({x:o.x,y:o.y},end,3+stage);
  if(stage===2){
   draw({x:o.x,y:clamp(W-o.y,10,350)},
    {x:clamp(W-o.x,10,350),y:o.y},4);
   // Focused crossing pulse: a third beam would otherwise add many hits.
   o.v2LensFocus={next:.35,remaining:1};
  }
  if(st.wallBeams.length>12)st.wallBeams.splice(0,st.wallBeams.length-12);
 }
}
function onWall(o,side){
 const d=abilityFor(o);if(!d)return;
 const st=roundState();if(!st)return;
 if(o.v2LastSide===side&&(G.rt-(o.v2LastWallAt||0))<.12)return;
 o.v2LastSide=side;o.v2LastWallAt=G.rt||0;
 if(d.kind==='web'){
  if(o.b.id===34){ // Black Spider has venom nests instead of white Spider's cords.
   const h=zone(o,o.x,o.y,'poison',17,3,.24);
   if(h)h.v1WidowNest=true;
   o.v1WidowNests=(o.v1WidowNests||0)+1;
   webPoint(o,side); // Preserve Black Spider's recognizable wall-web identity.
  }else webPoint(o,side);
 }
 if(d.kind==='pet')o.v2PetPower=Math.min(1.5,(o.v2PetPower||1)+.1);
 if(d.kind==='thorn')zone(o,o.x,o.y,'thorn',15,16,.65);
 if(d.kind==='beam'&&o.b.id===41){
  const vertical=side==='left'||side==='right';
  st.wallBeams.push({a:{x:vertical?o.x:0,y:vertical?0:o.y},
   b:{x:vertical?o.x:W,y:vertical?W:o.y},owner:o.uid,
   team:o.team,color:d.color,life:3.4+evolutionStage(o)*.5,width:2+evolutionStage(o)*2,inside:{}});
  if(st.wallBeams.length>12)st.wallBeams.splice(0,st.wallBeams.length-12);
  visual(o,o,'beam',23,d.color,.48);
 }
 if(d.kind==='turret'||d.kind==='pet')zone(o,o.x,o.y,d.kind,23,4,.65);
 if(d.kind==='train'&&o.b.id!==33){
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,'train',20,2.5,.65);
  const train=st.hazards[st.hazards.length-1];
  train.vx=side==='left'?160:side==='right'?-160:0;
  train.vy=side==='top'?160:side==='bottom'?-160:0;
 }
 if(d.kind==='grid'&&o.b.id===27)zone(o,o.x,o.y,'shock',30,2,.55);
 if(o.b.id===27&&o.v1CrownCircuit?.until>G.rt){
  const offset=side==='left'||side==='right'?{x:0,y:25}:{x:25,y:0};
  zone(o,clamp(o.x+offset.x,15,345),clamp(o.y+offset.y,15,345),
   'shock',19+o.v1CrownCircuit.stored*2,2,.35);
  o.v1CrownPylons=(o.v1CrownPylons||0)+1;
 }
 if(d.kind==='frost'&&o.b.id===29)zone(o,o.x,o.y,'frost',19,3,.38);
 if(o.b.id===16&&evolutionStage(o)>0){
  o.v2ForgeHeat=Math.min(6,(o.v2ForgeHeat||0)+1);
  const forge=st.hazards.find(h=>h.owner===o.uid&&h.kind==='pet'&&h.life>0);
  if(forge){
   forge.power=Math.min(2.8,forge.power+.11);
   forge.nextShot=Math.min(forge.nextShot||0,.45);
  }
  if(evolutionStage(o)===2){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+1.5);
   zone(o,o.x,o.y,'shock',19,1.2,.24);
  }
 }
 if(o.b.id===23&&evolutionStage(o)>0){
  const turret=st.hazards.find(h=>h.owner===o.uid&&h.kind==='turret'&&h.life>0);
  if(turret){
   turret.power=Math.min(2.8,turret.power+.12);
   turret.nextShot=Math.min(turret.nextShot||0,.5);
  }
 }
 if(o.b.id===25&&evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2BriarUntil>G.rt){
  // The thorns physically attach to the wall struck, not the enemy location.
  const vertical=side==='left'||side==='right',stage=evolutionStage(o);
  const offsets=stage===2?[-42,-21,21,42]:[-22,22];
  for(const shift of offsets){
   const x=vertical?o.x:clamp(o.x+shift,18,342);
   const y=vertical?clamp(o.y+shift,18,342):o.y;
   zone(o,x,y,'thorn',15+stage*2,6,.36+stage*.06);
  }
  if(stage===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
 }
 if(o.b.id===27&&evolutionStage(o)>0&&o.v2CrownUntil>G.rt){
  const vertical=side==='left'||side==='right',stage=evolutionStage(o);
  for(const shift of (stage===2?[-44,-22,22,44]:[-28,28])){
   const x=vertical?o.x:clamp(o.x+shift,18,342);
   const y=vertical?clamp(o.y+shift,18,342):o.y;
   zone(o,x,y,'shock',19+stage*2,2.4,.35+stage*.04);
  }
  if(stage===2)o.v2CrownDelayed={next:.42,remaining:1};
 }
 if(d.kind==='charge'){o.skillCharge=Math.min(5,(o.skillCharge||0)+1);}
 signatureWall32(o,side,st);
 if(o.b.id<16)window.BVBFirstSixteen?.onWall?.(G,o,side,first16Api);
 if(o.b.id>=48&&o.b.id<=63)window.BVBNextSixteen?.onWall?.(G,o,side,first16Api);
 if(o.b.id>=64&&o.b.id<=79)window.BVBThirdSixteen?.onWall?.(G,o,side,first16Api);
 if(o.b.id===25)for(const h of st.hazards)if(h.id===25&&h.owner===o.uid&&h.kind==='thorn'&&h.age===0)h.v1GiantPiston=true;
}
function cooldown(o){
 if(o.b.id===130)return 3;
 const d=abilityFor(o);const rate=Math.max(.55,Math.min(1.5,o.abilityRate||1));
 return Math.max(2.25,(d?.cooldown||4)*rate*(o.tier===3?.78:o.tier===2?.90:1));
}

function distinctFirstFortyEightV1(o,foe){
 const id=o.b.id,st=roundState();if(!st)return;
 const level=evolutionStage(o);
 if(id===15){
  // Hook sweeps the victim tangentially; Harpoon (30) reels on a straight axis.
  const dx=foe.x-o.x,dy=foe.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
  foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)-dy/d*.12;foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dx/d*.12;
  o.v1HookOrbit=(o.v1HookOrbit||0)+1;
 }else if(id===36&&level===0){
  // V1 wings leave a delayed, damaging arc along the actual flight path.
  const from=o.v2LightOrigin||{x:o.x,y:o.y};
  o.v1LightAfterimage={x:from.x,y:from.y,next:(G.rt||0)+.34};
 }else if(id===35&&st.hazards.length){
  // A haunting grave remembers its victim instead of just being a timed bomb.
  const h=st.hazards[st.hazards.length-1];
  if(h.id===35&&h.kind==='mine'&&level===0)h.v1HauntedGrave=true;
 }else if(id===39&&st.hazards.length){
  const h=st.hazards[st.hazards.length-1];
  if(h.id===39&&h.kind==='mine'&&level===0)h.v1ShackleTrap=true;
 }else if(id===40&&st.hazards.length){
  // Acid erodes armor on real puddle contact; virus is carried by touch.
  const h=st.hazards[st.hazards.length-1];
  if(h.id===40&&h.kind==='poison'&&level===0)h.v1CorrosivePuddle=true;
 }else if(id===41){
  // Photons travel along a reflected diagonal instead of Laser's wall scan.
  st.wallBeams.push({a:{x:0,y:clamp(o.y-45,15,345)},
   b:{x:W,y:clamp(foe.y+45,15,345)},owner:o.uid,team:o.team,
   color:abilityData[41].color,life:1.1+level*.15,width:1.8+level*.4,inside:{}});
  if(st.wallBeams.length>12)st.wallBeams.splice(0,st.wallBeams.length-12);
  o.v1PrismReflections=(o.v1PrismReflections||0)+1;
 }else if(id===43){
  // Shuriken returns on walls; rifle and thief projectiles do not share its path.
  for(const shot of st.shots.filter(p=>p.id===43&&p.owner===o.uid&&p.age===0)){
   shot.bounces=Math.max(2,shot.bounces);shot.starTrail=false; // V3 alone leaves electric ricochet marks.
   shot.homing=.04;shot.ricochetSplit=Math.max(shot.ricochetSplit||0,level===2?1:0);
  }
 }else if(id===46&&st.hazards.length){
  const h=st.hazards[st.hazards.length-1];
  if(h.id===46&&h.kind==='mine'&&level===0){
   h.armAt=1.25;h.v1TimedBomb=true;h.color='#fb923c';
  }
 }else if(id===47&&o.axeOrbit&&level===0){
  // V1 Orbita protects its owner; Topór and Ostrze are primarily offensive.
  o.v1OrbitShield={remaining:1,expires:(G.rt||0)+2.3};
  o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
 }
}

const first16Api={shoot,zone,radial,dash,strike,setStatus,visual,roundState,evolutionStage,alive};
function cast(o,foe){
 if(!o||!foe||!alive(foe)||!G)return;
 const d=abilityFor(o),kind=d.kind;
 if(kind==='trebusz'){window.BVBTrebusz?.cast(G,o,foe);return;}
 const scale=Math.min(1.26,1+(Math.max(1,o.tier||1)-1)*.12);
 const delta=Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y);
 const lowHp=o.hp/Math.max(1,o.mh)<.35;
 o.attackGlow=.7;G.v2SkillId=o.b.id;
 G.pop ||= [];
 if(G.pop.length<24)G.pop.push({x:o.x,y:Math.max(22,o.y-o.r-24),age:0,life:1.1,
  text:d.title.length>21?d.title.slice(0,20)+'…':d.title,c:d.color});
 if(o.b.id>=48&&o.b.id<=63&&window.BVBNextSixteen?.onCast){
  window.BVBNextSixteen.onCast(G,o,foe,first16Api);
  return;
 }
 if(o.b.id>=64&&o.b.id<=79&&window.BVBThirdSixteen?.onCast){
  window.BVBThirdSixteen.onCast(G,o,foe,first16Api);
  return;
 }
 switch(kind){
 case 'web': visual(o,o,'web',27,d.color,.5);break; // webs form only on actual wall impacts
 case 'charge': o.skillCharge=Math.min(5,(o.skillCharge||0)+1+evolutionStage(o));dash(o,foe,.22);break;
 case 'orbit':
  // Real gameplay blades: persistent, visible and collision-tested on every tick.
  o.skillSpin=(o.skillSpin||0)+1;
  o.axeOrbit={life:2.35+evolutionStage(o)*.35,angle:0,radius:o.r+20+evolutionStage(o)*6+(o.b.id===1&&lowHp?9:0),blades:Math.min(6,3+evolutionStage(o)+(o.b.id===4?Math.floor(o.skillSpin/2):0)),nextHit:Object.create(null),color:d.color};
  visual(o,o,'orbit',34,d.color,.45);break;
 case 'thorn': visual(o,o,'charge',24,d.color,.5);break; // only walls create spikes
 case 'volley':
  if(o.b.id===37){ // Candy uses a sticky bouncing cone rather than a copied volley.
   shoot(o,foe,{count:3,damage:o.baseDmg*.25,spread:.5,slow:.32,
    speed:142,bounces:1,r:5,color:'#f9a8d4'});
   const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'slow',17,1.9,.26);
   if(h)h.v1CandyGlaze=true;
   o.v1CandyGlazes=(o.v1CandyGlazes||0)+1;
  }else shoot(o,foe,{count:o.b.id===5?5:o.b.id===43?3:o.b.id===3?2:3,
   damage:o.baseDmg*(o.b.id===5?.2:.36)*scale,homing:.2,spread:.22,
   speed:lowHp&&o.b.id===3?195:168});
  break;
 case 'drain':
  if(delta<128+evolutionStage(o)*22){strike(o,foe,Math.min(8,foe.hp*.06)*scale,{slow:.25});
    o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+Math.min(9,o.baseDmg*.4)*(1+evolutionStage(o)*.15));}
  else dash(o,foe,.15);
  visual(o,o,'tether',25,d.color,.58);break;
 case 'dash':
  if(o.b.id===36)o.v2LightOrigin={x:o.x,y:o.y};
  dash(o,foe,o.b.id===108&&lowHp?.6:.35,{shield:o.b.id===114?6:0});
  // The light-ball's advertised impact wave must really hit nearby enemies,
  // not merely recolor the standard dash. Evolutions widen the hit area.
  if(o.b.id===9)radial(o,foe,.32,{radius:90,knock:.24});
  break;
 case 'chess':
  o.vx=Math.abs(foe.x-o.x)>Math.abs(foe.y-o.y)?Math.sign(foe.x-o.x)||1:0;
  o.vy=o.vx===0?Math.sign(foe.y-o.y)||1:0;
  visual(o,o,'chess',42,d.color,.65);
  if(evolutionStage(o))shoot(o,foe,{count:evolutionStage(o),damage:o.baseDmg*.14,spread:.7});
  if(delta<96)strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.55,{knock:.24});break;
 case 'dice': {
  const roll=Math.floor((window.BVBRework?.random?.()??Math.random())*6);o.v2LastRoll=roll+1;
  if(roll===0)shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.45});
  if(roll===1)setStatus(o,foe,'slow',.8+evolutionStage(o)*.2);
  if(roll===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+9+evolutionStage(o)*2);
  if(roll===3)o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+5+evolutionStage(o));
  if(roll===4)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'fire',26,2,.45);
  if(roll===5)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'poison',30,3,.38);
  visual(o,o,'dice',28,d.color,.6);break;
 }
 case 'potion': {
  const roll=Math.floor((window.BVBRework?.random?.() ?? Math.random())*3);
  if(o.b.id===32){ // Potion: three actual randomly selected chemical zones.
   const reagent=['fire','frost','poison'][roll];
   const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,reagent,29,2.6,.37);
   if(h)h.v1Elixir=reagent;
   o.v1LastReagent=reagent;
   visual(o,foe,'dice',28,d.color,.55);
  }else
  if(o.b.id===95){if(roll===0)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'fire',30,2.4,.4);else if(roll===1)shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.35,slow:.85});else o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+9+evolutionStage(o)*2);}
  else if(o.b.id===127){if(roll===0)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'poison',30,2.8,.38);else if(roll===1)shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.35,slow:.85});else o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+6+evolutionStage(o));}
  else if(roll===0)shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.45,slow:.65,color:d.color});
  else if(roll===1)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'poison',30,2.8,.38);
  else {o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+9+evolutionStage(o)*2);visual(o,o,'shield',33,d.color,.55);}
  break;
 }
 case 'frost':
  if(o.b.id===29){
   // Frost leaves a cold wake; the earlier ice identity releases shards.
   o.v1FrostWake={lastX:o.x,lastY:o.y,next:.3,remaining:2.3};
   zone(o,o.x,o.y,'frost',16,2.2,.32);
   visual(o,o,'tail',31,'#b2faff',.5);
  }else shoot(o,foe,{count:3,damage:o.baseDmg*.24,slow:1.05,spread:.26,color:'#a5f3fc'});
  break;
 case 'beam':{
  const lead=.19,target={x:foe.x+foe.vx*22*lead,y:foe.y+foe.vy*22*lead};
  roundState().beams.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,x2:target.x,y2:target.y,color:d.color,life:.35+evolutionStage(o)*.1,max:.35+evolutionStage(o)*.1,id:o.b.id});
  strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.43*scale,{slow:evolutionStage(o)*.15,stun:o.b.id===20?.12:0});
  if(o.b.id===20)o.v1ForesightMark={next:.28,remaining:1,
   x:clamp(target.x,12,348),y:clamp(target.y,12,348)};
  visual(o,o,'beam',23,d.color,.55);break;
 }
 case 'tail':case 'growth':{
  o.skillScale=Math.min(1.23,(o.skillScale||1)+.025+evolutionStage(o)*.01);
  if(kind==='tail')o.v2Tail={life:3.5+evolutionStage(o)*.5,length:Math.min(9,5+evolutionStage(o)*2+Math.floor((o.skillScale-1)*15)),nextHit:0};
  else {o.v2BaseRadius??=o.r;o.r=Math.min(o.v2BaseRadius*1.23,o.v2BaseRadius*o.skillScale);}
  o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+3.3*scale);
  zone(o,o.x,o.y,kind==='tail'?'tail':'slime',24,3,.29);
  if(o.b.id===38)o.v1StickyMass={remaining:2.4,next:.24,lastX:o.x,lastY:o.y};
  if(o.b.id===17){
   o.v1CellDivision={next:.28,remaining:1+evolutionStage(o),originX:o.x,originY:o.y};
  }
  visual(o,o,'growth',28,d.color,.7);break;
 }
 case 'tether':
  if(delta<240+evolutionStage(o)*15){const f=.32+evolutionStage(o)*.08;foe.vx+=(o.x-foe.x)/Math.max(1,delta)*f;
   foe.vy+=(o.y-foe.y)/Math.max(1,delta)*f;
   strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.4,{slow:.45+evolutionStage(o)*.2});}
  roundState().beams.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,x2:foe.x,y2:foe.y,color:d.color,life:.3,max:.3,id:o.b.id});
  visual(o,o,'tether',20,d.color,.4);break;
 case 'pet':case 'turret':zone(o,o.x,o.y,kind,22,5,.7);break;
 case 'train':{if(o.b.id===33)break;zone(o,o.x,o.y,kind,22,3,.7);const h=roundState().hazards.at(-1),a=Math.atan2(foe.y+foe.vy*50-o.y,foe.x+foe.vx*50-o.x);h.vx=Math.cos(a)*160;h.vy=Math.sin(a)*160;break;}
 case 'shock':case 'storm':
  shoot(o,foe,{count:kind==='storm'?3:o.b.id===83?2:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.32,stun:.22,homing:.45,color:'#fde047',spread:.23,randomAim:kind==='storm'});o.v2ShockUntil=G.rt+1.5+evolutionStage(o)*.2;break;
 case 'zone':case 'gas':case 'poison':
  if(o.b.id===24){
   // V1 is contact-only; V2 incubates at the target, V3 spreads the strain.
   const stage=evolutionStage(o);
   o.v1VirusCarrier={until:G.rt+3.5,next:0};
   o.v2InfectUntil=G.rt+3.5;
   if(stage>0)zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'poison',17+stage*7,2.1+stage*.5,.23+stage*.1);
   if(stage===2)zone(o,clamp(foe.x+28,15,345),clamp(foe.y-28,15,345),'poison',19,2.2,.27);
   visual(o,o,'growth',32,d.color,.55);
  }else if(o.b.id===19){
   zone(o,o.x,o.y,'zone',31,3.1,.38);
   o.v1PressureImpulse={next:.3,remaining:2.2};
   visual(o,o,'ring',39,d.color,.53);
  }else if(o.b.id===42){ // Gas moves, acid remains as a puddle.
   const h=zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'gas',33,3,.37);
   if(h){h.v1Gas=true;h.vx=9;h.vy=-5;}
  }else zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,kind,kind==='gas'?38:30,3,.42);
  break;
 case 'grid':
  if(o.b.id===27){ // Crown stores charges at the walls; WDC uses a numbered 3x3 board.
   o.v1CrownCircuit={until:G.rt+3.3,stored:Math.min(3,(o.v1CrownStored||0)+1)};
   o.v1CrownStored=o.v1CrownCircuit.stored;
   zone(o,o.x,o.y,'shock',24,2.1,.30);
   visual(o,o,'orbit',35,d.color,.55);
  }else for(let x=-1;x<=1;x++)for(let y=-1;y<=1;y++)
   zone(o,clamp(foe.x+x*31,12,348),clamp(foe.y+y*31,12,348),
    'grid',16,2.8,.06+(x+1)*.02+(y+1)*.01);
  break;
 case 'healshot':
  shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.38,healOnHit:7*scale,speed:170,homing:.3,color:'#fbbf24'});break;
 case 'arrow':
  shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.6,bounces:3,speed:180,r:3,color:'#fef08a'});break;
 case 'pulse':case 'wave':case 'quake':case 'nova':
  if(o.b.id===74||o.b.id===120)o.v2Echo={clock:.35,remaining:2+evolutionStage(o),power:.18,radius:100};
  radial(o,foe,kind==='nova'?.73:.5,{radius:kind==='wave'?155:kind==='nova'?130:100,
     knock:kind==='wave'||kind==='quake'?.36:.18,slow:kind==='pulse'?.18:0});break;
 case 'swarm':shoot(o,foe,{count:o.b.id===31?3:2,damage:o.baseDmg*.22,homing:2.5,
   poison:o.b.id===31?.8:0,speed:118,life:3.1,color:d.color});break;
 case 'mine':{const stage=evolutionStage(o),lead=.75*110*(foe.actualPace||1.38);for(let i=0;i<=stage;i++)zone(o,clamp(foe.x+foe.vx*lead+(i-stage/2)*26,20,340),clamp(foe.y+foe.vy*lead,20,340),'mine',24,5,.72/(1+stage*.3));break;}
 case 'reflect':case 'shield':
  if(o.b.id===45){ // Living cactus: seeds root into collidable thorn sprouts.
   const angle=Math.atan2(foe.y-o.y,foe.x-o.x);
   for(let j=-1;j<=1;j++){
    const a=angle+j*.7,x=clamp(foe.x+Math.cos(a)*31,17,343),
     y=clamp(foe.y+Math.sin(a)*31,17,343);
    const seed=zone(o,x,y,'thorn',11,4,.36);
    if(seed){seed.v1CactusSeed=true;seed.armAt=.36;}
   }
   o.v1CactusLaunches=(o.v1CactusLaunches||0)+1;
   visual(o,foe,'growth',36,'#9adb61',.65);
   break;
  }
  if(o.b.id===96){o.status.stun=0;o.status.slow=0;o.status.weaken=0;}
  o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+(kind==='shield'?13:8)*scale);
  o.skillReflect=kind==='reflect'?1.7+evolutionStage(o)*.4:0;
  if(kind==='shield'&&evolutionStage(o)){o.status.burn=0;if(evolutionStage(o)===2){o.status.poison=0;o.status.slow=0;}}
  visual(o,o,'shield',34,d.color,.68);break;
 case 'heal':
  o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+7*scale);o.status.shield=Math.min(26,(o.status.shield||0)+5);
  if(evolutionStage(o))o.status.burn=0;if(evolutionStage(o)===2){o.status.poison=0;o.status.slow=0;}
  visual(o,o,'heal',30,'#86efac',.62);break;
 case 'shard':
  shoot(o,foe,{count:5,damage:o.baseDmg*.25,spread:.28,speed:165,bounces:1,slow:o.b.id===129?.35:0,color:d.color});
  o.v2ShatterUntil=G.rt+2;visual(o,o,'shard',32,d.color,.5);break;
 case 'blink':{
  const a=Math.atan2(o.y-foe.y,o.x-foe.x)+((window.BVBRework?.random?.() ?? Math.random())-.5)*1.1;
  o.x=clamp(foe.x+Math.cos(a)*80,o.r,W-o.r);
  o.y=clamp(foe.y+Math.sin(a)*80,o.r,W-o.r);
  if(evolutionStage(o))shoot(o,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.14,ghost:true,homing:.6});if(evolutionStage(o)===2)o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
  visual(o,o,'blink',33,d.color,.65);break;
 }
 case 'time':case 'eclipse':
  setStatus(o,foe,'slow',(kind==='time'?1.2:.7)*(1+evolutionStage(o)*.2));
  if(kind==='eclipse')setStatus(o,foe,'weaken',1.6+evolutionStage(o)*.3);
  visual(o,foe,'clock',41,d.color,.75);break;
 case 'lava':case 'sun':
  zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,kind==='lava'?'fire':'sun',31,2.8,.52);break;
 case 'meteor':shoot(o,foe,{count:3,damage:o.baseDmg*.29,spread:.36,burn:.65,bounces:1,speed:145});break;
 case 'cyclone':case 'gravity':{
  const dir=kind==='gravity'?-1:1;
  foe.vx+=(foe.x-o.x)/Math.max(1,delta)*(.26+evolutionStage(o)*.07)*dir;foe.vy+=(foe.y-o.y)/Math.max(1,delta)*(.26+evolutionStage(o)*.07)*dir;
  radial(o,foe,.29,{radius:175,knock:kind==='cyclone'?.2:0});break;
 }
 case 'prism':shoot(o,foe,{count:3,damage:o.baseDmg*.3,spread:.33,color:'#a5b4fc'});break;
 case 'echo':{
  radial(o,foe,.32,{radius:130});
  o.v2Echo={clock:.5,remaining:1+evolutionStage(o),power:.22,radius:130};break;
 }
 case 'shadow':shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.42,slow:.38,ghost:true,homing:.5,color:d.color});break;
 case 'void':
  strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.42,{slow:.38});
  o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+2+evolutionStage(o));
  visual(o,foe,'shadow',32,d.color,.65);break;
 case 'moon':shoot(o,foe,{count:2,damage:o.baseDmg*.38,spread:.17,bounces:1,color:'#c4b5fd'});break;
 case 'mirage':o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+8+evolutionStage(o)*2);foe.aiTarget={vx:-foe.vy,vy:foe.vx};foe.aiDecisionClock=.4+evolutionStage(o)*.2;dash(o,foe,.12);visual(o,o,'mirage',35,d.color,.6);break;
 case 'doom':zone(o,foe.x,foe.y,'doom',22,2,.65);roundState().hazards.at(-1).targetUid=foe.uid;break;
 case 'phoenix':o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+4+evolutionStage(o)*2);zone(o,o.x,o.y,'fire',31,3,.32);break;
 case 'pumpkin':radial(o,foe,.47,{radius:115,knock:.18});break;
 default:shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.5,homing:.15});
 }
 if(o.b.id<16)window.BVBFirstSixteen?.onCast?.(G,o,foe,first16Api);
 if(o.b.id<48)distinctFirstFortyEightV1(o,foe);
 applyAuthoredUpgrade(o,foe);
 if(typeof snd==='function'&&o.b.id%5===0)snd(420+(o.b.id*19)%650,.11,'triangle',.018,180);
}
const oldSpecial=specialAbility;
specialAbility=cast;
// Cell's one-time mitosis is part of its single growth ability.
const previousApply=applyDamage;
applyDamage=function(target,damage){
 previousApply(target,damage);
 if(target?.b?.id===17&&target.hp<=0&&!target.v2MitosisUsed){
  target.v2MitosisUsed=true;target.hp=Math.max(1,Math.round(target.mh*.24));
  target.r=Math.max(10,target.r*.68);
  target.status.shield=(target.status.shield||0)+5;
  if(evolutionStage(target)>0){
   const level=evolutionStage(target);
   target.hp=Math.max(target.hp,Math.round(target.mh*(level===2?.39:.3)));
   target.v2CellBud={clock:.35,remaining:level===2?5:3,heal:level===2?3:2};
   zone(target,target.x,target.y,'slime',level===2?43:30,2.6+level,.48);
   if(level===2&&target.v2MitosisBloom)target.status.shield=Math.min(32,(target.status.shield||0)+9);
  }
  visual(target,target,'growth',32,'#5eead4',.95);
 }
};
function closestToSegment(px,py,ax,ay,bx,by){
 const dx=bx-ax,dy=by-ay,t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,((px-ax)*dx+(py-ay)*dy)/(dx*dx+dy*dy||1)));
 return Math.hypot(px-(ax+t*dx),py-(ay+t*dy));
}
// Periodic parts of the sixteen identity-specific evolutions. Each branch
// is an effect of a distinct ability: rolls, trains, graves, light, candy,
// slime, chains, acid, lenses, stars or orbiting defensive satellites.
function afflictedTick32(o,dt){
 if(o.v2Haunted){
  const curse=o.v2Haunted;curse.next-=dt;
  if(curse.next<=0){
   const source=G.bl.find(t=>t.uid===curse.owner&&alive(t));
   if(source){
    strike(source,o,source.baseDmg*(curse.level===2?.16:.10),{slow:.22});
    if(curse.level===2)setStatus(source,o,'weaken',.35);
   }
   curse.remaining--;curse.next+=.5;
   if(curse.remaining<=0)o.v2Haunted=null;
  }
 }
 if(o.v2Shackled){
  const chain=o.v2Shackled;chain.next-=dt;
  if(chain.next<=0){
   const source=G.bl.find(t=>t.uid===chain.owner&&alive(t));
   if(source){
    const dx=source.x-o.x,dy=source.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    const power=chain.level===2?.27:.17;
    o.vx=(o.vx||0)+dx/d*power;o.vy=(o.vy||0)+dy/d*power;
    setStatus(source,o,'slow',chain.level===2?.65:.42);
    if(chain.level===2&&chain.remaining===1)
     setStatus(source,o,'stun',.2);
   }
   chain.remaining--;chain.next+=.37;
   if(chain.remaining<=0)o.v2Shackled=null;
  }
 }
 if(o.v2Corrosion){
  const acid=o.v2Corrosion;acid.remaining-=dt;acid.next-=dt;
  if(acid.remaining<=0)o.v2Corrosion=null;
  else if(acid.next<=0){
   const source=G.bl.find(t=>t.uid===acid.owner&&alive(t));
   if(source){
    strike(source,o,source.baseDmg*(.04+.02*acid.stacks),{poison:.35});
    setStatus(source,o,'weaken',.4);
   }
   acid.next+=.6;
  }
 }
}
function signatureTick32(o,dt,st){
 const id=o.b.id;
 if(id===32&&o.v2Volatile){
  const mix=o.v2Volatile;mix.next-=dt;
  if(mix.next<=0){
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   if(mix.roll===0&&foe)radial(o,foe,.22,{radius:105,burn:.3});
   if(mix.roll===1&&foe)setStatus(o,foe,'slow',.65);
   if(mix.roll===2){
    o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+3.2);
    o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+2);
   }
   visual(o,foe||o,'dice',34,abilityData[32].color,.4);
   mix.remaining--;mix.next+=.55;
   if(mix.remaining<=0)o.v2Volatile=null;
  }
 }else if(id===33&&false&&o.v2Express){
  const x=o.v2Express;x.next-=dt;
  if(x.next<=0){
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   if(foe){
    const train=zone(o,17,clamp(foe.y+24,20,340),'train',15,2.9,.37);
    if(train){train.vx=165;train.vy=0;train.v2RailTrain=2;train.v2RailClock=.2;}
   }
   x.remaining--;x.next+=.7;
   if(x.remaining<=0)o.v2Express=null;
  }
 }else if(id===36){
  const after=o.v2LightEcho;
  if(after){
   after.remaining-=dt;after.next-=dt;
   if(after.remaining<=0)o.v2LightEcho=null;
   else if(after.next<=0){
    const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
    if(foe&&Math.hypot(foe.x-after.x,foe.y-after.y)<58)
     strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.15,{slow:.27});
    zone(o,after.x,after.y,'shock',18,1.05,.19);
    after.next+=.55;
   }
  }
  const returning=o.v2PrismaticReturn;
  if(returning){
   returning.next-=dt;
   if(returning.next<=0){
    o.x=clamp(returning.from.x,o.r,W-o.r);
    o.y=clamp(returning.from.y,o.r,W-o.r);
    const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
    if(foe)radial(o,foe,.3,{radius:105,knock:.24});
    visual(o,o,'blink',44,abilityData[36].color,.5);
    o.v2PrismaticReturn=null;
   }
  }
 }else if(id===37&&o.v2SugarCrystal){
  const sugar=o.v2SugarCrystal;sugar.next-=dt;
  if(sugar.next<=0){
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   if(foe){
    const kind=sugar.flavor==='frost'?'frost':sugar.flavor==='sour'?'poison':'shock';
    const offset=sugar.remaining%2===0?-19:19;
    zone(o,clamp(foe.x+offset,16,344),clamp(foe.y-offset,16,344),
     kind,22,2.1,.29);
   }
   sugar.remaining--;sugar.next+=.7;
   if(sugar.remaining<=0)o.v2SugarCrystal=null;
  }
 }else if(id===38&&o.v2SlimeBud){
  const bud=o.v2SlimeBud;bud.remaining-=dt;bud.next-=dt;
  if(bud.remaining<=0)o.v2SlimeBud=null;
  else if(bud.next<=0){
   if(Math.hypot(o.x-bud.lastX,o.y-bud.lastY)>9){
    const h=zone(o,o.x,o.y,'slime',18+bud.level*2,2.2,.35);
    if(h&&bud.level===2)h.v2SlimeDivision=true;
    bud.lastX=o.x;bud.lastY=o.y;
    if(bud.level===2)o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+.65);
   }
   bud.next+=bud.level===2?.28:.48;
  }
 }else if(id===41&&o.v2LensFocus){
  const focus=o.v2LensFocus;focus.next-=dt;
  if(focus.next<=0){
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   if(foe)shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.16,ghost:true,
     homing:.55,speed:220,color:'#a5f3fc'});
   focus.remaining--;focus.next+=.65;
   if(focus.remaining<=0)o.v2LensFocus=null;
  }
 }else if(id===43&&o.v2Stars){
  const stars=o.v2Stars;stars.next-=dt;
  if(stars.next<=0){
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   if(foe){
    const a=stars.remaining*2.09+G.rt;
    const origin={...o,x:clamp(o.x+Math.cos(a)*28,18,342),
      y:clamp(o.y+Math.sin(a)*28,18,342)};
    shoot(origin,foe,{count:1,damage:o.baseDmg*.14,
      spread:.35,homing:.2,speed:185,bounces:2,starTrail:stars.level===2,
      color:'#fbbf24'});
    o.v2StarShots=(o.v2StarShots||0)+1;
   }

   if(stars.remaining<=0)o.v2Stars=null;
  }
 }else if(id===47&&o.v2Satellites){
  const sat=o.v2Satellites;sat.remaining-=dt;sat.next-=dt;
  const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
  if(sat.intercepts>0){
   for(const bullet of st.shots){
    if(bullet.life>0&&bullet.team!==o.team&&
      Math.hypot(bullet.x-o.x,bullet.y-o.y)<o.r+42){
     bullet.life=0;sat.intercepts--;
     o.v2SatelliteBlocks=(o.v2SatelliteBlocks||0)+1;
     visual(o,o,'shield',27,abilityData[47].color,.45);
     if(sat.intercepts<=0)break;
    }
   }
  }
  if(sat.remaining<=0)o.v2Satellites=null;
  else if(sat.next<=0){
   if(foe){
    const angle=G.rt*3.5,xx=clamp(o.x+Math.cos(angle)*35,15,345),
      yy=clamp(o.y+Math.sin(angle)*35,15,345);
    st.beams.push({x:xx,y:yy,x2:foe.x,y2:foe.y,
      color:abilityData[47].color,life:.35,max:.35,id:47});
    if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<210)
      strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*(sat.level===2?.12:.08));
    o.v2SatelliteBeams=(o.v2SatelliteBeams||0)+1;
   }
   sat.next+=sat.level===2?.4:.65;
  }
 }
}
function tick(dt){
 if(!G||G.ph!=='battle'||netRole==='guest')return;
 const st=roundState();if(!st)return;
 st.tick+=dt;
 window.BVBTrebusz?.tick(G,dt,first16Api);
 window.BVBNextSixteen?.tick?.(G,dt,first16Api);
 window.BVBThirdSixteen?.tick?.(G,dt,first16Api);
 for(const o of G.bl||[]){
  if(!alive(o))continue;
  o.skillReflect=Math.max(0,(o.skillReflect||0)-dt);
  if(o.skillImpact>0)o.skillImpact=Math.max(0,o.skillImpact-dt);
  if(o.status.weaken>0)o.status.weaken=Math.max(0,o.status.weaken-dt);
  afflictedTick32(o,dt);
  if(o.b.id<16)window.BVBFirstSixteen?.tick?.(G,o,dt,first16Api);
  if(o.b.id===36&&evolutionStage(o)===0&&o.v1LightAfterimage&&
    G.rt>=o.v1LightAfterimage.next){
   const origin=o.v1LightAfterimage;
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
   st.beams.push({x:origin.x,y:origin.y,x2:o.x,y2:o.y,
    color:abilityData[36].color,life:.35,max:.35,id:36});
   if(foe&&closestToSegment(foe.x,foe.y,origin.x,origin.y,o.x,o.y)<foe.r+13)
    strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.16,{slow:.2});
   o.v1LightAfterimage=null;
   visual(o,origin,'blink',30,abilityData[36].color,.42);
  }
  if(o.b.id===47&&evolutionStage(o)===0&&o.v1OrbitShield?.expires>G.rt){
   for(const p of st.shots){
    if(p.life<=0||p.team===o.team)continue;
    if(Math.hypot(p.x-o.x,p.y-o.y)<=o.r+32){
     p.life=0;o.v1OrbitShield.remaining--;
     o.v1SatelliteBlocks=(o.v1SatelliteBlocks||0)+1;
     visual(o,o,'shield',32,abilityData[47].color,.4);
     if(o.v1OrbitShield.remaining<=0){o.v1OrbitShield=null;break;}
    }
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id===17&&o.v1CellDivision){
   const cells=o.v1CellDivision;cells.next-=dt;
   if(cells.next<=0){
    const offset=cells.remaining%2===0?-23:23;
    zone(o,clamp(cells.originX+offset,16,344),
      clamp(cells.originY-offset,16,344),'slime',13,2.1,.25);
    o.v1CellSplits=(o.v1CellSplits||0)+1;
    cells.remaining--;cells.next+=.56;
    if(cells.remaining<=0)o.v1CellDivision=null;
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id===20&&o.v1ForesightMark){
   const mark=o.v1ForesightMark;mark.next-=dt;
   if(mark.next<=0){
    st.beams.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,x2:mark.x,y2:mark.y,
      id:20,color:abilityData[20].color,life:.26,max:.26});
    const f=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
    if(f&&Math.hypot(mark.x-f.x,mark.y-f.y)<f.r+19)
     strike(o,f,o.baseDmg*.09,{slow:.18});
    o.v1ForesightMarks=(o.v1ForesightMarks||0)+1;
    o.v1ForesightMark=null;
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id===38&&o.v1StickyMass){
   const mass=o.v1StickyMass;mass.next-=dt;mass.remaining-=dt;
   if(mass.remaining<=0)o.v1StickyMass=null;
   else if(mass.next<=0){
    if(Math.hypot(o.x-mass.lastX,o.y-mass.lastY)>9){
     const h=zone(o,o.x,o.y,'slime',15,2,.3);
     if(h)h.v1StickyTrail=true;
     mass.lastX=o.x;mass.lastY=o.y;
    }
    mass.next+=.42;
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id===29&&o.v1FrostWake){
   const wake=o.v1FrostWake;wake.remaining-=dt;wake.next-=dt;
   if(wake.remaining<=0)o.v1FrostWake=null;
   else if(wake.next<=0){
    if(Math.hypot(o.x-wake.lastX,o.y-wake.lastY)>7){
     zone(o,o.x,o.y,'frost',17,2,.34);
     wake.lastX=o.x;wake.lastY=o.y;
    }
    wake.next+=.38;
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id===19&&o.v1PressureImpulse){
   const pulse=o.v1PressureImpulse;pulse.remaining-=dt;pulse.next-=dt;
   if(pulse.remaining<=0)o.v1PressureImpulse=null;
   else if(pulse.next<=0){
    const f=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
    if(f){const dx=f.x-o.x,dy=f.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
     if(d<95){f.vx=(f.vx||0)+dx/d*.14;f.vy=(f.vy||0)+dy/d*.14;}}
    pulse.next+=.5;
   }
  }
  if(o.b.id>=32&&o.b.id<=47)signatureTick32(o,dt,st);
  // Second bespoke batch (24–31): simulate their OWN collision or movement
  // mechanics, not generic on-cast bonus shots.
  if(o.v2Viral){
   const virus=o.v2Viral;virus.clock-=dt;
   if(virus.clock<=0){
    const carrier=G.bl.find(a=>a.uid===virus.owner&&alive(a));
    if(carrier){
     strike(carrier,o,carrier.baseDmg*(.09+.035*virus.stacks),{poison:.42});
     if(virus.mutation&&!virus.bloomed){
      zone(carrier,o.x,o.y,'poison',30+virus.stacks*4,2.6,.38+.09*virus.stacks);
      virus.bloomed=true;
     }
    }
    virus.remaining--;virus.clock+=.57;
    if(virus.remaining<=0)o.v2Viral=null;
   }
  }
  if(o.v2Ripples){
   const ripple=o.v2Ripples;ripple.next-=dt;
   if(ripple.next<=0){

    const last=ripple.level===2&&ripple.remaining===1;
    const radius=last?120:76+ripple.index*31;
    if(foe){
     radial(o,foe,.14+ripple.index*.05,{radius,slow:.18});
     if(last&&Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<radius+10){
      const dx=o.x-foe.x,dy=o.y-foe.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
      foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+dx/d*.4;
      foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dy/d*.4;
     }
    }
    visual(o,o,'ring',radius,abilityData[28].color,.55);
    ripple.index++;ripple.remaining--;ripple.next+=.35;
    if(ripple.remaining<=0)o.v2Ripples=null;
   }
  }
  if(o.v2FrostSteps){
   const frost=o.v2FrostSteps;frost.remaining-=dt;frost.next-=dt;
   if(frost.remaining<=0)o.v2FrostSteps=null;
   else if(frost.next<=0){
    const travelled=Math.hypot(o.x-frost.lastX,o.y-frost.lastY);
    if(travelled>=8){
     zone(o,o.x,o.y,'frost',18+frost.level*2,2.3,.29);
     if(frost.level===2){
      zone(o,(o.x+frost.lastX)/2,(o.y+frost.lastY)/2,
       'iceRail',19,2.8,.40);
     }
     frost.lastX=o.x;frost.lastY=o.y;
     visual(o,o,'tail',26,abilityData[29].color,.5);
    }
    frost.next+=frost.level===2?.3:.5;
   }
  }
  if(o.v2HarpAnchor){
   const chain=o.v2HarpAnchor;chain.remaining-=dt;chain.next-=dt;
   const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.uid===chain.uid&&alive(t));
   if(!foe||chain.remaining<=0)o.v2HarpAnchor=null;
   else if(chain.next<=0){
    const dx=o.x-foe.x,dy=o.y-foe.y,dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    if(dist<270){
     const tension=(chain.level===2?.35:.23);
     foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+dx/dist*tension;
     foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dy/dist*tension;
     setStatus(o,foe,'slow',chain.level===2?.6:.45);
     chain.pulses++;
     const last=chain.level===2&&chain.remaining<.42;
     if(last){
      strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.28,{stun:.24});
      o.v2HarpAnchor=null;
     }
     st.beams.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,x2:foe.x,y2:foe.y,
      color:abilityData[30].color,life:.3,max:.3,id:30});
    }
    if(o.v2HarpAnchor)chain.next+=.24;
   }
  }
  if(o.v2Hive){
   const hive=o.v2Hive;hive.remaining-=dt;hive.next-=dt;
   for(const projectile of st.shots){
    if(hive.intercepts<=0)break;
    if(projectile.life>0&&projectile.team!==o.team&&
      Math.hypot(projectile.x-o.x,projectile.y-o.y)<o.r+52){
     projectile.life=0;hive.intercepts--;
     o.v2HiveBlocks=(o.v2HiveBlocks||0)+1;
     visual(o,o,'shield',26,abilityData[31].color,.5);
    }
   }
   if(hive.remaining<=0)o.v2Hive=null;
   else if(hive.next<=0){
    const foe=G.bl.find(t=>t.team!==o.team&&alive(t));
    if(foe){

   }

  // and pulling, rather than one-off reused actions or cosmetic rings.

   if(bud.clock<=0){

 for(const s of st.shots){

   if(foe){

    s.vx=s.vx*(1-turn)+dx*turn;s.vy=s.vy*(1-turn)+dy*turn;
   }
  }

     const owner=G.bl.find(o=>o.uid===s.owner&&alive(o));
     if(owner){

     }

     if(archer&&target){

       color:'#fef08a'

     }

   }else s.life=0;
  }

   if(owner)strike(owner,target,s.damage,{slow:s.slow,poison:s.poison,burn:s.burn,stun:s.stun,knock:s.knock});
   if(owner&&s.healOnHit&&alive(owner))owner.hp=Math.min(owner.mh,owner.hp+s.healOnHit);
   s.life=0;
  }
 }

   }

  else if(h.kind==='fire'||h.kind==='sun')strike(owner,foe,3*h.power,{burn:.8});
  else if(h.kind==='mine'||h.kind==='doom'||h.kind==='train')strike(owner,foe,7*h.power,{knock:.28,stun:h.id===39?.3:0});
  else strike(owner,foe,3*h.power,{knock:h.kind==='zone'?.1:0});
  // Extra effects originate from confirmed hazard hits. V3 produces a
  // distinct consequence instead of doubling a generic power multiplier.
  if(h.v1GiantPiston){
   const dx=foe.x-h.x,dy=foe.y-h.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
   foe.vx=(foe.vx||0)+dx/d*.22;foe.vy=(foe.vy||0)+dy/d*.22;
  }
  if(h.v1ShackleTrap){setStatus(owner,foe,'stun',.38);h.v1ShackleTrap=false;}
  if(h.v1HauntedGrave){
   setStatus(owner,foe,'weaken',.75);
   foe.v2Haunted={owner:owner.uid,next:.4,remaining:2,level:1};
   h.v1HauntedGrave=false;
  }
  if(h.v1CorrosivePuddle)setStatus(owner,foe,'weaken',.75);
  if(h.v1TimedBomb&&!h.v1BombExploded){
   h.v1BombExploded=true;radial(owner,foe,.11,{radius:44,knock:.22});
  }
  if(h.v2Grave&&!h.v2Activated){
   h.v2Activated=true;
   setStatus(owner,foe,'weaken',.9);
   foe.v2Haunted={owner:owner.uid,next:.36,remaining:h.v2Grave===2?3:2,level:h.v2Grave};
   if(h.v2Grave===2){

    if(next)next.armAt=.55;
   }
  }
  if(h.v2Shackle&&!h.v2Activated){
   h.v2Activated=true;
   foe.v2Shackled={owner:owner.uid,next:.22,remaining:h.v2Shackle===2?3:2,level:h.v2Shackle};
   setStatus(owner,foe,'stun',h.v2Shackle===2?.33:.2);
  }

   const old=foe.v2Corrosion?.owner===owner.uid?foe.v2Corrosion?.stacks||0:0;
   foe.v2Corrosion={owner:owner.uid,stacks:Math.min(4,old+1),next:.4,remaining:2.3};

     clamp(h.y-side*16,16,344),'slime',14,2,.25);

     const child=zone(owner,clamp(h.x+dx,16,344),clamp(h.y+dy,16,344),
      'mine',16,2,.3);
     if(child)child.armAt=.35;

   }

  h.cooldown=h.kind==='mine'||h.kind==='doom'||h.kind==='echo'?99:.62;

 for(const beam of st.wallBeams||[]){
  beam.life-=dt;
  if(beam.life<=0)continue;
  for(const foe of G.bl){
   if(!alive(foe)||foe.team===beam.team)continue;

   if(touched&&!beam.inside[foe.uid]){
    const owner=G.bl.find(o=>o.uid===beam.owner);
    if(owner)strike(owner,foe,2.5,{slow:.2});
   }
   beam.inside[foe.uid]=touched;
  }
 }
 st.wallBeams=(st.wallBeams||[]).filter(b=>b.life>0);
 for(const w of st.webs){

const oldStep=step;
step=function(dt){
 if(!G||G.ph!=='battle')return;
 const previous=(G.bl||[]).map(o=>({o,x:o.x,y:o.y,vx:o.vx,vy:o.vy}));
 oldStep(dt);
 if(!G||G.ph!=='battle'||netRole==='guest')return;
 for(const p of previous){
  const o=p.o;if(!alive(o))continue;
  let side=null;
  if(p.vx*o.vx<0&&(o.x<=o.r+.3||o.x>=W-o.r-.3))side=o.x<W/2?'left':'right';
  if(p.vy*o.vy<0&&(o.y<=o.r+.3||o.y>=W-o.r-.3))side=o.y<W/2?'top':'bottom';
  if(side)onWall(o,side);
 }
 tick(dt);
};

  cx.strokeStyle=e.color;cx.lineWidth=Math.max(.7,3*(1-t));
  if(e.kind==='slash'){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(.45+t),-.6,1.95);cx.stroke();}
  else if(e.kind==='orbit'){for(let i=0;i<3;i++){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(.4+t),i*2*Math.PI/3+t,i*2*Math.PI/3+.5+t);cx.stroke();}}
  else if(e.kind==='clock'){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(.5+t),0,7);cx.stroke();cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(e.x,e.y);cx.lineTo(e.x+e.size*.35,e.y-e.size*.3);cx.stroke();}
  else {
   cx.beginPath();cx.arc(e.x,e.y,e.size*(.35+t),0,Math.PI*2);cx.stroke();
   // Per-ball rune pattern: every ball uses a different rhythm and geometry.
   const petals=3+(e.id%6),rot=(e.id%2?-1:1)*t*(.7+e.id%5*.16);
   cx.globalAlpha*=.58;
   for(let j=0;j<petals;j++){
    const a=j*Math.PI*2/petals+rot,r=e.size*(.24+t*.63);
    const x=e.x+Math.cos(a)*r,y=e.y+Math.sin(a)*r;
    if(e.id%3===0){cx.strokeRect(x-2,y-2,4,4);}
    else if(e.id%3===1){cx.beginPath();cx.arc(x,y,1.4+(e.id%3),0,7);cx.stroke();}
    else {cx.beginPath();cx.moveTo(x,y-3);cx.lineTo(x+3,y);cx.lineTo(x,y+3);cx.closePath();cx.stroke();}
   }
  }
 }
 cx.restore();
}

function stage(o,h){return h.evolutionStage(o);}

function onCast(g,o,foe,h){
 if(!g||!o||!foe||o.b?.id>=16)return;
 const id=o.b.id,lv=stage(o,h),t=g.rt||0,st=h.roundState();
 if(!st)return;
 switch(id){
 case 0:{
  // Direction change is physical; Fibonacci's value grows on impact instead.
  if(lv){const a=.11*lv*(o.y<=foe.y?1:-1),vx=o.vx,vy=o.vy;
   o.vx=vx*Math.cos(a)-vy*Math.sin(a);o.vy=vx*Math.sin(a)+vy*Math.cos(a);}
  o.bvbRushWindow=lv?t+1.7:0;break;
 }
 case 1:
  if(o.axeOrbit)o.axeOrbit.angle=t*.5;

   if(lv)p.bounces=lv;if(lv===2){p.ghost=true;p.poison=.3;}}
  if(lv===2){foe.aiTarget={vx:-(foe.vy||0),vy:foe.vx||0};
   foe.aiDecisionClock=Math.max(foe.aiDecisionClock||0,.55);}
  o.bvbStolenKnives=knives.length;break;
 }
 case 4:
  if(lv)o.bvbSpiral={next:t+.39,remaining:lv===2?3:2,lv};
  break;
 case 5:{
  // Salvo recoil and temperature replace a repeated arc-knife mechanic.
  o.bvbRifleHeat=Math.min(6,(o.bvbRifleHeat||0)+1);
  for(const p of st.shots.filter(p=>p.owner===o.uid&&p.id===5&&p.age===0)){
   p.homing=lv?Math.min(1.1,.16+o.bvbRifleHeat*.16):0;
   if(lv===2&&o.bvbRifleHeat>=3){p.burn=.45;p.knock=.1;}
  }
  if(lv===2&&o.bvbRifleHeat>=5){
   o.bvbRifleHeat=0;o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+3);

 }

  break;
 case 11:{

function onWall(g,o,side,h){
 const lv=stage(o,h),id=o.b.id,t=g.rt||0,st=h.roundState();
 if(!lv||!st)return;
 switch(id){
 case 0:
  if(lv===2&&o.bvbRushWindow>t){
   const f=foeFor(g,o,h);if(f){h.dash(o,f,.2);h.radial(o,f,.24,{radius:72,knock:.14});}
   o.bvbRushWindow=0;o.bvbRicochets=(o.bvbRicochets||0)+1;
  }break;
 case 2:{
  const old=o.bvbBriarLast;
  if(old&&old.side!==side&&o.bvbBriarUntil>t){
   const x=(old.x+o.x)/2,y=(old.y+o.y)/2;
   h.zone(o,x,y,'thorn',lv===2?26:19,3.1,.34);
   if(lv===2)for(const f of [-.24,.24])
    h.zone(o,clamp(x+(o.x-old.x)*f,17,343),
      clamp(y+(o.y-old.y)*f,17,343),'thorn',18,3,.31);
   o.bvbBriarBranches=(o.bvbBriarBranches||0)+1;
  }
  o.bvbBriarLast={side,x:o.x,y:o.y};
  break;
 }
 case 6:{
  const webs=st.webs.filter(w=>w.owner===o.uid);
  if(webs.length){
   const web=webs[webs.length-1];
   h.zone(o,(web.a.x+web.b.x)/2,(web.a.y+web.b.y)/2,'slow',lv===2?27:19,2,.3);
   o.bvbSilkVibrations=(o.bvbSilkVibrations||0)+1;
   if(lv===2&&webs.length>=2){
    const last=webs.slice(-2),x=last.reduce((v,w)=>v+(w.a.x+w.b.x)/4,0),
      y=last.reduce((v,w)=>v+(w.a.y+w.b.y)/4,0);
    h.zone(o,x,y,'slow',24,1.5,.4);
    o.bvbCocoons=(o.bvbCocoons||0)+1;
   }
  }break;
 }
 case 8:o.bvbSpearAnchor={x:o.x,y:o.y,side,until:t+2};break;
 case 9:
  if(o.bvbBurstEcho?.until>t&&!o.bvbBurstEcho.used){
   const f=foeFor(g,o,h);
   if(f)h.radial(o,f,.2,{radius:lv===2?112:85,knock:.14});
   o.bvbBurstEcho.used=true;
   o.bvbReflectedWaves=(o.bvbReflectedWaves||0)+1;
   if(lv===2&&f&&Math.hypot(f.x-o.x,f.y-o.y)<125)
    h.zone(o,f.x,f.y,'fire',21,1.3,.29);
  }break;
 case 12:
  if(o.bvbIceGrowth>t){
   for(const off of (lv===2?[-24,0,24]:[0])){
    const x=side==='left'||side==='right'?o.x:clamp(o.x+off,16,344),
      y=side==='left'||side==='right'?clamp(o.y+off,16,344):o.y;
    h.zone(o,x,y,'frost',17,3,.36);
   }
   o.bvbIcicles=(o.bvbIcicles||0)+(lv===2?3:1);
  }break;
 case 14:
  if(o.bvbShedReady){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+4+lv*2);
   o.bvbShedReady=false;o.bvbShedding=(o.bvbShedding||0)+1;
   h.visual(o,o,'shield',26,'#b9f990',.6);
  }break;
 case 15:
  if(lv===2&&o.bvbHookSwing?.until>t){
   const f=foeFor(g,o,h);if(f){
    const dx=f.x-o.x,dy=f.y-o.y,d=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
    o.vx=-dy/d*.9;o.vy=dx/d*.9;
   }
   o.bvbHookWall=(o.bvbHookWall||0)+1;
   o.bvbHookSwing.until=0;
  }break;
 }
}
function onContact(g,o,foe,base,h){
 const lv=stage(o,h),t=g.rt||0;
 if(!lv)return base;
 if(o.b.id===0&&o.bvbRushWindow>t){
  o.bvbRushWindow=0;return base+o.baseDmg*.13*lv;
 }
 if(o.b.id===8&&lv===2&&o.bvbSpearFollow?.until>t){
  h.shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.22,ghost:true,bounces:1,knock:.13});
  o.bvbSpearFollow.until=0;
  o.bvbSecondThrusts=(o.bvbSecondThrusts||0)+1;
 }
 return base;
}
function tick(g,o,dt,h){
 const lv=stage(o,h),t=g.rt||0,st=h.roundState();
 if(!lv||!st)return;
 const foe=foeFor(g,o,h);if(!foe)return;
 if(o.b.id===1&&o.bvbAxeReturn&&t>=o.bvbAxeReturn.next){
  const r=o.bvbAxeReturn;
  h.shoot(o,foe,{damage:o.baseDmg*.24,bounces:r.lv===2?2:1,
   knock:.11,speed:165,color:'#ffb76d'});
  r.remaining--;r.next=t+.55;
  if(r.remaining<=0)o.bvbAxeReturn=null;
 }
 if(o.b.id===4&&o.bvbSpiral&&t>=o.bvbSpiral.next){
  const sp=o.bvbSpiral;
  if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<110+lv*15){
   h.radial(o,foe,.13,{radius:110+lv*15,slow:.2});
   if(lv===2&&sp.remaining===1)h.setStatus(o,foe,'stun',.2);
  }
  sp.remaining--;sp.next=t+.5;if(sp.remaining<=0)o.bvbSpiral=null;
 }
 if(o.b.id===7){
  if(o.bvbBloodBank>0&&o.hp/o.mh<.4){
   o.status.shield=Math.min(32,(o.status.shield||0)+o.bvbBloodBank);
   o.bvbBloodBank=0;
  }
  if(lv===2&&o.bvbBloodLink&&t>=o.bvbBloodLink.next){
   if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<195){
    h.strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.1,{slow:.18});
    o.hp=Math.min(o.mh,o.hp+2.1);
   }
   o.bvbBloodLink.remaining--;o.bvbBloodLink.next=t+.48;
   if(o.bvbBloodLink.remaining<=0)o.bvbBloodLink=null;
  }
 }
 if(o.b.id===13&&o.bvbLaserScan&&t>=o.bvbLaserScan.next){
  const scan=o.bvbLaserScan,a=t*.75+(scan.remaining%2)*.35;
  st.beams.push({x:o.x,y:o.y,
   x2:clamp(o.x+Math.cos(a)*150,0,360),
   y2:clamp(o.y+Math.sin(a)*150,0,360),
   id:13,color:'#ff92bd',life:.28,max:.28});
  if(Math.hypot(foe.x-o.x,foe.y-o.y)<100+lv*25)
   h.strike(o,foe,o.baseDmg*.07,{slow:.13});
  scan.remaining--;scan.next=t+.4;
  if(scan.remaining<=0)o.bvbLaserScan=null;
 }
 if(o.b.id===14&&lv===2&&o.bvbSnakeKnot&&t>=o.bvbSnakeKnot.next){
  const points=(o.trail||[]).slice(-18);
  if(points.length>=5){
   const a=points[0],b=points[points.length-1];
   if(Math.hypot(a.x-b.x,a.y-b.y)<42){
    h.zone(o,clamp((a.x+b.x)/2,15,345),clamp((a.y+b.y)/2,15,345),'slow',24,1.8,.32);
    o.bvbKnots=(o.bvbKnots||0)+1;
   }
  }
  o.bvbSnakeKnot.remaining--;o.bvbSnakeKnot.next=t+.63;
  if(o.bvbSnakeKnot.remaining<=0)o.bvbSnakeKnot=null;
 }
}
window.BVBFirstSixteen={descriptions,description:(id,stage)=>{
 const row=descriptions[id];return row&&stage>0?'V'+(stage+1)+': '+row[stage-1]:null;
},onCast,onWall,onContact,tick};
})();
</script>
<script>
/* BVB 2.0 — Animated skill preview in collection, keeps base inventory UI. */
(() => {
'use strict';
if(!window.BVB2?.abilities)return;
const css=document.createElement('style');
css.textContent=[
'.bvb-skill-preview{margin-top:14px;border:1px solid #555fc6;background:#090f2a;',
'border-radius:15px;padding:12px;text-align:left}',
'.bvb-skill-preview h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:#c4b5fd;font-size:.93rem}',

'.bvb-skill-preview p{font-size:.79rem;line-height:1.5;color:#cbd5e1}',
'.bvb-skill-preview button{margin:8px 0 0;width:100%}'
].join('');
document.head.appendChild(css);
const defensive=new Set(['shield','reflect','heal','growth','time','eclipse','mirage']);
const zones=new Set(['poison','gas','mine','zone','lava','sun','frost','thorn','grid','pet','turret','train']);
const beams=new Set(['beam','prism','tether','ray']);
const dashes=new Set(['dash','blink','charge','chess']);
const colors={frost:'#9ee9ff',shield:'#67e8f9',heal:'#86efac',shock:'#facc15',poison:'#b5f574',lava:'#fb923c'};
let ticket=0;
function play(id){
 const canvas=document.getElementById('bvb-skill-preview-canvas');
 if(!canvas||!B[id])return;
 const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');if(!ctx)return;
 const skill=window.BVB2.abilities[id],type=skill.kind,color=colors[type]||skill.color||'#c4b5fd';
 const token=++ticket,start=performance.now(),W=320,H=150;
 function circle(x,y,r,c){
  ctx.fillStyle=c;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();
 }
 function glowingLine(x,y,x2,y2,w,c,alpha=1){
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.shadowColor=c;ctx.shadowBlur=10;
  ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x2,y2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
 }
 function sprite(ball,x,y,r){
  const img=ART_IMAGES.get(ball);
  if(img?.complete&&img.naturalWidth)ctx.drawImage(img,x-r,y-r,r*2,r*2);
  else circle(x,y,r,B[ball]?.c||'#fff');
 }
 function frame(now){
  // Stop the preview when the menu, collection window or its parent view is hidden.
  // Otherwise requestAnimationFrame would keep rendering during the actual fight on phones.
  if(token!==ticket||canvas!==document.getElementById('bvb-skill-preview-canvas')||canvas.closest?.('[hidden]'))return;
  const phase=((now-start)/1000)%2.9,t=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,(phase-.35)/1.2));
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  const grad=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,W,H);grad.addColorStop(0,'#0b1433');grad.addColorStop(1,'#1c1647');
  ctx.fillStyle=grad;ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#52639a';ctx.lineWidth=3;ctx.strokeRect(3,3,W-6,H-6);
  for(let j=0;j<18;j++){
   const x=(j*73+13)%W,y=(j*47+29)%H;
   circle(x,y,j%4===0?1.7:1,'#596ca5');
  }
  const ox=dashes.has(type)?65+Math.max(0,t-.1)*76:67,ex=248,oy=H/2,ey=H/2;
  const opacity=phase>2.3?Math.max(.05,(2.9-phase)/.6):1;
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=opacity;
  if(type==='web'){
   const startX=12,startY=42,endX=W-12,endY=111;
   if(phase>.38)circle(startX,startY,4,'#fef9c3');
   if(phase>.9)circle(endX,endY,4,'#fef9c3');
   if(phase>.9){
    glowingLine(startX,startY,endX,endY,2,'#cbd5e1');
    for(let i=1;i<8;i++){const p=i/8,x=startX+(endX-startX)*p,y=startY+(endY-startY)*p;
     glowingLine(x-7,y-7,x+7,y+7,.75,'#dbeafe',.7);}
   }
  }else if(defensive.has(type)){
   if(phase>.5){
    ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.shadowColor=color;ctx.shadowBlur=18;ctx.lineWidth=3;
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ox,oy,24+12*Math.sin(t*Math.PI),0,7);ctx.stroke();
   }
  }else if(zones.has(type)){
   if(phase>.42){
    const radius=15+30*t;ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.23;
    circle(ex,ey,radius,color);ctx.restore();
    ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex,ey,radius,0,7);ctx.stroke();
   }
  }else if(beams.has(type)){
   if(phase>.48){
    glowingLine(ox+13,oy,ex-12,ey,8,color,.55);
    glowingLine(ox+13,oy,ex-12,ey,2,'#ffffff',.85);
   }
  }else if(dashes.has(type)){
   if(phase>.38)glowingLine(ox-55,oy,ox-12,oy,4,color,.5);
  }else if(phase>.35){
   let px=ox+25+Math.min(1,t)*155,py=oy+Math.sin(t*Math.PI*2)*8;
   glowingLine(px-23,py,px,py,3,color,.65);circle(px,py,6,color);
   circle(px-1,py-2,2,'#ffffff');
  }
  if(type==='orbit'||type==='shard'||type==='swarm'){
    for(let i=0;i<3;i++){
     const angle=(now-start)/500+i*2*Math.PI/3;
     circle(ox+Math.cos(angle)*27,oy+Math.sin(angle)*27,4,color);
    }
  }
  sprite(1,ex,ey,16);
  sprite(id,ox,oy,18);
  if(phase>1.2 && phase<2.15 && !defensive.has(type)){
   ctx.strokeStyle='#ffffff';ctx.globalAlpha=.75*Math.sin((phase-1.2)/.95*Math.PI);
   ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(ex,ey,20+(phase-1.2)*15,0,7);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.restore();
  if(phase<2.9)requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 }
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
// Inventory animation preview removed; standalone ability browser remains.
window.BVB2Preview={play};

})();

 }
}

 }
}
